Biological age acceleration here is derived from KDM-BA/PhenoAge clinical biomarkers plus genetic pleiotropy analysis; no DNA methylation was directly assayed.
DNAm epigenetic clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge) were directly calculated from blood and compared with telomere length in a pediatric multiple sclerosis case-control study.
This AML study assesses IDH mutation status and hypomethylating-agent therapy outcomes but does not directly measure any epigenetic marker.
cfDNA methylation fragment ratio and CAFF scores were directly measured by methylation sequencing in a prospective neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy trial to predict pathological response.
PhenoAge here is calculated from UK Biobank clinical/genetic data via correlation and Mendelian randomization analyses without any DNA methylation measurement.
HMGB1 is measured as a serum inflammatory protein biomarker for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis exacerbation, not an epigenetic marker.
Over one million DNA methylation sites were directly measured across brain regions in a PTSD/MDD case-control postmortem cohort and linked to ketamine treatment response.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating plasma NET biomarker, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiling directly resolved diagnostic classification of pilocytic astrocytoma among 68 histologically ambiguous gliomas.
Preoperative tumor tissue underwent direct epigenetic/DNA methylation profiling in a prospective phase II trial correlating molecular subtype with survival.
miRNA-133a and miRNA-452 expression were the markers directly measured in patient blood samples; CpG methylation was only referenced from an external GEO dataset, not measured here.
KDM6A status was assessed by immunohistochemical protein expression rather than by a direct histone modification assay.
Whole-exome sequencing found recurrent mutations in histone H3-modifying genes, which is a genetic mutation finding, not a direct measurement of histone modification or chromatin state.
DNA methylation profiling was directly performed across tumor-adjacent lung tissue at varying distances and linked to prognosis in an added four-year-follow-up cohort.
BioAge here is explicitly calculated from seven routine clinical biomarkers in NSCLC patients, not from any epigenetic assay.
KDMAge and PhenoAge are computed from NHANES clinical biomarkers for digestive cancer risk, with no epigenetic marker directly measured.
Methylation analysis is mentioned only briefly alongside NGS in a 14-case series without clarifying what was measured or a clear comparison design.
Biological age and PhenoAge are explicitly calculated from clinical biomarkers (resting heart rate, activity, BMI) in this VO2max-T2D cohort, not from DNA methylation.
This brain abscess study uses proteomics-based pathogen and host-protein identification, with no epigenetic marker measured.
SOCS6 promoter methylation was directly measured in tumor and adjacent tissue from HCC patients alongside polymorphism genotyping, linked to HBV-related liver disease progression.
GABRB2 promoter methylation was directly measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR in a case-control comparison of oral squamous cell carcinoma tissue and serum.
DNA methylation levels and epigenetic clocks (OMICmAge, GrimAge V2, PhenoAge) were directly measured before and after a course of ketamine infusions in MDD/PTSD patients.
This is a study protocol for a planned nonrandomized trial with laboratory analyses still ongoing at the time of the report, and no epigenetic marker is reported as measured.
Plasma cfDNA methylation sequencing was directly performed before and after treatment in a phase II trial of cadonilimab for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, linked to treatment response.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was directly measured in umbilical cord blood and compared between neonates with and without in utero low-dose aspirin exposure.

DNA methylation at SLAMF8-correlated CpG sites was analyzed via a public database rather than directly assayed in the authors' own patient cohort, leaving the individual-level versus summary nature of this data unclear.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (Infinium EPIC array) was directly measured in parathyroid carcinoma and adenoma tissue to identify diagnostic methylation markers.
An enzyme-assisted cfDNA methylation sequencing assay was directly measured and validated across multicenter case-control cohorts for multi-cancer early detection screening.
CpG site-specific methylation of PRSS3 was directly measured and linked to prognosis in an independent validation cohort of gastric cancer patients.
Cord blood DNA methylation was directly measured and mediation-analyzed between maternal obesogenic lifestyle exposures and offspring birth weight in a prospective birth cohort.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating NET biomarker in serum from heart failure patients, a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
gamma-H2AX-positive lymphocytes, a directly measured histone modification, were assessed in electroplating workers stratified by chromium/cadmium exposure alongside rDNA copy number.
Bulk DNA methylation from whole blood was directly measured and compared between high and low allostatic load groups in a cell-type-deconvoluted cohort analysis.
DNA methylation-based molecular grouping of medulloblastoma was directly used for risk stratification across three combined clinical trial cohorts.
CHI3L1 and PI3 promoter CpG methylation were directly measured by bisulfite sequencing in a case-control comparison of allergic and nonallergic asthma patients.
This phase 1 trial of the BET inhibitor TQB3617 assesses safety and efficacy in lymphoma but does not measure histone acetylation or any epigenetic marker in patients.

DNA hypomethylation and altered heterochromatin were described in oocytes/cumulus cells from women of advancing age, but the abstract does not clearly state a comparison group or one of the five eligible designs.
CpG-T2DM associations were identified via a methylome-wide association study using GWAS summary statistics and a DNA methylation prediction model rather than directly measured methylation.
Acceleration of 13 DNAm epigenetic clocks was directly computed in a prospective cohort and linked to life-course leisure-time physical activity, a modifiable exposure.
Genome-wide PBMC DNA methylation (EPIC 850K array) was directly measured and linked to survival stratification in Chinese lung adenocarcinoma patients.
Loss of the chromatin-stabilization protein EZH2 is inferred from genomic instability (monosomy 7/7q deletion), not directly measured as a chromatin or histone mark.
MGMT promoter methylation rates were directly compared between thalamic DMG-H3K27-altered and glioblastoma patients and linked to overall survival.
ADRB2 5'-UTR methylation was directly measured in a case-control study of adult asthma patients and linked to blood cadmium/lead exposure.
KDM-BA-Accel and PhenoAge-Accel are computed from NHANES clinical/demographic covariates in this machine-learning analysis, with no DNA methylation measured.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation at birth was directly measured in cord blood and tested for interaction with maternal prenatal stress exposure.
DNAm-based epigenetic signatures of CRP and IL-6 were directly derived from blood methylation and linked to PTSD diagnosis and symptom severity.
DNA methylation signature and DNAm age were directly characterized using individual-level TCGA data comparing early-onset and average-onset colorectal cancer.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC 850K array) was directly measured in peripheral blood of children with congenital biliary dilatation versus healthy controls.
Circulating cell-free DNA methylation was directly measured via EWAS in a Nigerian HIV-positive cohort and used to build a risk classifier across the HCC disease spectrum.
SDK1 methylation-COPD associations were derived entirely from GWAS, eQTL and mQTL summary statistics via a multi-omics Mendelian randomization framework.
DNA methylation was profiled directly in HGSC cell lines, but the overlapping CpG probes were also applied to individual-level TCGA-OV tumor samples for survival and drug-sensitivity analysis.
Fractal box-counting analysis of neutrophil nuclear texture is a structural/morphological imaging measure, not a direct assay of a regulatory epigenetic mark.
MGMT promoter methylation and protein levels were directly assessed in human GBM biopsies collected at different times of day and linked to temozolomide treatment timing.
SMAD3 promoter methylation was directly measured by RT-PCR in a longitudinal study of children from different intrauterine smoking/growth-restriction exposures.
PhenoAge and PhenoAgeAccel in this NHANES dietary copper analysis are clinical-biomarker-based scores, with no DNA methylation measured.
Genome-wide methylation array analysis directly identified prognostic CpG sites integrated into a multi-omics survival model for gastric cancer.
Genome-wide methylation profiling directly identified a CpG panel diagnostic for upper mediastinal lymph node metastasis in esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma.
DNA methylation in cord blood was directly measured and mediation-tested between prenatal phthalate exposure and child leptin levels in a birth cohort.
Phenotypic age and biological age here are computed from validated clinical biomarker algorithms, not DNA methylation, in this LE8-diabetic retinopathy analysis.
BioAgeAccel, PhenoAgeAccel, homeostatic dysregulation and Klotho are NHANES clinical/serum measures; no epigenetic marker was assayed for this ketogenic diet analysis.
This is a plasma proteomic study of aging phenotypes (KDM-BA/PhenoAge acceleration, telomere length, frailty, healthspan); no epigenetic marker was directly measured.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating NET biomarker in maternal plasma/serum, a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Whole-genome DNA methylation in peripheral blood was directly measured and integrated with brain connectome data to define biotypes across major psychiatric disorders.
Blood-derived DNA methylation was directly measured via EWAS across two cohorts and linked to glaucoma diagnosis and intraocular pressure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiling directly identified CpG biomarkers validated as a liquid-biopsy diagnostic assay for lymph node metastasis in T1 gastric cancer.
DNA methylation was directly measured via EWAS in the EPIC-Potsdam cohort and linked to serum copper exposure and incident type 2 diabetes/cardiovascular disease.
Soluble BDCA-2 is measured as a serum protein biomarker by ELISA in rheumatoid arthritis and lupus patients; no epigenetic marker is assayed.
DNA-methylation subtyping was directly performed and shown to significantly impact survival in young-adult high-grade glioma, distinct from MGMT status.
DNA methylation was directly measured in adolescent blood samples and tested as a mediator between prenatal maternal stress exposure and autistic-like traits.
GrimAge2, a DNA-methylation epigenetic clock, was directly computed and analyzed for its cross-sectional association with HDL-cholesterol levels.

Biological age acceleration and homeostatic dysregulation here are derived from NHANES clinical biomarkers, and the Mendelian randomization uses genetic instruments for these clinical scores, not DNA methylation.
qPCR measured expression of the epigenetic-regulator genes DNMT1, TET1, OGG1 and AID, which is gene expression rather than a direct measurement of DNA methylation itself.
T1rho-MRI was evaluated for predicting MGMT promoter methylation status in gliomas, implying methylation was directly assayed as the ground-truth outcome being predicted.
Frailty is assessed here via a clinical deficit-accumulation index, not any epigenetic marker, in this pain-management study.
Sperm DNA fragmentation index via chromatin dispersion assay measures DNA strand breakage/packaging, which the instrument specifically excludes as not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
This is a study protocol for a planned randomized trial in glaucoma patients, with DNA methylation listed only as a future exploratory outcome, not yet measured.
A clinical frailty index is used to predict neurosurgical outcomes; no epigenetic marker is measured in this study.
This is a protocol for the ongoing BEBOP cohort study describing planned recruitment and methylation analysis, not yet-reported primary data.
Retrospective biobank study directly measures FAM19A4/miR-124-2 promoter methylation in HPV-positive cervical samples to triage patients against cytology, a clinical screening decision.
Single-patient case study integrating scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq with previously published samples has no defined comparison-group design among the five eligible.
Prospective cohort of 357 gastric cancer patients directly measures CDO1/HOPX peritoneal lavage methylation to diagnose and prognosticate micrometastatic dissemination.
International INFORM registry cohort of 162 pediatric DMG tumors is explicitly profiled by DNA methylation analysis and correlated with treatment and outcome.
Retrospective cohort measures autoantibodies (including anti-histone antibody) driving false-positive syphilis serology, not a histone modification or other epigenetic mark.
Case-control study genotypes protamine/transition-protein gene variants by Sanger sequencing, a genetic not epigenetic measurement of sperm chromatin compaction.
Sperm DNA fragmentation index via the chromatin dispersion test measures strand breakage/packaging, explicitly excluded as not an epigenetic mark per the instrument.
Cross-sectional SOEP cohort measures buccal-derived epigenetic clocks (PedBE, CheekAge) and their association with socioeconomic status and health disparities.
Whole-exome sequencing study of endometrial carcinoma reports SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling gene mutations, not a directly measured methylation or histone-modification level.
Two independent meningioma cohorts (195 discovery, 485 validation) use DNA methylation-based deconvolution of CpG sites to predict TAM/TIL infiltration and survival.
Cross-sectional survey of dietitians' guideline use for galactosaemia measures no biological or epigenetic marker at all.
Genome-wide methylation discovery validated by TaqMan assay in independent non-ICB and ICB-treated ccRCC cohorts links FBLN2 promoter methylation to prognosis and immunotherapy response.
Study measures VAMP8 protein/mRNA expression in cervical tissue via IHC/qPCR; ChIP-qPCR is used only mechanistically in cell lines, not as a patient-measured marker.
Cross-sectional Korean cohort of 1940 participants relates cardiovascular-health lifestyle behaviours to five DNA methylation-based epigenetic age acceleration measures.
H3K14 crotonylation reading by YEATS4 is characterized in breast cancer cell lines; the patient survival correlation appears to use YEATS4 expression, not the histone mark measured in humans.
Prospective validation of the MORE antenatal counselling classification system measures inter-rater reliability, not any epigenetic marker.
Retrospective cohort of 80 brainstem glioma cases develops and validates a CSF ctDNA methylation classifier (BSGdiag) for diagnosis, prognosis, and monitoring.
SH-MARA is an enrolling study protocol describing planned genetic/methylation analysis of self-harm risk, with no reported primary results yet.
Retrospective histopathological review of 13 H3 G34-mutant glioma cases at a single centre with no stated comparison group is a case series.
Monocentric cohort of 71 metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma patients directly measures HOXD8/POU4F1 methylated ctDNA and correlates it with tumour volume for disease monitoring.
Case-control study of 20 periodontitis and 20 healthy gingival tissue samples directly measures LINE-1 and gene-specific DNA methylation via bisulfite pyrosequencing after periodontal therapy.
The 'histone acetylation-based' model is built from a 7-gene expression signature associated with HAT activity in GEO/TCGA data, not a directly assayed histone modification.
Cohort of 24 pediatric high-grade glioma tissues versus normal brain measures H3K9me3 by immunohistochemistry and correlates it with survival.
Prospective OPTiMiSE cohort of 116 first-episode psychosis patients profiles paired blood methylomes to predict amisulpride treatment response.
Nested case-control study within a birth cohort measures epigenome-wide DNA methylation mediating the association between urinary copper exposure and gestational diabetes.
TGM2/NR3C1 study analyzes TCGA gene expression and confirms transcription-factor binding by ChIP-qPCR only in LUSC cell lines, not a marker measured in patients.
Case-control study of 136 COPD patients versus 64 controls directly measures global DNA methylation as a candidate epigenetic biomarker linked to smoking and disease status.

The abstract does not settle whether the NE phenotype used for this cohort was actually derived from chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (an eligible marker) or from RNA sequencing gene expression in this specific study.
Retrospective comparison of venetoclax+hypomethylating agents versus priming regimens in AML-MR evaluates treatment efficacy without measuring any methylation biomarker.
Beyond the enzymatic-versus-bisulfite methodology comparison, the study reports a clinical finding linking IL-15 methylation to acalabrutinib response in the ACE-CL-001 CLL trial cohort.
Cohort of 111 JMML children and 9 controls directly measures BMP4 promoter methylation by targeted bisulfite sequencing for diagnostic and prognostic risk stratification.

Despite an apparently mismatched methods paragraph, the core case-control study of 25 cancer patients versus 25 controls directly measures p16 promoter hypermethylation linked to cadmium/chromium exposure.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial (VCSIP) measures buccal DNA methylation at asthma/allergy CpGs in children of pregnant smokers given vitamin C.
Next Generation birth cohort performs epigenome-wide cord-blood DNA methylation analysis comparing offspring exposed in-utero to maternal T2D versus GDM.
Diagnostic cohort of 62 individuals evaluates DNA methylation episignature arrays as a first-tier test for suspected genetic disorders.
PhenoAgeAccel here is computed from clinical chemistry biomarkers via linear regression, not from DNA methylation data, so no epigenetic marker is measured.
Three-cohort study of urine extracellular vesicle DNA directly measures methylation at prostate-cancer-specific loci to build a diagnostic and classification panel.
Intrinsic capacity age model is built from cognitive, sensory, vitality and locomotion biomarkers, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic measure.
Framingham cohort links immune-cell phenotypes and inflammatory proteins to DNA methylation aging clocks, but neither a modifiable exposure/intervention nor a clinical decision is being evaluated.
Cohort of 99 gastric cancer patients on anti-PD-1 therapy uses genome-wide methylation array/targeted sequencing to build the iMETH classifier predicting treatment response.
Population-based cohort of 182 Brazilian paediatric CNS tumours applies Infinium MethylationEPIC profiling for molecular diagnostic classification.

The abstract does not state whether DNA methylation at the KCNQ1OT1:TSS-DMR was directly measured in this cohort or whether BWS status was established by prior clinical testing before this placental-pathology analysis.

Multicentre ECCC study with sequencing and TMA validation cohorts directly measures whole-genome DNA methylation, linking hypermethylation at ETS1 sites to an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment and metastatic risk.
Pooled observational case-control analysis (5386 cases/6798 controls) measures CpG island methylator phenotype status and relates it to physical activity, a modifiable exposure.
Study measures gene expression of RNA m5C regulators (writers/erasers/readers) in adipose tissue, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.
Mendelian randomization/machine-learning analysis of IBD draws on summary-level GWAS data (Fenland, FinnGen, Pan-UKB, IIBDGC) with no individual-level data analysed.
Biological age of heart/liver/kidney is calculated by the Klemera-Doubal method from dietary and clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
NRF2-TAGLN mechanism is studied entirely in ovarian cancer cell lines with no human participant or human-derived sample.
Training and validation urine sample sets directly measure Vimentin/POU4F2 methylation by RT-PCR for non-invasive bladder carcinoma diagnosis.
Case-control study of 150 cancer patients versus 150 controls directly measures global 5-methylcytosine DNA methylation by ELISA alongside piRNA levels, so ncRNA is not the only marker measured.
Fourteen dystonia cases with unresolved variants were selected from a larger cohort for long-read sequencing with no stated comparison group, a case series.
This is a clinical practice guideline built on systematic reviews of randomised controlled trials, not a primary study itself.
Cohort comparing WTC-exposed and unexposed women profiles blood DNA methylation with four epigenetic clocks to test association with WTC environmental exposure.

The abstract references molecular ependymoma subgroups (EPN-PFA/PFB/ZFTA/YAP1) without stating that DNA methylation profiling, rather than another platform, was the measurement used to define them in this cohort.
CHAMACOS cohort repeatedly measures DNA methylation from birth to age 18 to derive cumulative epigenetic aging and its prospective association with cardiometabolic health.
Cross-sectional MIDUS study measures DunedinPACE and GrimAge2 DNA methylation clocks and relates them to relationship-stress domains.
Case-control FTD cohort (27 carriers, 250 non-carriers) performs genome-wide DNA methylation analysis to build and validate a diagnostic predictor of C9orf72 repeat expansion.
Longitudinal cohort of 216 people with HIV measures blood DNA methylation across eight epigenetic clocks and tests prognostic association with AIDS, SNAEs, and mortality.
PhenoAge-accel is explicitly defined here from immune/inflammatory clinical markers compared to chronological age, not from DNA methylation.
The abstract reports sensitivity/specificity for a 56-sample ovarian cancer cohort without stating what comparison group, if any, the ROC analysis was performed against.
Cohort of adult IBD patients and controls, replicated in two independent cohorts, measures blood DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and disease-progression-associated CpGs.
Citrullinated histone H3-DNA (CitH3-DNA) complexes are quantified by ELISA as a circulating NETosis marker, explicitly a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Histone H4 is measured as a circulating serum/urine protein biomarker by ELISA, not as a chromatin modification.

Two-sample Mendelian randomization across GWAS/eQTL summary statistics identifies ageing-related genes, validated only in mouse experiments, with no individual-level human data analysed.
A case-control study validates the bisulfite-free dRE-STEM cfDNA methylation method against CRC-specific loci in human plasma samples for diagnostic screening.
MGMT inhibition and gamma-H2AX induction are demonstrated in glioblastoma cell culture and a patient-derived xenograft mouse model, with no human participant measurement.
Biological age is derived from clinical measures via the Klemera-Doubal method and Mahalanobis distance, not DNA methylation.
Multicentre AIN3 cohort followed for 3+ years directly measures ZNF582/ASCL1 methylation on anal smears to predict progression to anal cancer.
Multicentre prospective study directly measures aberrant DNA methylation (HIST1H4F, NRN1, POU4F2) in urine alongside mutations to diagnose urothelial carcinoma.
Cross-sectional MIDUS study relates neighborhood opportunity, a modifiable social exposure, to three DNA methylation-based epigenetic clock measures.
Study genotypes IDH1/IDH2 mutations in AML patients; the resulting histone/DNA hypermethylation is discussed but not itself measured.

Health and Retirement Study cohort develops a DNA methylation surrogate biomarker for chronic inflammation and validates its prognostic value for mortality and multimorbidity.
Cross-sectional case-control study of 58 JIA patients versus 35 controls directly measures 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine levels as diagnostic biomarkers.
Longitudinal single-arm study of 122 healthy adults measures SLC6A4 promoter methylation before and after an acute stress test, correlated with cortisol reactivity.
Case-control study genotypes TRDMT1 polymorphisms by TaqMan assay, a genetic association study that does not directly measure any epigenetic mark.
Reference cohort of 2540 samples plus retrospective and real-time validation cohorts uses genome-wide DNA methylation profiling to classify acute leukemia diagnostically.
Longitudinal bone-density study of childhood gymnastics participation measures pQCT bone parameters, with no epigenetic marker.

H3Cit-DNA complexes are measured in plasma as a NET biomarker of neutrophil activation, a circulating protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.

Nrf2 promoter methylation by bisulfite sequencing appears to have been assessed only in CSE-treated bronchial epithelial cells in vitro; human tissue analysis was limited to protein levels by Western blot.
Retrospective cohort of 62 endometrial neoplasia patients treated with MPA performs DNA methylation microarray analysis to identify methylomic subtypes predicting treatment efficacy.
Biological aging acceleration is assessed via Klemera-Doubal and PhenoAge algorithms based on clinical measures, not DNA methylation, in this kidney stone cohort.
Case-control comparison of 16 children across obesity/birth-weight groups performs an epigenome-wide association study directly measuring global DNA methylation.
Retrospective imaging review of 8 pediatric H3K27M/BRAF V600E co-mutated midline glioma cases has no stated comparison group, a case series.

GUSTO cohort measures a smoking-associated DNA methylation risk score in umbilical cord tissue and relates it to offspring caries experience.
Twin study (310 discovery, 777 replication) measures eight DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and methylation-based telomere length, relating them to incident fracture and osteoporosis.

Longitudinal cohort testing whether DNAm epigenetic clocks (Skin&Blood, PhenoAge, GrimAge/GrimAge2) mediate work-stress effects on burnout and depressive symptoms.

Case-control study directly measuring LEP/LEPR/ADIPOQ promoter methylation and linking it to the metabolically-healthy-obesity phenotype.

Retrospective case series of 42 MEITL cases characterized by IHC/EBV-ISH/NGS with no comparison group.
Case series of corneal patch graft outcomes; no epigenetic marker of any kind is measured.

Prospective EWAS comparing peripheral-blood DNA methylation between aSAH patients and matched controls, identifying disease-associated DMPs.
Citrullinated histone H3 content in coronary thrombi is used as a NET/inflammation marker, not a direct chromatin-state measurement.
Post hoc analysis of the PRESMET trial cohort measuring CD4+ T-cell DNA methylation (RRBS) that differentiates ischaemic from non-ischaemic HFrEF.

H3K27 benzoylation is measured by Cut&Tag only in the MIA mouse model/astrocytes; the human ASD cohort data cited are behavioral/microbiota, with no epigenetic marker measured in humans.

Summary-data-based Mendelian randomization using GWAS/mQTL summary statistics, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Cross-sectional screening study measuring FMR1 promoter methylation (MS-MLPA) in ASD boys and correlating full-mutation methylation status with clinical presentation.

Retrospective series of 8 urothelial carcinoma cases with myxoid/chordoid features, with no comparison group.

Genome-wide cfDNA methylation signature discovered and validated (tissue, TCGA, plasma) to differentiate triple-negative from other breast cancer subtypes.

Case series of 9 patients with H3F3B-mutant DMG characterized by methylation profiling and H3K27me3 IHC, without a concurrently enrolled comparison group.
m6A is an RNA modification (epitranscriptomic mark), not one of the eligible DNA methylation/histone/chromatin/epigenetic-clock markers.
Case-control study measuring cfDNA methylation of four genes (PTGER4, RASSF1A, SHOX2, H4C6) for lung cancer detection.

Clinical trial comparison of AML consolidation chemotherapy regimens; no epigenetic marker is measured.
cg05575921 (AHRR) DNA methylation is measured by ddPCR in an elderly cohort and linked to smoking exposure and cardiovascular disease risk prediction.
Anti-histone-2B IgA autoantibodies are an immunoassay biomarker, not a measurement of histone modification or chromatin state.
Serum neurofilament light chain and MECP2 genetic variant type are assessed; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured.
Bidirectional Mendelian randomization using GWAS summary statistics for gut microbiota and myopia, with no individual-level epigenetic measurement.

Summary-data-based Mendelian randomization integrating mQTL/eQTL/pQTL summary statistics for coronary artery disease.
