Multiple DNAm-based epigenetic clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge) are measured in the Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging and linked to sleep duration.
A machine-learning classifier for methylation disorders is built and validated on genome-wide methylation from blood of patients with PWS, Angelman and related syndromes versus healthy controls.
DKK1 promoter methylation is measured by targeted bisulfite sequencing in a case-control comparison of ankylosing spondylitis patients and healthy controls.
This is an explicit single-patient case report of an ectopic pituitary adenoma with methylation profiling for diagnosis.
Plasma cell-free DNA methylation at cancer-associated markers is compared between pregnant and control women in a case-control study assessing false-positive liquid biopsy signals.
A 200-CpG methylation classifier (MFCUP) for tissue-of-origin is trained on TCGA methylation data and validated across multiple independent cohorts and an FFPE sequencing panel.
DNA methylation testing is mentioned only as one diagnostic step performed during repeat glioma surgery; no methylation result or association is analyzed.

Lymphocyte gamma-H2AX (a histone modification, per the instrument's guidance regardless of its DNA-damage interpretation) and micronucleus frequency are compared between isoflurane-exposed and unexposed veterinarians.
DNA and RNA methylation patterns in HCC tumor samples are compared by ethnoracial status and locoregional therapy response.
PCDHGB7 methylation (CerMe) is measured in cervical samples and evaluated prospectively as a triage test for hrHPV-positive women.
The DMRRS signature is built from expression of DNA-methylation-regulator genes across LUAD cohorts, not from measured methylation levels themselves.
Cell-free DNA methylation (Sentinel-MPE) in pleural fluid is measured in a blinded prospective case-control study distinguishing malignant from benign pleural effusion.
TCGA-HNSC DNA methylation patterns define immunophenotype clusters and an IPMS score validated for predicting immunotherapy benefit.
The chromatin-regulator signature is derived from TCGA expression of chromatin-regulator genes, not from a measured chromatin-state assay.
RB1 gene methylation (MS-MLPA) is measured in sarcoma patients' leukocytes before and after anthracycline-based chemotherapy.
An EWAS of lifetime cannabis use disorder in a PTSD-enriched veteran cohort identifies several methylation sites associated with CUD.
The 'DNA methylation-based aging clock' here is a polygenic risk score computed from genotype, not an actually measured methylation profile.
DunedinPACE and other DNAm epigenetic clocks are measured across three cohorts and associated with structural brain MRI phenotypes.
Whole-genome DNA methylation is profiled in a novel phyllodes tumour cohort and used to derive a malignancy-discriminating classifier.
SWI/SNF and DNA-repair gene mutation frequencies by race are analyzed from a clinical sequencing database; no chromatin or methylation assay is performed.
BAG3 methylation's prognostic value is analyzed via the GSCA webtool, but the abstract does not specify whether this constitutes an individual-level methylation analysis or a summary-level lookup.
Blood DNA methylation EWAS distinguishes suicide-attempt history from non-attempt in bipolar disorder patients across discovery and replication cohorts.
A quantile mediation method is demonstrated on real birth-cohort data examining DNA methylation as mediator between maternal smoking and offspring birthweight.
H3K4 methylation dependence is shown mechanistically in TNBC cell lines; the n=360 patient cohort data are used only for EMSY expression and survival, not H3K4 methylation.
The 'gAge' clock is built entirely from gut microbiota composition data, not from any epigenetic marker.
DNA methylation-derived EpiScores for circulating proteins are tested for association with incident cardiovascular disease in the Generation Scotland cohort.
5-hydroxymethylcytosine, a DNA modification, is measured by immunohistochemistry across a cohort of 318 thyroid tumors and correlated with clinicopathologic and mutation features.
Citrullinated histone H3 is measured in bronchoalveolar lavage as a NET biomarker, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Chromatin clearing/margination are cytomorphologic features scored by light microscopy in thyroid FNA, not a molecular epigenetic assay.
Blood FOLR3 methylation is measured by mass spectrometry across two large independent case-control validation cohorts for early NSCLC detection.
Predictive models use clinical, ultrasonographic and cytopathologic variables including 'pale chromatin' as a morphologic descriptor, not a molecular epigenetic marker.
Serum NETs are quantified via histone-DNA and neutrophil-elastase-DNA complexes, a circulating protein assay excluded per the instrument's histone-NET guidance.
Five DNAm-based epigenetic aging measures (GrimAge, PhenoAge, DunedinPACE, etc.) are related to diet quality and body size longitudinally in the Melbourne Collaborative Cohort Study.
DNA methylation profiling classifies 2023 ependymomas into molecular subtypes with correlated progression-free survival outcomes.
Growth trajectories in Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome children are compared by imprinting methylation subtype (IC2-LOM vs pUPD).
Whole genome sequencing identifies SNPs associated with IVIG response in Kawasaki disease; no epigenetic marker is measured.
In the 54-patient clinical validation, BTG1 expression by RT-qPCR (not its methylation status) predicts decitabine response; methylation was shown only in vitro.
A targeted NGS methylation panel (MethScore) is built and tested in training/testing AML cohorts for overall survival prognostication.
Genome-wide DNA methylation episignature testing (EpiSign) diagnostic yield is reported across 2399 clinical referral cases.
Biological age here (KDM-BA, phenotypic age, homeostatic dysregulation) is computed from NHANES clinical biomarkers, with no DNA methylation mentioned.
Genome-wide leukocyte DNA methylation (EPIC 850K) is measured before/after a supervised resistance or aerobic exercise program in women with PCOS.
CpG methylation sites within the ABO gene from public AML methylation data are correlated with survival in patients with decreased ABO expression.
DNA methylation subclass is used alongside CDKN2A/B deletion to stratify overall survival in a cohort of IDH-mutant astrocytomas.
This is a purely biochemical/cellular high-throughput screening platform paper characterizing EZH2 inhibitor binding kinetics, with no human participant cohort.
Five HDAC-related microRNAs are the only epigenetic markers measured in RA patients versus controls; HDAC level itself is an enzyme assay, not a chromatin-state measurement.
A prospective cohort plus genome-wide methylation analysis links smoking-associated DNA methylation (DNMT3A, AHRR, LTA/TNF loci) to Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis risk.
PhenoAgeAccel is derived from 9 blood chemistry biomarkers in NHANES, not from DNA methylation.
DNA methylation profiling (DKFZ classifier) is compared against histopathological diagnosis to reclassify hemispheric pilocytic astrocytomas.
A Pediatric-Buccal-Epigenetic DNAm clock is measured in children and examined for association with cumulative social adversity.
This is development and validation of a patient-reported outcome questionnaire (Prurigo Control Test) with no biological marker of any kind.
DNA methylation-based CNS tumor classification scores are correlated with time to treatment decision and survival in a retrospective cohort of 1481 patients.
SDC2/NDRG4 fecal DNA methylation is evaluated as a diagnostic marker for colorectal cancer and advanced adenoma in a multicenter clinical trial.
A next-generation multi-target stool DNA methylation panel is validated for colorectal cancer and precancerous lesion screening in case-control studies.
This validates the IberScore cardiovascular risk model against 'vascular age' from traditional risk factors, with no epigenetic marker measured.
MGMT promoter methylation is used only as a trial eligibility/population descriptor; the study analyzes radiological progression patterns after cilengitide, not methylation itself.
H3K4me3 at the PFDN5 promoter is validated by ChIP in CRC cell lines; the 72-patient cohort measures only KDM5C/PFDN5 expression, not methylation status.
Cross-sectional analysis directly measures five DNAm-based epigenetic aging clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) and links them to diet quality, a modifiable exposure.
Study measures placental gene expression by RNA sequencing, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state, despite discussing a histone methyltransferase gene.
Frailty-microvascular disease cohort analysis measures clinical frailty phenotype and retinal capillary density; no epigenetic marker is measured at all.
Longitudinal physical-activity intervention study directly measures promoter-specific DNA methylation of SOD2 and L3MBTL1 in breast cancer patients, linking it to a modifiable exercise intervention.
Abstract references 8 combined 'biological ages' from the SATSA twin study without stating whether any of them is a DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clock.
DNA-methylation-defined molecular classes of 139 human spinal ependymomas serve as the reference standard for a histology-based diagnostic classifier, a diagnostic comparison series.
Pyrosequencing directly measures MGMT promoter methylation at multiple cut-offs in a retrospective cohort of 78 glioblastoma patients, linked to treatment response and survival.
Tumor-derived DNA from a cohort study is screened for MLH1 promoter methylation/CIMP status, which is associated with MMR-deficiency subtyping relevant to Lynch-syndrome diagnosis.
A targeted plasma cfDNA methylation assay is directly measured and validated across independent clinical cohorts for noninvasive detection/monitoring of neuroendocrine prostate cancer.
Phase 1 KRAS-vaccine trial reports T-cell responses and ctDNA/tumor-antigen biomarkers; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Pediatric stroke transport-protocol study reports Glasgow Coma Scale and LVO clinical scores only; no epigenetic marker is measured.
BPDCN diagnostic series reports frequencies of genomic mutation subtypes, including genes in the DNA-methylation pathway, but does not directly measure methylation itself.
An epigenome-wide association study directly measures blood DNA methylation in a case-control design relating a history of perinatal asphyxia to schizophrenia/bipolar disorder risk.
Cross-sectional NSCH analysis of childhood obesity and social determinants of health measures no epigenetic marker.
Retrospective cohort of CRC patients directly measures MLH1 promoter methylation via reflex testing to guide genetic-counseling referral decisions for Lynch syndrome.
Cohort study directly measures LINE-1 global DNA methylation and MGMT promoter methylation in IDH-mutant astrocytoma tissue, linked to grade and prognosis.
Whole-exome sequencing and microarray study of germline cancer-predisposition variants measures genetic mutations, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.
Methylation-specific PCR directly measures Septin9 promoter methylation in breast tumor tissue from a retrospective series, linked to recurrence/metastasis prognosis.
DNA methylation array profiling of 42 pediatric MPNST/MPNST-like tumors is directly measured and used to reach an integrated diagnostic classification.
Bisulfite pyrosequencing directly measures cord-blood methylation of serotonin-regulating genes (SLC6A4, MAOA, HTR2A), linked to modifiable maternal metabolic exposures (pBMI, GWG, GDM).

Citrullinated histone is assessed by immunohistochemistry in plaque tissue as a NET/inflammation marker, matching the instrument's explicit protein-assay exclusion for citrullinated H3 rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Nested case-control study directly measures a 13-gene DNA methylation panel from oral brushings used for periodic surveillance monitoring after oral cancer surgery.
MGMT-unmethylated status is only a fixed cohort inclusion criterion here; the predictor actually analyzed against survival is cognitive test performance, not the methylation marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation array data directly measured in 385 IDH-mutant astrocytomas is used for a methylation-based prognostic subclassification.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR directly measures ASCL1/ZNF582 methylation in a cross-sectional series of anal biopsies to determine diagnostic performance for HGAIN and anal cancer.
Longitudinal cohort directly measures blood DNAm aging from adolescence to adulthood, linked to childhood mental-health symptoms and substance-use exposures.
Randomized physiotherapy trial on premature aging measures relative telomere size and metabolic/inflammatory markers, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.

A multi-cohort GWAS meta-analysis draws CpG methylation (ASM-QTL) associations from summary statistics rather than analyzing individual-level methylation data, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Women's Health Initiative cohort directly measures whole-blood 450K DNAm-based epigenetic aging (GrimAge, DNAmTL) linked to stressful-life-event exposure burden.
ARID1A loss is assessed via mutation, copy-number deletion, and immunohistochemical protein expression, not by a directly measured DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state mark.
A tumor methylation score from methylated ctDNA is directly and repeatedly measured in HCC patients over time to monitor treatment burden and detect recurrence.
Case-control and prospective follow-up study directly measures BNIP3/DAPK1 promoter methylation in peripheral leukocytes for gastric-cancer detection, chemotherapy response and prognosis.
Randomized dietary-intervention trial (Obekit) directly measures EPIC-array DNA methylation at baseline to predict percentage weight loss on two hypocaloric diets.
Epigenome-wide association study directly measures DNA methylation differences between T2DM cases and normoglycemic controls in the KoGES cohort, identifying candidate diabetes biomarkers.
Case-control study directly measures Alu DNA methylation patterns (COBRA) in peripheral blood of type 1 diabetes patients versus healthy controls.
Strong Heart Study cohort directly measures DNAm-based epigenetic aging (PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) mediating the association of arsenic exposure with CVD and mortality risk.
Retrospective periacetabular osteotomy outcomes study measures patient-reported joint function and satisfaction scores; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Nested case-control study within a randomized trial directly measures HPV genome methylation (S5 classifier) jointly with serum folate to stratify CIN3+ risk.
Case-control study directly measures RUNX1 promoter methylation to differentiate papillary thyroid cancer from benign thyroid nodules, an explicit diagnostic application.
TCGA and GEO methylome data are directly analyzed in HNSCC/OSCC patients to build a 16-CpG senescence-related prognostic signature to guide treatment strategy.
Genomic DNAm episignature is directly measured in 18 individuals with USP7 variants and used as a diagnostic biomarker to reclassify variants of uncertain significance.
Study cohort consists of client-owned dogs with multicentric high-grade B-cell lymphoma, not human participants.
National Cancer Database cohort directly reports MGMT promoter methylation status, linked to overall survival and treatment stratification in IDH-wildtype/mutant gliomas.
Exome-sequencing study of de novo variants underlying syndromic intellectual disability measures genetic mutations, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.

Core findings derive from a mouse model of radiation-induced thrombocytopenia; the human megakaryocyte cell line is only used for supplementary in vitro mechanistic confirmation, not an epidemiological design on the eligible list.

Case-control study of acute kidney injury measures methylation-related metabolites (choline, SAM, SAH, betaine, TMAO) in plasma/urine, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state itself.
Birth-cohort study directly measures sperm DNA methylation (reduced representation bisulfite sequencing) linking paternal air-pollution exposure to offspring birth outcomes.
This is an explicit study protocol for a planned two-armed RCT of yoga on biological age; no primary data are yet reported.
Randomized folic-acid supplementation trial directly measures 450K DNA methylation array data and epigenetic clocks (AgeAccel) in healthy male volunteers.

Targeted bisulfite sequencing directly measures cord-blood methylation differences between LGA and AGA newborns, but the study only describes these biological differences without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure, intervention, or a stated clinical/public-health decision.

This is a small case series of two families (plus a literature-pooled proband review) with HPS6 variants; the CpG-island overlap with variants is a structural bioinformatic observation, not a design-based methylation measurement.

Longitudinal epigenome-wide association study directly measures blood DNAm changes at HDAC4/MARK3 associated with treatment response after medication-withdrawal treatment in chronic migraine patients.
The circ-YAP/m6A mechanism for CRC liver metastasis is established through in vitro assays and a PDX/xenograft animal model, not through one of the five eligible human epidemiological designs.
Prospective screening cohort of 3000 participants directly measures blood Septin9/SRSF1/PAX8 gene methylation for early colorectal cancer screening.
Study measures SUV420H1 protein expression by immunohistochemistry as a prognostic factor in HCC, not the H4K20 histone methylation mark that the enzyme deposits.
KDMAge and PhenoAge here are explicitly calculated from clinical chemistry biomarkers, not from DNA methylation.

Prospective genomic profiling of 459 IDH-wildtype glioblastomas directly measures DNA methylation, classifying a distinct replication-repair-deficient subtype relevant to immune checkpoint blockade treatment.
TCGA cohort correlates DNA methylation with genetic ancestry to build a machine-learning ancestry classifier, without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical decision.

Multi-database cohort analysis attributes KLF3 silencing to CpG-island methylation and links this epigenetic mechanism to prognosis and therapeutic drug sensitivity in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
TCGA-based analysis includes direct DNA methylation profiling of SLC7A11 (MethSurv) associated with breast-cancer subtype and patient outcome, alongside expression/copy-number data.
Two-sample and summary-data-based Mendelian randomization draws methylation-BMD associations from GWAS summary statistics, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Case-control study directly measures human sperm DNA methylation array data comparing COVID-19-infected and healthy semen donors.
Case-control study directly measures PRLHR promoter methylation in hippocampal tissue and plasma cfDNA of Alzheimer's patients as a candidate liquid-biopsy diagnostic biomarker.
A hierarchical classifier is developed and validated using individual-level methylation array data from thousands of human tumor samples across 30 cancer types, a diagnostic-accuracy application.
DNA methylation profiling is directly measured and clustered in a cohort of human diffuse midline glioma tumors, defining a new diagnostic/prognostic subtype relevant to trial interpretation.
Case-control study directly measures CD70 gene methylation in T-cell DNA comparing systemic lupus erythematosus patients and population controls.
Nested case-control study directly measures a methylation risk score from four CpG loci associated with incident type 2 diabetes risk.
Framingham Heart Study cohort directly measures DNA methylation, among other omics layers, associated with coronary artery calcification and myocardial infarction risk.
Case-control study directly measures urinary cell-free DNA methylation markers developed and validated for hepatocellular carcinoma screening.
UK Biobank phenotypic-age study computes biological age from nine clinical chemistry biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Spatial transcriptomic profiling of tumor-associated endothelial cells in TNBC measures gene expression, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.
Radiogenomic study directly incorporates DNA-methylation-seq data from glioblastoma patients into a prognostic overall-survival risk-stratification nomogram.

RNA-seq/ATAC-seq discovery in a handful of iCCA tumors identifies a PLK1/MISP mechanism, but the marker linked to clinicopathological outcome in the larger 91-patient cohort is protein expression, not a directly measured chromatin-state variable.

This study compares 16 normalisation methods for a BMI EpiScore and Horvath's clock across two birth cohorts, a purely technical/methodological analysis without linking methylation to a modifiable exposure or explicit clinical decision.
Cross-sectional whole-blood DNA methylation comparison directly measures epigenetic age acceleration in the Yakutian population versus Central Russia, related to subarctic climate adaptation.

Analysis of offspring from an RCT directly measures genome-wide DNA methylation in placenta, cord blood, and buccal cells comparing CAPA-IVM versus conventional IVF, a modifiable fertility-treatment choice.
Nested case-control study directly measures AHRR/F2RL3 blood methylation linked to modifiable smoking and occupational exposures.
This is an explicit prospective study protocol (MeD-Seq Rectal) describing planned DNA-methylation liquid-biopsy work to predict chemoradiation response; no primary data are yet reported.
KDM-BA and physiological dysregulation aging measures are derived from clinical biomarkers in this napping/cognition study, not DNA methylation.
PRISM cohort directly measures placental DNA methylation array data to infer cell-type composition associated with gestational ambient PM2.5 air-pollution exposure.
Case-control study directly measures HYAL1 promoter methylation in FFPE thyroid tissue to differentiate malignant papillary thyroid cancer from benign nodules.
Prospective cohort directly measures principal-component-based DNAm epigenetic-age clocks in spinal-deformity surgery patients for preoperative frailty/surgical risk assessment.
Case-control study directly measures placental/plasma DNA methylation and nucleosome positioning patterns to build and validate a diagnostic model for early-onset preeclampsia.
Phase Ib trial of HDAC-inhibitor entinostat plus pembrolizumab reports clinical response and immune-cell (MDSC) outcomes without directly measuring histone acetylation or another epigenetic mark.
Sperm chromatin dispersion test measures DNA fragmentation and oxidative stress, which the instrument explicitly treats as strand-breakage/packaging, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
This is a single-patient case report of pseudohypoparathyroidism type Ib, even though GNAS methylation was measured diagnostically in that one patient.
ALSPAC cohort directly measures cord-blood DNA methylation patterns co-varying with maternal risk profiles, prospectively linked to childhood cardiometabolic/neurocognitive risk.
This is a single-patient case report of long-term decitabine/ATRA maintenance therapy in an elderly AML patient.
TCGA-UCEC cohort directly analyzes individual-level DNA methylation data at specific CpG sites to build a prognostic risk model for endometrial cancer.
Strong Heart Study prospective cohort directly measures blood DNA methylation (850K array) associated with liver-cancer mortality risk in American Indians.
Case-control study directly measures RB1 promoter methylation by real-time PCR in retinoblastoma patients versus healthy controls to test a hereditary-transmission risk mechanism.
Prospective cohort directly measures blood DNA methylation (Illumina BeadChip) comparing current, former, and never smokers with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
Retrospective/prospective case series directly measures H3K27me3 histone-mark loss by immunohistochemistry in sarcomatoid carcinomas as a differential-diagnosis pitfall for MPNST.
Cross-sectional comparative study directly measures differential DNA methylation in peripheral immune cells across ACPA-positive at-risk, ACPA-negative, and early rheumatoid arthritis groups.
NHANES cross-sectional study computes biological aging (homeostatic dysregulation, KDM, phenotypic age, allostatic load) from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Two independent birth cohorts directly measure neonatal DNA methylation (EPIC array) associated with maternal PCOS/hirsutism and preconception testosterone exposure.
Case-control study directly measures blood CD4+ T-cell DNA methylation (RRBS) with ROC-based diagnostic performance reported for atrial fibrillation.
Case-control study directly measures cfDNA 5-hydroxymethylcytosine, a DNA modification mark, in a machine-learning diagnostic model for early lung-cancer detection.
Cross-sectional St Jude Lifetime Cohort study directly measures DNAm-based epigenetic age acceleration associated with deficit accumulation in childhood-cancer survivors.
PhenoAge here is explicitly derived from clinical traits rather than DNA methylation, so no epigenetic marker is measured in this sleep/aging Mendelian randomization study.
Cross-sectional case-control study measuring genome-wide DNA methylation in blood of PCOS patients vs controls and using it to build a diagnostic model.
Methylation-sensitive digital PCR assay validated for diagnosing symptomatic coronary heart disease across two additional human cohorts totaling 449 cases and 2067 controls.
Explicitly a study protocol for a planned crossover RCT of mindfulness/compassion training, with no results reported yet.
Longitudinal cohort of 214 veterans in which GrimAge DNA methylation acceleration prospectively predicted neuropathology biomarkers and cognition, informing dementia risk assessment.
Develops a DNA-methylation-based silencing index in ccRCC and validates it against outcomes in the BIONIKK trial's individual-level patient data to predict immunotherapy resistance.

This is a cohort-profile paper mixing completed and future analyses; the DNA methylation-depression finding is mentioned without any design or effect-size detail to confirm it is a focused primary analysis.
Retrospective study of aeromedical enteral feeding practices with no epigenetic marker of any kind measured.
Mendelian randomization drawing telomere length and epigenetic clock associations entirely from GWAS summary statistics, with no individual-level participant data analyzed.

Micronuclei, chromatin bridging, nuclear budding and multipolar mitosis are morphological chromosomal-instability counts on cytology smears, not a molecular chromatin-state or methylation measurement.
Bibliometric and altmetric analysis of the 100 most-cited articles on tobacco smoke and children's health, not a primary epigenetic study.
Case-control study measuring whole-blood androgen-receptor promoter methylation as a mediator between organochlorine pesticide exposure and type 2 diabetes risk.
Prospective observational cohort comparing the WID-qEC DNA methylation test against ultrasound for detecting uterine cancer in women with abnormal bleeding.
Reports a descriptive series of 22 molecularly characterized mismatch-repair-deficient ovarian cancers (some via MLH1 promoter methylation) with no comparator group, functioning as a case series.
Cohort study measuring bisulfite-pyrosequencing methylation of the BDNF promoter in relation to three-year average PM2.5 and ozone exposure.
Analyzes mRNA expression of chromatin-regulator genes from TCGA/GEO to build a prognostic gene signature, without directly measuring DNA methylation, histone marks, or chromatin state.
Diagnostic accuracy study of a neural-network model (DeepTrace) applied to plasma cfDNA methylation sequencing for early hepatocellular carcinoma detection in 130 individuals.

ATAC-seq and ChIP-seq chromatin measurements were performed in mouse embryonic fibroblasts and a breast cancer cell line; the human TNBC cohort was analyzed only for gene expression correlation, not for the epigenetic marker itself.

A statistical methods comparison paper for high-dimensional mediation analysis, using simulations and an existing DNAm dataset to benchmark analytic approaches rather than testing a specific epidemiological design.

Bioinformatic analysis of TCGA/CGGA RNA expression of m5C regulator genes in glioma; RNA m5C modification and gene expression are not among the eligible DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin markers.

Histone hypermethylation from glucose deprivation was characterized in lung adenocarcinoma cell models; the human LUAD cohort analysis only correlates a HIF1a-dependent expression signature with prognosis, not the histone mark itself.
Paired pre/post blood DNAm array analysis in 125 breast cancer patients, validated in a further 1273 treated vs 872 untreated patients, linking chemotherapy exposure to methylation change.
Prospective cohort epigenome-wide association study of cervical CpG methylation predicting time-to-progression to CIN2+, informing risk-based screening.
A cohort-profile paper stating that epigenetic clock and telomere biomarker work in this cohort is 'underway' as future plans, with no epigenetic results yet reported.
Builds and validates a DNA-methylation-based three-class risk-stratification system in the largest medullary thyroid carcinoma methylation cohort assembled to date (78 samples).
Cross-sectional study of breast tumor DNA methylation and gene expression by neighborhood deprivation and race in 185 women.
Analysis of Gleason grade upstaging after prostatectomy with no epigenetic marker measured.
Case-control study (196 CHD cases vs 184 controls) measuring peripheral-blood ITGB2 methylation by mass spectrometry as a candidate CHD biomarker.
Five combined case-control datasets (1812 psychosis cases vs 1753 controls) measuring the DunedinPACE DNA methylation clock to test accelerated aging in schizophrenia.
Uses epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization built on GWAS-on-facial-aging and EWAS summary statistics rather than individual-level participant data.
Develops a sperm DNA double-strand-break assay (SDFR); sperm chromatin/DNA fragmentation tests measure strand breakage rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
PhenoAgeAccel here is derived from clinical chemistry biomarkers in NHANES; the abstract contains no mention of DNA methylation or any other epigenetic assay.
Training (n=244) and validation (n=199) cohorts developing a six-marker plasma DNA methylation panel for early detection of esophageal, gastric, and colorectal cancer.
A study protocol for a planned double-blind RCT of anti-aging supplements measuring proBNPage progression; no results are yet reported and proBNPage is not an epigenetic marker.
Targeted panel sequencing of pathogenic mutations (PIK3CA, KMT2C, TP53, TERT) in anal squamous cell carcinoma; no DNA methylation, histone mark, or chromatin state was measured.
Uses MethylMix on individual-level TCGA methylation/mRNA data plus an independent GSE17538 validation cohort to build a methylation-driven-gene survival signature for colon cancer.

Measures circulating citrullinated histone H3 (H3Cit) in plasma alongside cytokines in a cancer-cachexia case-control study; a plasma histone protein biomarker is a protein assay, not a chromatin-state measurement.
Retrospective thyroid cytology study describing 'pale chromatin' as a morphological cytological feature, not a molecular epigenetic marker.

In this bladder cancer case-control study the only marker directly measured in human tissue is miR-124-3p, a non-coding RNA; DNMT3B was assessed as mRNA expression rather than as a methylation measurement.

This study centers on SS18-SSX immunohistochemistry and fusion-transcript sequencing for synovial sarcoma diagnosis; DNA methylation profiling is used only as a confirmatory check in two cases, not as the studied marker.
Prospective longitudinal cohort (Project RESCUE) measuring buccal-swab EPIC DNA methylation in neonates exposed in utero to the COVID-19 pandemic versus pre-pandemic neonates.

A technical validation study testing whether heparin blood-collection tubes are compatible with the 5hmC-Seal assay, using matched samples purely to check technical concordance rather than to test a disease association.
Cross-sectional NHANES analysis relating HOMA-IR to biological age with no mention of DNA methylation or any epigenetic assay.

Whole exome and whole genome sequencing of urinary cfDNA in South African prostate cancer patients identifies somatic and germline mutations only; no DNA methylation was assayed in this study despite methylation being mentioned as a general biomarker category.
Case-control study of the MTHFR C677T germline genetic polymorphism as an endometriosis risk factor; DNA methylation is only invoked speculatively in the discussion, not measured.
Aptamer-based serum proteomics (SOMAscan) in glioblastoma patients treated with the HDAC inhibitor valproic acid; downstream protein expression was measured, not histone acetylation itself.
Single-cell and spatial genomic profiling of gastric intestinal metaplasia identifies ARID1A as a driver gene by mutation status, not by measuring chromatin state or DNA methylation directly.
US-wide cohort of Black and white women measuring DNA methylation epigenetic aging clocks and CpG sites in relation to residential PM2.5, PM10, and NO2 exposure.
Retrospective cohort of 241 glioblastoma patients relating metformin use and survival to tumor MGMT promoter methylation status.
Adult T-ALL trial cohort (GRAALL) with DNA methylation and H3K27me3 ChIP-seq profiling of patient samples linked to response to 5-azacitidine/venetoclax treatment.
AML trial cohort (AMLSG 12-09, n=155) with genome-wide pretreatment DNA methylation profiling used to build a classifier predicting response to azacytidine induction.
Registry study of clinical practice guideline compliance in acute appendicitis surgery with no epigenetic marker involved.
Cross-sectional analysis of 469 TILDA participants measuring the GrimAge DNA methylation clock in relation to metabolic syndrome status.
Retrospective series of 219 primary CNS tumors comparing whole-genome DNA methylation diagnostic classification against RNAseq-detected gene fusions.
Multicenter cohort of 107 ICB-treated urothelial carcinoma patients comparing PD-L1 promoter methylation (qMSP) against IHC protein expression for predicting treatment response.
Before-after implementation study of a urinary tract infection antibiotic guideline with no epigenetic marker measured.
Case-control-style EPIC array DNA methylation profiling of 25 Fanconi anemia patients versus healthy and other-genetic-disorder controls to derive a diagnostic episignature.
Case series describing histologic and SS18::SSX fusion features of biphasic synovial sarcoma with myoepithelial differentiation; no epigenetic marker measured.
Diagnostic and case-control screening study (including UKFOCSS nested samples) measuring targeted-bisulfite-sequencing cfDNA methylation at ZNF154/C2CD4D/WNT6 for ovarian cancer detection.
Epigenome-wide association study of blood DNA methylation across three European cohorts in relation to B-vitamin intake biomarkers.
231 children with ADHD had genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC array) assessed in blood in relation to maternal smoking during pregnancy.
Electron and light microscopy study describing 'chromatin amount and uniformity' as a morphological ultrastructural feature of breast cancer cells, not a molecular epigenetic assay.
British 1946 birth cohort (n=498) relating four DNA methylation age-acceleration clocks to ECG-based cardiac age scores and cardiometabolic risk factors.
Validates 990 candidate hypermethylated DNA regions by targeted bisulfite sequencing in 59 precancerous colorectal lesions with matched normal mucosa, aiming at a noninvasive screening assay.
Cross-sectional survey of therapists' barriers to implementing lymphedema clinical practice guidelines; no epigenetic marker involved.
Compares HOXB13 gene-body CpG methylation alongside protein/mRNA expression across localized, metastatic, and neuroendocrine human prostate cancer groups, supporting HOXB13 as a diagnostic biomarker.
Whole-exome, RNA, and DNA-methylation sequencing of 22 matched IDC-P/PAC prostate tumor pairs, with survival analysis extended to a 505-patient validation cohort.
Cross-sectional community sample (n=118) measuring the DunedinPACE DNA methylation pace-of-aging biomarker from blood leukocytes in relation to insomnia and chronic low back pain impact.

Pan-cancer bioinformatic analysis using individual-level TCGA/CCLE/GTEx data examines PFKP promoter DNA methylation as a regulator of its expression and correlates it with diagnosis and prognosis across cancers.
Retrospective case series of 30 retinoblastoma patients with germline BRCA1/2 variants; BRCA1 promoter hypermethylation was examined in only a single patient's tumor with no comparator group.
Two-stage discovery/validation cohort (Jinan Diabetes Cohort Study) identifying blood DNA methylation regions associated with cardiovascular events in patients with type 2 diabetes.
Case-control study (80 AD patients vs 100 controls) using bisulfite pyrosequencing to test a blood DNA methylation panel for diagnosing late-onset Alzheimer disease.
Cohort of CKD patients measuring three DNA methylation epigenetic-age clocks before and after kidney transplantation versus dialysis to assess treatment effects on biological aging.
Cross-sectional Cebu Longitudinal cohort estimating exhausted and naive CD8/CD4 T-cell abundance from whole-blood DNA methylation deconvolution in relation to socioeconomic status.
UK Household Longitudinal Study cohort linking DNA-methylation-based epigenetic ageing to contemporary and historical housing circumstances.
Pre/post CT-scan study of 20 healthy volunteers measuring both gamma-H2AX foci by immunofluorescence and EPIC-array DNA methylation changes from radiation exposure.
Two-sample Mendelian randomization of iron biomarkers and epigenetic clock acceleration using GWAS summary statistics only, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Measures 28 circulating SASP proteins (e.g. GDF15, RAGE, VEGFA) in plasma to predict mortality; none are DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin markers.
Case-control study (81 vs 81) using targeted bisulfite sequencing of LGR6 CpG islands in PBMCs to test diagnostic value for ankylosing spondylitis.
Multicenter description of epilepsy features in Kleefstra syndrome caused by EHMT1 deletions/variants; genetic diagnosis was made, but no histone methylation mark was directly assayed.
Interrupted time-series study of BRUE/ALTE guideline implementation in emergency departments with no epigenetic marker measured.
Curates multiple TCGA and E-MTAB renal cell carcinoma cohorts to derive DNA methylation modification patterns predicting survival and immunotherapy/targeted-therapy response.
Multicenter discovery-and-validation study (433 serum samples) of cfDNA methylation biomarkers (GALNT9, UPF3A, WARS, LDB2) for colorectal cancer screening.
Meta-EWAS across four cohorts (5274 participants) of blood DNA methylation in relation to Mediterranean, plant-based, and DASH dietary quality scores.
Paired-design diagnostic study of 37 patients and 12 controls comparing a urine DNA methylation test with cytology and FISH for upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
Retrospective cross-sectional study of 148 postmenopausal women testing PER2/PER3 CpG island methylation in relation to sleep duration and osteoporosis.
Population-based Rhineland Study conducting epigenome-wide association studies of DNA methylation CpGs linked to measured and genetically predicted leukocyte telomere length and vascular function.

Histone lactylation driving PD-L1 transcription was demonstrated in cultured AML cells; the human patient cohort data only correlate bone-marrow lactate and STAT5/PD-L1 expression, not the histone mark itself.
DPSeq is a deep-learning classifier that predicts CpG island methylator phenotype and other biomarkers from H&E histology images rather than directly assaying DNA methylation.
SNP genotyping of IDH1, IDH2, and TET2 germline polymorphisms in Egyptian AML patients; genetic variant status is not a direct epigenetic marker measurement.

The measured marker in this TNBC study is the long non-coding RNA MIDEAS-AS1, quantified in patient tissue and correlated with survival; ncRNA is the only epigenetic-adjacent marker measured in humans.
Two-sample and multivariable Mendelian randomization relating women's fertility/sexual-development traits to epigenetic clocks using GWAS instrumental variables, not individual-level cohort data.

Measures histone post-translational modifications on circulating H3.1 nucleosomes in plasma of non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients versus healthy donors; per the instrument, a circulating plasma histone assay is a protein biomarker, not a chromatin-state measurement.
POUNDS Lost randomized dietary-protein intervention trial testing whether baseline ABCG1 DNA methylation modifies long-term changes in adiposity and body fat distribution.
Develops and validates a real-time PCR assay for TRH promoter methylation to detect CIN2+ in cervical screening cohorts.

Bioinformatic prognostic signature built from mRNA expression of histone-acetylation modulator genes (KAT2B, SIRT6, HAT1) in TCGA/GEO/ICGC liver cancer cohorts, not from measured histone acetylation itself.
Methylation-specific PCR analysis of BRCA1 promoter hypermethylation across 84 malignant, benign, and adjacent-normal human breast tissues, linked to tumor aggressiveness markers.

ChIP is used only as a technique to show ERG transcription-factor binding at the ICAM2 promoter in gastric cancer cell lines and mouse xenografts; no epigenetic marker was measured as a study endpoint in humans.

MeRIP-seq of m6A-modified long non-coding RNAs in primary and metastatic prostate cancer tissue; the only marker measured in humans is a modified ncRNA (lncRNA), not DNA methylation, histone marks, or chromatin state.

Develops the GP-age blood DNA methylation clock for chronological age prediction accuracy across 11,910 methylomes without testing any specific modifiable exposure, intervention, or applied clinical/public health decision.
Brain-predicted age difference derived from T1-weighted MRI in bipolar disorder patients; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker was measured.
Cohort of 38 medulloblastoma patients profiled by EPIC methylation array, with methylation-based subtyping shown to predict progression-free and overall survival.
Discovery and validation cohorts of people with type 2 diabetes had gene methylation measured and linked to diabetic kidney disease diagnostic performance.
DIRECT PLUS RCT measured DNA methylation epigenetic clocks before and after a polyphenol-rich dietary intervention.
Diagnostic comparison cohort of 31 women assessed germline MLH1 promoter hypermethylation as part of Lynch syndrome screening performance.
Two-stage case-control study measured PRICKLE1 promoter methylation in ankylosing spondylitis patients versus controls with diagnostic ROC analysis.
Bioinformatics/Mendelian-randomization study drawing methylation-disease links from GWAS, eQTL and mQTL summary statistics, not individual-level data.
Prospective cohort measured global DNA methylation and telomere length in people with HIV with/without MAFLD to characterize accelerated aging.
Longitudinal cohort and nested case-control measured LOXL3/SLC6A19 methylation mediating phthalate exposure effects on cardiometabolic risk in children.
cfMeDIP-seq measured DNA methylation/fragmentation in plasma from breast cancer patients versus healthy controls to build a diagnostic marker.
Sperm chromatin structure assay (DNA fragmentation index, HDS) measures DNA strand breakage, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, per the instrument's explicit rule.
Cross-sectional study of 376 participants measured TXNIP DNA methylation by pyrosequencing linked to serum carotenoid dietary exposure.
RCT subsample measured the pediatric buccal epigenetic clock (DNAm age acceleration) linked to a parenting-practices intervention.
Characterization of a tumor tissue series (germ cell tumor-derived somatic-type malignancy) without a stated comparative epidemiological design.
BioAge index is built from blood test biomarkers; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker is measured.
Case-control study measured INS/PTPN22/IL2RA promoter methylation in children with type 1 diabetes versus controls.
Explicitly a prospective observational study protocol describing planned enrollment, with no primary data yet reported.
Pregnancy cohort measured maternal leukocyte DNA methylation of circadian genes linked to birth outcomes.
Longitudinal cohort (Health and Retirement Study) measured DNAm age acceleration mediating effects of loneliness exposure on cognitive functioning.
Case-control tissue comparison used methylated DNA markers to discriminate HPV-associated cancers, a diagnostic-accuracy use case.
Population-based case-control study measured genome-wide DNA methylation mediating sleep quality's association with infertility.
Retrospective cohort measured sperm DNA promoter methylation variability augmenting semen-analysis prediction of fertility outcomes.
Biological/phenotypic age indices are derived from cardiovascular health scores; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Tissue/plasma cohort identified a DNA-methylation signature diagnostically distinguishing pancreatic cancer from chronic pancreatitis.
Study exposed female C57BL6 mice to glyphosate; no human participants or human-derived samples.
Single retrospective case report of one leukemia patient, with no comparison group.
Validated diagnostic score from methylation of imprinted genes in spermatozoa of recurrent-pregnancy-loss cases versus controls.
Secondary analysis of individual-level GEO methylation data (GSE42861) comparing rheumatoid arthritis cases and controls on epigenetic age measures.
Longitudinal HIIT intervention study measured DNA methylation in human skeletal muscle biopsies.
Whole exome sequencing of urethral clear cell adenocarcinoma cases identifies mutations; no epigenetic marker is directly measured.
Technical study of methylation stability under DNA cryopreservation; not linked to a modifiable exposure or clinical decision.
TAVI cohort measured circulating methylated IRX3 as a predictor of post-procedure mortality/outcome.
Brain age is estimated from MRI volumetrics via deep learning, not from any epigenetic marker.
RCT measured airway DNA methylation as a mechanism of fish-oil supplementation's effect on childhood asthma.
Case-control cohort of prostate cancer measured genome-wide methylation markers associated with metastasis to inform treatment decisions.
Case-cohort study measured blood AHRR and global (LINE-1) methylation as predictors of future non-Hodgkin lymphoma diagnosis.
H3K27me3 histone methylation was measured only in iPSC-derived neurons (a cell model), not in the human AUD trial participants themselves.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating NET/protein biomarker, not a chromatin-state assay, per the instrument's explicit rule.
Immune age index (IMMAX) is derived from flow-cytometry blood cell subpopulations; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Clinical trials of metformin in people with HIV measured PC-based DNAm epigenetic clocks in blood cells before/after treatment.
Cross-sectional study measured CYP2R1 promoter methylation and its correlation with circulating vitamin D levels.
Case-control cohort measured H3K9me3 histone modification at the RORA promoter in cord blood to build an ASD screening model.
RCT of zinc oxide patches for chronic prurigo measures clinical lesion counts; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Paired pre/post-treatment cohort of pediatric gliomas used DNA methylation-based profiling to render an integrated WHO diagnosis.
Case-control study measured DNMT and HDAC1 gene expression by qPCR, not DNA methylation or histone modification levels themselves.
Paired sun-exposed/protected skin samples from human participants measured DNA methylation, validating a noninvasive collection method and UV/age effects.
Retrospective tissue comparison of 5-hydroxymethylcytosine immunostaining distinguished a lymphoproliferative disorder from its benign mimic.
Cohort of HNSCC tumors measured whole-genome methylation subtypes correlated with genomic stability and prognosis.
Training/validation cohorts of ESCC tissue identified a cfDNA methylation diagnostic panel.
EWAS in the RHINESSA cohort measured offspring blood DNA methylation associated with father's preconception smoking exposure.
Study examines TLR7/TLR9 expression and IgA glycosylation; no epigenetic marker is measured in humans.
Case-control study measured DNA methylation of vitamin-D-pathway genes with diagnostic ROC evaluation for colorectal cancer.
Retrospective comparison of MGMT methylation patterns between long- and short-term glioblastoma survivors informs treatment-response prognosis.
Prospective cohort of pregnant women measured cell-free DNA methylation for early preeclampsia risk stratification.
Levine PhenoAge here is described as derived from clinical/lab biomarkers, not from DNA methylation.
Prospective study measured fetal/cord blood DNA methylation associated with maternal one-carbon nutrient intake in pregnancies with and without gestational diabetes.
RCT reports 'histone acetylation' alongside HDAC/DNMT 'activities' without clarifying whether an actual histone mark level or only enzyme activity was measured.
Birth cohort measured offspring DNA methylation modified by GST genotype in relation to maternal smoking exposure.
Explicitly a study protocol describing a planned pilot study, with results only anticipated.
Deep-learning classifier trained and validated on ovarian/breast/endometrial cancer cohorts using DNA methylation data to guide treatment decisions.
Case-control study measured ChREBP promoter methylation in type 2 diabetes patients versus healthy controls.
Cohort of prostate cancer patients measured tissue/urine DNA methylation biomarkers to guide focal therapy decisions.
Boston Birth Cohort measured cord blood epigenome-wide DNA methylation linked to maternal pre-pregnancy BMI and childhood obesity.
Histone modifications were measured only in human bronchial epithelial cell lines, not in the birth-cohort participants.
ICU cohort study describes PhenoAge as based on DNA methylation biomarkers, predicting unplanned ICU readmission.
Retrospective study of a supplement combination on arterial stiffness measures no epigenetic marker.
Multi-omics cohort analysis (TCGA/GEO plus an in-house patient cohort) measured ACSL1 CpG methylation linked to renal-cell-carcinoma prognosis and treatment decisions.

Abstract mixes summary-statistics-based Mendelian randomization with an undetailed 'prospective gene-environment interaction' analysis, leaving unclear whether individual-level methylation data underlies the findings.
Training and validation cohorts of cervical samples measured novel DNA methylation markers for cervical precancer/cancer diagnosis.
Cohort of Korean colorectal cancer tumors and adjacent normal tissue measured methylome differences with diagnostic/prognostic implications.
Immunohistochemistry measured histone-modifying enzyme protein levels (e.g., EZH1, UTX), not the histone marks themselves.
Retrospective Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome cohort related molecular diagnosis (including imprinting-center loss of methylation) to dentoskeletal prognosis.
Case-control cohort measured cfDNA methylation (MRE-Seq) for diagnosis of colorectal and lung cancer.
Boston Birth Cohort measured cord blood CYP2E1 DNA methylation associated with detectable acetaminophen exposure.
Biological aging trajectories are derived from an unspecified 'biological aging measure,' with no epigenetic marker described.
Jackson Heart Study cohort measured the GrimAge epigenetic clock mediating neighborhood disadvantage's association with heart-failure incidence.
Case-control EWAS measured methylome differences in OCD patients versus controls linked to severity and treatment response.
Longitudinal study measured genome-wide DNA methylation changes tracking suicidal ideation in schizophrenia-spectrum patients.
TCGA-derived and validation cohort of triple-negative breast cancer measured TERT promoter methylation linked to prognosis and immunotherapy response.
Framingham cohort measured the GrimAge epigenetic clock mediating physical inactivity's association with brain aging.

Retinal imaging biomarker of biological age; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Prospective multicohort study combined cell-free DNA methylation with clinical/imaging data for pulmonary nodule diagnosis.
CRISPR screening and CARM1-mediated CBP protein methylation were studied in bladder cancer cell lines, not human participants.
Retrospective algorithm-development study for febrile infants; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Retrospective cohort of focal cortical dysplasia tissue and postmortem controls measured DNA methylation signatures with stated diagnostic value.
Retrospective cohort compared DNA methylation profiles of ART-conceived versus non-ART rhabdoid tumor patients.
Study measures CSF3R and other gene mutations by sequencing; DNA-methylation-related genes are only noted as mutated, not methylation itself.
Cohort of metal-exposed versus unexposed subjects measured targeted CpG methylation of NFKB1 and other genes.
Machine-learning model uses histopathological/cytological features including 'chromatin' texture, not a measured epigenetic mark.
Multicenter cohort measured PBMC DNA methylation markers for early breast cancer detection.
Case-control study measured plasma cfDNA RARB/GSTP1 promoter methylation as breast cancer biomarkers.
Case-control study measured blood MMP9 promoter methylation associated with TIA/stroke-related cognitive impairment.
Bioinformatics analysis of TCGA glioblastoma data measured POLD4-associated CpG methylation linked to patient survival.
Genetic diagnostic yield study (karyotype, CMA, whole exome sequencing) for autism; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Multiomics bladder-cancer analysis touches on CpG methylation but does not clearly state a cohort/case-control/cross-sectional design for the underlying patient data.
Cross-sectional study measured leukocyte ABCA1 DNA methylation associated with dietary n-3 PUFA intake.
Cohort of mother-infant dyads measured newborn SLC6A4 DNA methylation associated with prenatal air pollution and stress exposure.
Matched case-control study measured genome-wide DNA methylation associated with anthracycline-induced cardiomyopathy in childhood cancer survivors.
Case-control study using existing DNAm array data measured GrimAge epigenetic age acceleration in multiple sclerosis.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a NET/inflammatory biomarker in plasma, not a chromatin-state assay.
Analysis used GWAS/PRS/LDSC summary-level genetic data and pathway enrichment mentioning HDAC-related genes, not a directly measured methylation or histone mark.
Two case-control studies plus a nested case-control directly measured DYRK4 blood DNA methylation by mass spectrometry and linked hypomethylation to lung cancer risk.
This is an RCT protocol/design report for VR exposure therapy that lists DNA methylation only as a planned secondary outcome, with no results reported.
A retrospective case series of 24 NUT midline carcinoma resections with no comparison group and no eligible marker measured.
The healthy aging index is built from blood pressure, reaction time, cystatin C, glucose and FVC, none of which are epigenetic markers.
STAP1 promoter methylation was measured in peripheral blood T cells of a retrospective HCC cohort and tied to disease-free and overall survival.
Genome-wide peripheral blood DNA methylation was profiled longitudinally in UC patients starting tofacitinib to predict endoscopic treatment response.
The cohort was characterized by H3F3A mutation status and co-occurring gene mutations (FGFR1, NF1, PIK3CA), not by a measured methylation or histone-modification level.
Abstract is null, giving no information on design or measured marker for this ATRT-SHH trial-cohort record.
The AIM BRAIN trial prospectively tested DNA methylation array classification against histopathology in 269 pediatric CNS tumor patients across two networks.
An RCT-derived EWAS measured blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) before and during a cognitive intervention in depression patients, linking it to treatment response.
The integrative aging clock in this cohort of Chinese women is built from transcripts, proteins, metabolites and microbiome data, not from DNA methylation.
DNMT3B, MTHFR and KDM1A were genotyped as SNPs, not measured as DNA methylation or histone modification levels.
ABCG1 blood methylation was quantified by mass spectrometry in two Chinese case-control studies and linked to coronary heart disease risk.
Peripheral blood DNA methylation arrays were performed in preterm infants to identify epigenetic signatures of bronchopulmonary dysplasia risk.
DNA methylome profiling was performed as part of integrated molecular diagnosis in a cohort of infants and young children with high-grade glioma, tied to survival outcomes.
Genome-wide methylation arrays on CRC versus polyp tissue identified a CpG panel later validated as a plasma diagnostic marker for colorectal cancer.
The study profiles somatic mutation patterns in cell-free DNA associated with replication timing and chromatin features, but does not directly measure a methylation or histone mark.
The Mindful Moms Study report is a trial protocol; genome-wide DNA methylation analysis is listed only as a planned secondary aim.
Secondary molecular analysis of the EORTC-26101 RCT measured tumor DNA methylation arrays and found MGMT promoter methylation prognostic for survival.
Blood methylation age measures such as HorvathAgeMeth were calculated in the SATSA twin cohort and predicted future stroke, dementia and Parkinson's diagnoses.
This is a technical feasibility study establishing cell lines and xenografts from 5 biopsy-derived samples, not an epidemiological comparison design.
The study analyzes colonoscopist adenoma detection rates stratified by a prior positive mt-sDNA test result, without itself measuring or analyzing the methylation data.
This cross-sectional survey measures blood pressure prevalence in adolescents with no epigenetic marker assessed.
Single-cell chromatin accessibility was measured directly in human AML bone marrow samples, but this 8-patient descriptive series has no clearly stated comparative design.
CpG methylation signatures were measured across UHN, TCGA and DKFZ IDH-mutant glioma cohorts and validated as prognostic of survival.
This is a case report of a single Suleiman-El-Hattab syndrome patient with a novel TASP1 variant; H3K4 histone effects are discussed only from prior literature.
The NHANES Biological Age Index in this MS pilot study is derived from blood pressure, FEV1, creatinine, CRP and similar clinical labs, not from an epigenetic marker.
A CpG methylation score across HPV L2/L1 and host loci was measured in exfoliated cervicovaginal cells and evaluated for cervical adenocarcinoma screening.
DNA methylation-based PhenoAge, GrimAge and DunedinPACE were measured in paired blood samples from the Sister Study cohort around a breast cancer diagnosis.
DNA methylation profiles were used to estimate immune cell proportions in the Dongfeng-Tongji cohort and linked to acute coronary syndrome incidence and risk factors.
This is a bidirectional Mendelian randomization study using GWAS summary statistics for epigenetic age and heart failure, not individual-level methylation data.
Tumor-informed methylation-based MRD scores were measured longitudinally in blood from surgical lung cancer patients and predicted disease-free survival.
This is a preclinical experimental study of human ovarian tissue culture and a xenograft mouse model, not one of the five eligible epidemiological designs.
This Mendelian randomization study draws smoking-related methylation associations from an EWAS/GWAS summary-statistics meta-analysis rather than individual-level data.
Biological age acceleration in this CHARLS analysis is derived by machine learning from unspecified aging-related biomarkers with no epigenetic marker described.
Pretreatment CpG methylation at 18 loci was assayed by EPIC array in biobanked esophageal biopsies from a randomized EoE trial and validated as a treatment-response biomarker.
This phase I/II trial of tenalisib plus romidepsin reports safety and response outcomes without measuring any histone or DNA methylation biomarker.
Methylated ctDNA markers were measured in plasma from a case-control study nested in the HUNT cohort and detected colorectal cancer up to two years before diagnosis.
This is a single case report of IgM primary plasma cell leukemia with no epigenetic marker measured.
Stool DNA-based SDC2 methylation was measured by quantitative MSP in a case-control study of colorectal cancer, adenoma and healthy controls.
This is a retrospective case series of 78 glioma patients with documented IDH-status loss, using methylation profiling diagnostically without a stated comparison design.
ITIH5's prognostic and immune effects in p53-like bladder cancer are assessed via expression and in vitro assays, not via a measured epigenetic mark.
HAMP promoter DNA methylation was measured in human liver biopsies and blood cells from the EPIC-Potsdam cohort and linked to incident type 2 diabetes risk.
This SEER database study of H3K27M-mutant DMG examines demographic and treatment factors without measuring methylation or histone-modification levels.
The metformin Mendelian randomization and observational analysis uses clinical PhenoAge and leukocyte telomere length, not a stated DNA methylation clock.
This dasatinib trial in ARID1A-mutant clear cell carcinoma uses BAF250a immunohistochemistry (protein loss), not a measured chromatin or methylation mark.
Biological age here is estimated from chest CT imaging features via deep learning, with no epigenetic marker involved.
This SPARE trial exploratory analysis measured MGMT promoter methylation in GBM tumors and found it prognostic for survival alongside TERT mutation.
An epigenome-wide association study measured maternal peripheral blood DNA methylation across pregnancy and identified CpG markers discriminating gestational diabetes.
CTLA4 promoter methylation was measured in HNSCC tumors from two cohorts and predicted response to immune checkpoint blockade.
The epimutacions package paper mixes technical benchmarking on reference datasets with an application to an autism cohort, leaving the underlying human study design unclear.
Nuclear score and cyclin D1 immunocytochemistry in thyroid FNA specimens are morphological and protein features, not a measured epigenetic mark.
This Rett-syndrome-like phenotype study is a protein-protein interaction and transcription-factor motif analysis, not a measured methylation or histone mark.
The HCC prognostic signature is built around a circRNA-microRNA-mRNA competing endogenous RNA network, with non-coding RNA as the relevant marker class examined in humans.
GrimAge and DunedinPACE DNA methylation aging measures were calculated in the Health and Retirement Study and linked to neighborhood deprivation and air pollution exposure.
The low grade glioma prognostic signature is based on 8 m6A/m5C-related long non-coding RNAs, i.e., ncRNA expression, not a directly measured DNA methylation or histone mark.

SMYD3-driven H4K20me3 is described mechanistically via ChIP assay, but the abstract does not specify whether this histone mark was measured in patient tissue or only in cell lines.
This study identifies rare MECP2 sequence variants and mouse expression patterns in precocious puberty, not a measured human epigenetic mark.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assessed as a molecular biomarker in a phase I/IIa dendritic-cell immunotherapy trial for glioblastoma.
The study centers on lncRNA MTAAT as a non-coding RNA regulator of mitophagy in ALK-negative ALCL, with no DNA methylation or histone mark measured.
DNA methylation subgrouping (SHH_3) was used to classify a retrospective cohort of Li-Fraumeni medulloblastoma patients whose survival outcomes were analyzed.
This PEMDAC trial follow-up measures plasma chemokines, cytokines and thymidine kinase activity, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.

MGMT promoter methylation was measured in leiomyosarcoma tumor samples and correlated with progression-free survival on dacarbazine treatment.
DNA methylation-based Pheno/Grim age-acceleration and DNAm PAI1 estimators were measured across three pooled cohorts and linked to sex hormone levels.
ChIP-PCR was used to show AhR promoter occupancy driving CCL21 expression, a transcription-factor binding assay rather than a measured methylation or histone mark.

Genome-wide DNA methylation status was measured in tumor tissue from the TRICOLORE randomized trial and combined with TP53 subtype for prognosis in metastatic colorectal cancer.

This randomized trial of vorinostat/hydroxychloroquine versus regorafenib in colorectal cancer reports pharmacodynamic and immune endpoints but no direct assay of histone acetylation or another epigenetic mark.

AR ChIP-sequencing measured transcription-factor binding intensity in prostate tumors, which is a cistrome assay rather than DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state measurement.
Methylation-specific PCR measured P16 and TP53 promoter methylation in an esophageal cancer case-control study, linked to cancer risk and prognosis.
Bisulfite pyrosequencing measured HTR2A promoter methylation in ENVIRONAGE cohort placentas and linked it to residential green space exposure.

The Normative Aging Study cohort used Illumina 450K-derived EpiSmokEr methylation classification of smoking phenotype to predict airflow limitation and mortality.

Pre/post-treatment breast tissue biopsies from antiprogestin clinical trials measured DNA methylation field-cancerization signatures directly, linked to the drug intervention.

Illumina EPIC methylation profiling in the LIFE-Adult cohort compared blood DNA methylation between extreme healthy and unhealthy lifestyle groups.
The chromatin organization-related gene signature is built from differential gene expression of genes annotated to a chromatin-organization pathway, not a direct measurement of chromatin state.
Bisulfite pyrosequencing measured LINE-1/Alu global DNA methylation in newborn cord blood from the NELA cohort and linked it to maternal urinary bisphenol exposure.
The FAM19A4/miR124-2 methylation test directly measured DNA methylation in cervical scrapes of HPV-positive women, informing which CIN2/3 lesions need treatment.
Infinium EPIC 850k methylation profiling directly distinguished fast- from slow-growing salivary gland pleomorphic adenomas in human tumor samples, a diagnostic biomarker design.
Whole-exome sequencing found frequent mutations in histone-modifier genes in primary hepatic neuroendocrine tumors, but no histone mark or methylation was directly assayed.
The Strong Heart Study measured Illumina EPIC DNA methylation in American Indian adults and linked differentially methylated CpGs to lung function and airflow limitation.
cfMeDIP-seq directly measured plasma cell-free DNA methylomes in a case-control comparison of ovarian cancer patients versus healthy and benign controls for early detection.
MGMT promoter methylation was measured directly in glioblastoma patients and analyzed together with levetiracetam plasma concentration for its association with survival.
Immunohistochemical H3K27me3 quantification, a histone modification, was directly measured in a cohort of WHO grade 3 meningioma biopsies and tested against overall survival.
Immunohistochemistry measured histone H4 acetylation directly in testicular tissue, comparing tumor, spermatogenic-impairment, and control patient groups.
MGMT promoter methylation status was measured directly in neuroendocrine tumor/carcinoma tissue samples and evaluated as a predictive biomarker for temozolomide therapy.
TCGA/GEO individual-level DNA methylation data showed RFPL3S hypermethylation in testicular germ cell tumors alongside lncRNA expression, linked to progression-free survival.
The FAM19A4/miR124-2 methylation test was measured directly on FFPE cervical biopsies from pregnant women with CIN3 to guide conservative-management decisions.
Phosphorylated histone H2AX was assessed as a circulating blood marker of DNA damage/repair in this fasting-mimicking-diet trial, a protein assay rather than a chromatin-based measurement.
Illumina methylome profiling of glioblastoma FFPE samples, validated in TCGA/TCIA, directly measured a 15-CpG signature distinguishing subventricular-zone tumor prognosis.
This phase I/II trial of the HDAC inhibitor ivaltinostat reports mutation burden and blood protein correlates but no direct measurement of histone acetylation or another epigenetic mark.
This is a cohort profile paper describing the RHINESSA study's design, participants, and prior findings rather than reporting a new primary analysis.
An epigenome-wide association study in the Dongfeng-Tongji case-cohort measured blood DNA methylation directly and linked specific CpGs to plasma zinc exposure and lung cancer risk.

The abstract states PTBP1 correlates with 'DNA methylation' across cancers via multiple databases but does not specify whether individual-level methylation data or only aggregate database statistics were used.
This is a descriptive case series of ten newly identified multi-locus imprinting disturbance patients screened from BWS/PHP1B cohorts, without a comparison group.
This German prospective cohort measured Illumina EPIC/450K DNA methylation to derive DNAm PhenoAge, GrimAge, and mortality-risk clocks and tested them against incident cancer risk.
The California Lupus Epidemiology Study measured DNA methylation directly at two longitudinal time points via the EPIC array to track SLE subtype-associated CpG stability.
This cross-sectional pilot study measured mtDNA hypermethylation and post-translational histone modifications directly in individuals with prenatal pro-oxidant exposure versus controls.
Whole-exome sequencing of alveolar soft part sarcoma identified mutations enriched in the chromatin-organization pathway by gene annotation, not a direct chromatin-state assay.
Genome-wide methylation microarray directly measured PTEN hypermethylation in a patient cohort failing hypomethylating-agent treatment for myelodysplastic syndrome, confirming cell-line findings.
Illumina EPIC methylation profiling was measured directly in infant whole blood during acute RSV infection and used to build a diagnostic signature for later respiratory sequelae.
CRISPR-DiR and methylation analysis of paired bone-marrow samples from two myelodysplastic syndrome patient cohorts directly measured SALL4 CpG island demethylation after hypomethylating therapy.
MGMT promoter methylation was measured directly in an IDH-wildtype glioblastoma cohort and evaluated alongside Ki-67 index as an independent predictor of survival.

This CARDIA cohort analysis measured epigenetic age acceleration directly but relates it only to serum AMH as a reproductive-aging correlate, not to a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical decision.
Genome-wide methylation-derived risk scores were measured directly in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes subgroups and used to predict future cardiovascular and renal complications.
This is a mechanistic study combining murine electroporation models, cell lines, and ChIP-seq validation in human tumor tissue rather than an epidemiological cohort, case-control, or trial design.
The 'chromatin remodeling' molecular subtype in this intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma multiomics study is defined by a proteomic pathway signature, not a direct chromatin-state measurement.

The Shanghai Birth/Sleep Cohort measured cord blood DNA methylation via the EPIC array and tested it as a mediator between maternal sleep timing and offspring adiposity.
Nested case-control studies measured blood DNA methylation directly via LASSO-selected CpGs to build a lung-cancer risk discrimination signature beyond smoking history.
This Japanese-language article is a narrative discussion of glioblastoma prognostic factors and future perspectives, citing MGMT methylation generally rather than reporting new primary data.
The 'physical fitness age' measure here is derived from grip strength, walking speed, and one-leg stand time, with no DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin marker involved.
Sperm chromatin structure assay parameters (DFI, HDS) measure DNA fragmentation and packaging, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, per the instrument's explicit exclusion.
The FASSTT randomized controlled trial measured cord blood DNA methylation via the EPIC array to assess effects of second/third-trimester folic acid supplementation.
Genome-wide peripheral blood methylation was measured directly at baseline and week 12 in a discovery and validation cohort of rheumatoid arthritis patients starting TNF inhibitor therapy.
This study maps ARID5B cis-regulatory variants via CRISPR interference screening and germline sequencing, a genetic rather than an epigenetic-mark measurement.
The Cebu Longitudinal Health and Nutrition Survey measured EPIC-array-derived epigenetic clocks directly and linked them to birth weight and maternal pregnancy energy status.
Biological age here is derived from urinary oxidative-stress metabolites (8-oxoG, dityrosine, isoprostanes), not from DNA methylation or another epigenetic marker.
This Rett syndrome natural history study reports MECP2 genetic variant classes and anxiety behavior, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark measured.
Histone H3K9 acetylation was measured directly in jejunal mucosa biopsies from a randomized crossover trial comparing high-fat and high-carbohydrate diets.
Immunohistochemistry measured LSD1 protein expression, an epigenetic-modifier enzyme, in hypopharynx carcinoma tissue rather than a histone mark or DNA methylation itself.
DNA methylation at APOE-region CpGs was measured directly in a racially diverse middle-aged cohort and linked to cognitive test performance and dietary inflammatory exposure.
Genome-wide methylation profiling of cervical secretions was measured directly in a case-control comparison of pregnancy versus non-pregnancy embryo transfer cycles.
Candidate-gene DNA methylation, including NKX2-5, was measured directly in cord blood in a case-control study of maternal PAH exposure and congenital heart disease risk.
A sperm DNA methylation-based epigenetic clock (SEACpG) was measured directly in a prospective preconception cohort and linked to time-to-pregnancy outcomes.
This phase I trial of regorafenib, hydroxychloroquine, and entinostat in colorectal cancer reports toxicity and weight-loss outcomes with no direct epigenetic marker assay described.
This survey of physical therapists' beliefs about a patellofemoral pain guideline involves no epigenetic marker of any kind.
The Bladder EpiCheck DNA methylation urine test was measured directly and compared with cytology for diagnosing upper tract urothelial carcinoma in a prospective clinical study.
Deep sequencing measured blood DNA methylation directly across a 17-year prospective cohort and built trauma-related methylation risk scores predicting adult psychiatric outcomes.
This glioma prognostic model is built from HDAC1/3/4/5/7/9 gene expression levels, not a direct measurement of histone acetylation.
The GAME study article explicitly presents a prospective cohort protocol for future assessment of gender-affirming hormone therapy effects on skeletal muscle methylomics, with no results reported.
Real-time methylation-specific PCR measured tumor-suppressor gene promoter methylation directly in circulating tumor cells and plasma cfDNA from early-stage NSCLC patients.
This brain-age model is built from MRI-derived white matter hyperintensity volumes, with no DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin marker involved.
MGMT promoter methylation status, measured directly, was used to stratify a glioblastoma cohort in which MRI-based white matter tract involvement predicted overall survival.
DNA methylation of the DMRTA2 marker was measured directly in urine sediment and tissue samples across discovery and validation cohorts for bladder cancer detection.
This study extracts computer-vision texture features from stained myeloblast chromatin images to predict relapse, a morphological image analysis rather than a molecular epigenetic assay.
The FAM19A4/miR124-2 methylation test was measured directly and followed longitudinally in women with untreated CIN2/3 to support a wait-and-see management policy.
This Finnish screening cohort classifies anti-epileptic drugs by known HDAC-inhibitory pharmacology without directly measuring histone acetylation or another epigenetic mark in patients.
This multi-ethnic epigenome-wide association study measured blood DNA methylation directly in 22,774 individuals and linked CRP-associated CpGs to obesity and smoking as modifiable mediators.

Citrullinated histone H3 was used here as a NET marker to identify neutrophil extracellular traps in NASH liver biopsies, the same protein-marker use the instrument names as excluded rather than a chromatin-regulatory readout.
Next-generation methylation sequencing measured APC promoter methylation directly in liver-transplant hepatocellular carcinoma tissue and linked it to post-transplant recurrence risk.

RRBS DNA methylation was measured in neonatal dried blood spots and compared between infants of normal-BMI versus obese mothers, linking methylation to a modifiable prenatal exposure.
Thirteen ESS tumors are described clinicopathologically and clustered against external reference data with no defined comparison group of the study's own design.
Methylation scores for lifestyle traits were calculated from CpGs in the Generation Scotland cohort and tested for association with major depressive disorder risk.

Genome-wide methylation was profiled on the EPIC array in a case-controlled comparison of pituitary adenoma patients with versus without postsurgical progression.
Methylome analysis of a national BCP-ALL registry cohort distinguished a diagnostically relevant IG-MYC-rearranged cluster with its own survival outcomes.

Serum MECP2 protein was quantified by ELISA as a prognostic marker in hip-fracture patients; this measures the protein, not DNA methylation itself.

METTL1's role concerns RNA m7G modification and its expression/activity across pan-cancer datasets; methylation data appear only as an input to a stemness index, not as a directly reported epigenetic finding.

This study quantifies nuclear morphometry and chromatin texture by image analysis of stained slides, not a molecular epigenetic mark.
