TLR9 promoter and intragenic CpG methylation was bisulfite-sequenced and compared between inflamed periapical lesions and healthy periodontal ligament tissue.
The abstract describes targeted bisulfite sequencing of plasma ccfDNA for candidate Alzheimer's markers but does not state the study design, sample size, or comparison groups used.

This HERBY trial sub-analysis classifies tumors by H3 K27 mutation and EGFR status via imaging and sequencing, with no methylation assay reported.

Cord and childhood blood DNA methylation was measured longitudinally and linked to gestational cadmium exposure in a Bangladeshi mother-child cohort.
WNT5A promoter CpG methylation was measured in 59 CLL patient samples and used to define prognostic subgroups predicting treatment-free survival.
This vaccine safety cohort study concerns a CpG adjuvant used to boost hepatitis B vaccine immunogenicity, not any epigenetic marker measurement.

This LUAD study characterizes mutations and expression repression of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling subunits, not a directly measured methylation or histone-modification mark.

Blood DNA methylation at BDNF Exon IV was measured in adolescent boys and tested against urinary metabolites of non-persistent pesticide exposures and behavioral outcomes.
SMARCA2 protein loss was detected by immunohistochemistry on tissue microarrays, which measures protein expression rather than chromatin state or a histone mark.

Seven DNA methylation sites were among the blood markers measured in a case-control comparison of endometrial cancer, breast cancer, benign lesion, and control groups to build a diagnostic panel.

DNA methylation status of SNRPA1 was assessed via multi-database patient data as part of a prognostic and drug-sensitivity characterization in ccRCC, though no methylation-specific finding is stated.

HDAC7 protein expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry as a prognostic marker in NSCLC, not the histone acetylation mark it catalyzes.

MGMT promoter methylation status was determined by sequencing and methylation profiling in the randomized phase III CATNON trial and tested for predictive value for temozolomide benefit.
This CLSA cohort profile reports genome-wide SNP genotyping data only; DNA methylation is named solely as a future data collection plan, not yet measured.
Case-control study measuring five DNA methylation markers in urine/cervical samples from cancer, CIN2/3 and control women to evaluate a cervical cancer screening test.

Prospective study directly measuring genome-wide and targeted bisulfite sequencing of sperm DNA methylation (BRCA1 promoter) in men grouped by fragmentation index, linked to infertility diagnostics.

Nanopore sequencing study whose DNA methylation profiling of STR sites is a technical byproduct of genotyping, not analysed in relation to a modifiable exposure or a specific clinical decision.
Blinded multicenter case-control validation (122 HCC vs 125 controls) of a blood test combining cell-free DNA methylation with clinical variables for early HCC detection.
Cohort study developing and validating a urine DNA methylation panel (RRBS and qMSP) directly measured across hundreds of samples for bladder cancer detection.

CARDIA cohort study (1,676 participants) measuring blood-based DNA methylation epigenetic age in relation to cognitive decline risk stratification.
Case-control study (286 vs 286) directly measuring HIF-1α promoter CpG island methylation by MSP in relation to risk of anti-tuberculosis drug-induced liver injury.
Circulating-tumor-cell study profiles the transcriptome (gene expression signature) of CTCs and tumors; no DNA methylation, histone modification or chromatin state was measured.
Cross-sectional profiling of cell-free DNA methylome (EPIC array) in serum/plasma of PitNET patients versus non-PitNET conditions to build a diagnostic classifier.

Cross-sectional study genotyping loss of methylation at imprinting center 2 (IC2-LoM) in children with Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome and relating it to craniofacial phenotype and monitoring needs.

Newborn Epigenetics Study cohort (90 mother-child dyads) measuring blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) associated with liver fat content, aiming to identify children at risk for NAFLD.
Cross-sectional study directly measuring p53 promoter methylation in blood of residents chronically exposed to arsenic-contaminated topsoil versus unexposed controls.
Dunedin cohort study of adolescent health conditions and midlife 'pace of aging' composite, gait speed, brain age and facial age; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker is named as measured.
Treatment comparison trial of chidamide (an HDAC inhibitor) versus chemotherapy for PTCL that reports survival outcomes but does not measure any histone modification or methylation marker.
RCT of pentoxifylline/zinc in male infertility measured sperm DNA fragmentation, which the instrument specifies reflects strand breakage/packaging rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Prospective study measuring circulating histone H3 protein levels in pediatric sepsis is a plasma protein assay, not a chromatin-state measurement.
Cohort of 80 malignant astrocytomas with MGMT promoter methylation directly measured by multiple bisulfite-based assays to inform diagnostic and treatment (temozolomide) decisions.
70-gene expression signature (Mammaprint) characterization of ultralow-risk ER+ breast tumors profiles gene expression, not DNA methylation or another epigenetic marker.
Case-series-with-controls study identifying and validating HOXD8 promoter hypermethylation as a diagnostic biomarker for biliary tract cancer in tissue and bile.
Epigenome-wide association study directly measuring saliva DNA methylation (EPIC array) in 1,135 veterans to identify epigenetic biomarkers associated with PTSD diagnosis.
Mendelian randomization/QTL analysis resolving depression GWAS signals to methylation, transcript and protein QTLs relies on GWAS/mQTL summary statistics rather than individual-level data.
Secondary analysis of individual-level TCGA and Moffitt melanoma methylation data identifying eQTM CpGs used as prognostic and immune-monitoring biomarkers.

Retrospective series of 33 BCOR-ITD tumours with DNA methylation profiling compares two location-based subtypes descriptively; the abstract does not clearly establish an analytic case-control/cohort design linking methylation to a decision.
Cross-sectional comparison of global DNA methylation and DNMT3A expression across multiple myeloma disease phases in bone marrow samples from MM patients, explored as a marker of tumor progression.
MGMT-unmethylated status was used only as a fixed inclusion criterion to select the GBM patient cohort; methylation itself was not analysed against the intervention or outcome in this study.
Cross-sectional study directly measuring DNA methylation (targeted bisulfite sequencing) of stress-related genes in children exposed to antenatal synthetic glucocorticoids versus controls.

Study of methylation quantitative trait loci in Crohn's disease examines genetic determinants of already-known disease-associated CpGs and concludes most are common/non-disease-specific, without tying methylation to a modifiable exposure or clinical decision.
Phase II trial of chidamide (HDAC inhibitor) plus chemotherapy for AITL reports response/survival outcomes without measuring any histone modification or methylation marker.
Targeted bisulfite sequencing directly measuring PDX1/EN2/MSX1 promoter hypermethylation in colorectal cancer patients, used to stratify good versus poor prognosis groups.
Cross-sectional study of 1,607 fertile men directly measuring sperm 5mC/5hmC DNA methylation in relation to long-term air pollution exposure and semen quality.
CD103+CD8+ tissue-resident memory T-cell infiltration study in bladder cancer measures immune cell infiltration and pathway-alteration status, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.
POUNDS Lost randomized weight-loss diet trial directly measuring blood DNA methylation at the TXNIP locus and its interaction with dietary protein intake on glycemic outcomes.
Cohort of 60 patients with genome-wide DNA methylation profiling used to define a diagnostic episignature for KMT2A-related (Wiedemann-Steiner) syndrome, enabling variant classification.
Cross-sectional cohort of 125 policemen with genome-wide DNA methylation microarray profiling directly measured in relation to occupational air pollution exposure across cities.
Reanalysis of individual-level ALSPAC cohort DNA methylation data testing associations with childhood adversity and prenatal smoking exposure across different data/analytic pipeline versions.
Case report/series on Rahman syndrome characterizes HIST1H1E gene mutations via exome sequencing; this is genetic testing, not a measured epigenetic mark.
Prospective observational cohort of HIV-positive women measuring ASCL1/LHX8 cervical methylation as a posttreatment monitoring test for recurrent CIN2/3.
Cohort of 178 newly diagnosed AML patients with custom NGS panel directly measuring DNA methylation of candidate genes to validate their prognostic value for survival.

Rheumatoid arthritis microbiome study attributes butyrate's effect to reduced HDAC expression as a mechanistic explanation in a mouse model; no epigenetic marker was directly measured in the human RA cohort.
Cross-sectional RODAM study measuring genome-wide DNA methylation (four epigenetic clocks) in migrant versus non-migrant Ghanaians in relation to cardiometabolic exposures.

Antiphospholipid syndrome cohort measures circulating citrullinated histone H3 (Cit-H3) as a NET marker in serum, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.

KEL oncogene functional study in acute erythroleukemia reporting H3K27 acetylation gain is a mechanistic cell-line/functional investigation rather than one of the five eligible epidemiological designs.
Cross-sectional comparison of methylome (MethylCap) profiling in disease-free breast tissue from women at high versus average risk of breast cancer, aiming at risk-assessment biomarkers.
Serial cell-free tumor DNA tracking in this glioma trial measures H3K27M mutant variant allele fraction (a DNA mutation), not histone methylation/acetylation status itself.
Narrative review of non-invasive oocyte-quality assessment techniques ('we aim to review'); no primary data.
Cross-sectional cohort (101 normal-weight, 97 overweight/obese) directly measuring nuclear (LINE-1, MTHFR) and mitochondrial DNA methylation in relation to obesity/one-carbon metabolism status.

Cohort combining an institutional biliary tract cancer series with TCGA-CHOL data, directly measuring DNA methylation to define subtypes with distinct survival and immunotherapy-relevant characteristics.

Systemic lupus erythematosus study profiles antimitochondrial IgG autoantibodies by ELISA/proteomics; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured despite background mention of mitochondrial CpG hypomethylation.
Case-control cfDNA methylation study (29 lung cancer vs 74 normal samples) directly measuring differentially methylated regions to build a lung cancer diagnostic marker panel.
Cohort of 163 gliomas with immunohistochemistry and CpG methylation of DLL3 directly measured and linked to prognosis in lower-grade glioma.
Prospective case-control study (108 bladder cancer patients vs 100 matched controls) directly measuring urinary DNA methylation markers by qMSP for diagnostic validation.
Multi-cohort study directly measuring genome-wide and targeted DNA methylation signatures to diagnose lymph node metastasis status in early gastric cancer and guide treatment decisions.
Case-control study (38 vs 31 and 6 vs 10) directly measuring blood DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks in adults with high-functioning autism spectrum disorder as a potential biomarker.
Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966 study (n=604) measuring five DNA-methylation-based epigenetic aging biomarkers in relation to work-related stress, a modifiable occupational exposure.
Purely computational pharmacophore modeling and molecular dynamics simulation to design HDAC3 inhibitors; no human participants or human-derived samples were used.
Molecular landscape study of H3 G34-mutant glioma characterizes PDGFRA and MUC gene mutations by whole-exome/RNA sequencing; no DNA methylation or histone modification was measured as an outcome.
St. Jude Lifetime Cohort study of childhood cancer survivors directly measuring blood DNA methylation (EPIC array, EWAS) in relation to social determinants of health exposures.

STAR-Protocols-style methods article describing the SUMO computational pipeline for multi-omic subtyping, referencing a companion primary paper; this is a protocol/method description, not a primary analysis.
Case-control study of MTHFD1 gene polymorphisms and maternal smoking in congenital heart disease measures SNP genotypes, not DNA methylation, despite background discussion of methylation.
Nonrandomized stepped-wedge pilot study of physical therapy clinical practice guideline implementation for neck/back pain; no epigenetic marker of any kind is involved.

TCGA-LUAD cohort study integrating differentially methylated CpG sites (among other omics layers) directly measured to build a tumor mutation burden prediction model relevant to immunotherapy prognosis.
Dietary intervention study in healthy men (cocoa flavanol vs control drink) directly measuring blood DNA methylation changes in cell-adhesion/cytoskeleton genes as a modifiable-exposure link.

Cohort of 44 (in-vitro) and 49 (clinical) colorectal cancer patients with CHFR promoter methylation directly measured by qMSP and correlated with irinotecan-based chemotherapy response, informing treatment selection.
Case-control study (49 girls with Conduct Disorder vs 50 controls) directly measuring genome-wide DNA methylation and relating differential methylation to environmental/psychosocial risk factors.
Interview article with a researcher about his career in environmental epigenomics; not a primary study.
Study directly measuring TM4SF1 promoter methylation (MSP) in papillary thyroid carcinoma tissue from patients with versus without lymph node metastasis, aiming at risk prediction.
Cohort of 148 HPV-negative OSCC patients (with 175 healthy controls) directly measuring miR-34b/c promoter DNA methylation by MSP and its association with nodal status and survival.
Comparative cytology study of rehydrated air-dried versus conventional PAP smears; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Prospective cohort study directly measuring serial circulating tumor DNA methylation (TriMeth assay) in colorectal liver metastasis patients for postoperative recurrence surveillance.
Cross-species proteomic biomarker study identifies circulating HIST1H1C histone protein in plasma after radiation exposure, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Prospective cohort of 181 women undergoing IVF directly measuring peripheral blood DNA methylation age (DNAm age, LINE-1) as a predictor of live birth.
Prospective study directly measuring lactylated histone H3K18 in PBMCs by western blot in critically ill septic shock patients versus controls, evaluated as a diagnostic/severity biomarker.
Cross-sectional study of 190 Huichol indigenous persons directly measuring CDKN2B/CDKN2A promoter methylation by pyrosequencing in relation to occupational pesticide exposure.

Nested case-control study using nanoscale nuclear architecture mapping (an optical/structural technique) to detect chromatin alterations in Barrett's esophagus; unclear whether this constitutes a directly measured molecular epigenetic marker as intended by the instrument.

Human fetal thyroid organoid culture study reporting chromatin accessibility at maturation genes is an experimental developmental-biology/organoid model, not one of the five eligible epidemiological designs.
Cohort study (Copenhagen City Heart Study, >9,000 individuals) directly measuring leukocyte AHRR (cg05575921) DNA methylation to improve lung cancer screening eligibility specificity.

Colon cancer study of berberine's effect via β-catenin signaling reports decreased CTNNB1 promoter methylation from TCGA/database analysis only incidentally, without linking methylation itself to an exposure or clinical decision; core experiments are in vitro/in vivo.
Cohort of 113 pregnant women directly measuring urinary metal exposures and cord-blood global DNA methylation (Alu, LINE-1) as an epigenetic outcome of prenatal metal exposure.
Piccolipiù birth cohort directly measuring cord-blood epigenome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC array) in relation to gestational PM10 air pollution exposure.

Population-based cohort of 603 non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients directly measuring peripheral blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) associated with tumor recurrence/death, aiming at monitoring biomarkers.
Nationwide registry study of AML epidemiology, treatment patterns and healthcare costs in Taiwan; no epigenetic marker is measured.

Methylation array study (450K) directly measuring DNA methylation at non-coding RNA gene loci in breast-to-brain metastasis versus primary/normal breast tissue, including TCGA data, proposed as prognostic markers.
This is a methodological appraisal of AAA clinical practice guidelines using AGREE II, not a primary study measuring any marker.

The GWAS/blood-meQTL/SMR analysis of disordered eating links methylation to genetic variant effects on disease susceptibility, not to a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical/public-health decision.
The study measures telomere length by qPCR, which is not DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or an epigenetic clock.

gamma-H2AX (a histone modification) and pATM were measured by staining in ex vivo cultured biopsies from a cohort of 28 oral/oropharyngeal cancer patients and related to prediction of treatment response.
25 DNA methylation CpG loci were measured in the Framingham cohort and combined with clinical features to predict early HFpEF risk, a clinical risk-stratification use.
Peripheral blood DNA methylation microarrays were compared between successful and normal cognitive aging groups in a community-dwelling older-adult case-control sample.
DNA methylation and epigenetic age acceleration measures in GENOA African-American cohort blood samples were related to multi-site atherosclerosis risk over 5-12 years follow-up.
Whole-blood DNA methylation (Infinium 450k) epigenetic age acceleration was assessed against change in frailty in the MOBILIZE Boston cohort, a prognosis-relevant biomarker use.
Five DNA methylation age clocks were measured in the Berlin Aging Study II/GendAge cohort and related to functional capacity outcomes cross-sectionally and longitudinally.
Genomic DNA methylation was directly profiled (EWAS) in individual-level case and control blood/leukocyte samples across two validation phases to identify pancreatic cancer susceptibility loci.
DunedinPACE, a DNA-methylation blood-test biomarker of pace of aging, was developed and validated against morbidity, disability, and mortality in the Dunedin birth cohort and other human datasets.

Epigenome-wide DNA methylation in CSF samples from a prospective cohort of 89 severe TBI patients was linked to intracranial hypertension severity, informing risk stratification and personalized therapy.

The study measures H2AFZ mRNA and protein expression levels in LUAD tissue via IHC/bioinformatics, which is expression of a histone variant rather than a measured chromatin-state or modification mark.
This study of Geriatric Assessment components predicting surgical outcomes measures no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Tissue and cell-free DNA methylation blocks were directly measured by bisulfite sequencing and used to build and validate an HCC screening/diagnostic model in patient plasma cohorts.
This retrospective study of breast cancer brain metastases reports only cytopathology and IHC receptor/Ki67 status, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation signatures (EpiScores) for the circulating proteome were trained/tested in four cohorts and related to incident disease risk in Generation Scotland.
This study of DSC-MRI/ADC imaging differentiating H3-mutant from H3-wild-type glioma uses imaging parameters, not a directly measured epigenetic marker, to classify tumors.
The SIOP Ependymoma I non-randomised trial evaluated DNA methylation and H3K27me3 histone modification status in tumor samples from treated children and related them to event-free/overall survival.
Genome-wide infant cord-blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) was related to maternal and neonatal one-carbon metabolite exposures in the MMIP pregnancy cohort.
This cohort of 220 methylation-class-PXA tumors used DNA methylation array analysis to define tumor classification and related pTERT mutation status to prognosis.
Cohort data (N=3205) were used to directly measure DNA hypomethylation at F2RL3 in blood and relate it to smoking exposure and myocardial infarction risk via platelet reactivity.
Cognitive function is assessed via serum metabolomics (amino acids, neurotransmitters) to build a biological-age model; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Global DNA methylation and chromatin remodeling/histone modifications were measured in buffy-coat samples from patients with neurodegenerative disorders for diagnostic biomarker discovery.
Placental LEP gene DNA methylation at 13 CpG sites was measured in the STORK-Groruddalen cohort and related to maternal glucose/LDL-cholesterol, a modifiable metabolic exposure.
DNA methylation (850K array) was measured in Gambian and Indian children's blood and related to cardiometabolic risk factors (blood pressure, insulin, lipids) in the EMPHASIS study.
GrimAge and Pace of Aging DNA methylation clocks were measured in TILDA cohort blood samples and related to childhood adversity exposure in this cross-sectional study.
Methylation status of SOSTDC1, DACT2, and WIF1 was measured by methylation-specific PCR in plasma samples of a breast cancer case-control cohort for diagnostic biomarker validation.

ZFP64 chromatin binding (ChIP-seq) was investigated mechanistically in cell lines and mouse/humanized-mouse tumor models; the human patient samples were used only for RNA-seq, not epigenetic marker measurement.
Newborn DNA methylation (CpGs) was measured in cord blood of the Isle of Wight Birth Cohort and related to asthma acquisition during adolescence/young adulthood, replicated in ALSPAC.

This case-control study of morphine abuse in men used Aniline Blue/Toluidine Blue/CMA3 sperm chromatin integrity stains, which the instrument specifies measure DNA strand breakage/packaging rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
H3K27M mutation status (a genetic alteration) was assessed in adult thalamic glioma patients, but no histone modification, methylation, or chromatin-state assay was directly measured.
Genome-wide tumor DNA methylation was measured pre- and on-treatment in patients enrolled in this single-arm phase 2 trial of pembrolizumab plus the demethylating agent azacitidine.

The abstract states DNA methylation profiling datasets were analyzed across ICC mutational clusters but does not specify whether this was individual-level primary/secondary data or only aggregate published findings.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation was measured in PBMCs of ankylosing spondylitis cases versus healthy controls (with independent validation cohort), linking methylation to disease diagnosis/mechanism.

SNRPN methylation-specific quantitative melt analysis directly measured DNA methylation in newborn blood spots to validate feasibility of population-scale screening for chromosome 15 imprinting disorders.

Multiple DNA-methylation-based epigenetic age acceleration measures were assessed in the Head and Neck 5000 prospective cohort and shown to predict all-cause mortality in oropharyngeal cancer patients.
MLH1 promoter methylation status was assessed alongside MMRP immunohistochemistry in a retrospective series of endometrial carcinomas to inform Lynch syndrome screening follow-up.
DNA methylation of three PTEN promoter sequences was measured by pyrosequencing in tumor tissue from a breast cancer cohort (validated in TCGA) and predicted 10-year survival after tamoxifen therapy.
MGMT promoter methylation status was retrospectively assessed in tumor tissue from 316 wild-type IDH glioblastoma patients and related to clinicopathological parameters and treatment response.
ZNF582 promoter methylation was measured in lesion and adjacent-normal tissue across OLP, dysplasia, and OSCC patient groups in this case-control study, informing malignant-transformation monitoring.
This cross-sectional study directly measured MGMT promoter methylation status by PCR (gold standard) and IHC in glioma patient tissue samples to evaluate diagnostic accuracy for treatment decisions.
OKI-179 is characterized in vitro and in preclinical tumor models; the human phase I trial is only mentioned as ongoing/future work with no reported results.
Hyper-methylated CLIP4 (measured by methylation-specific PCR) was validated as a serum/tissue biomarker for colorectal cancer diagnosis in training and validation patient cohorts.
DNA methylation status at 16 CpG sites of tumor-derived genomic DNA was measured (MethyLight-based assay) in 186 mCRC patients and predicted response to anti-EGFR treatment.
Promoter methylation of FBN1, SPG20, ITF2, RUNX3, SNCA, MLH1, and SEPT9 was directly measured in tissue and plasma cfDNA of a colorectal cancer case-control cohort for diagnostic biomarker discovery.
Multimodal MR imaging variables were used to predict H3 K27M mutation status noninvasively; no epigenetic marker was directly measured in this retrospective imaging study.
Pace of Aging here was measured from 12 physiological biomarkers across body systems, not a DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clock, so no eligible marker was measured.
IDH1/2 mutations were identified by direct sequencing in leukemia patients; DNA methylation itself was not measured, only discussed as a downstream consequence of mutation.
Blood DNA methylation at 45 FOXO3 CpGs (HumanMethylation450) was measured across eight case-control cancer studies and a mortality cohort and related to cancer survival.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation was measured across WHI, ARIC, and MESA cohorts and CpG sites were related to BMI, metabolic health, and incident coronary heart disease risk.

DNA-methylation-based telomere length (DNAmTL), an epigenetic clock-family biomarker, was measured in blood of COPD patients in the MACRO trial placebo arm and predicted exacerbation/hospitalization risk.

DNA methylation array was used for molecular (subgroup) classification of embryonal brain tumors in this prospective pediatric trial (PBTC-026), with methylation-defined subgroup linked to progression-free/overall survival.
This EPIC-Heidelberg case-cohort study examines GDF-15, NT-proBNP, HbA1c, CRP, and cystatin-C, none of which are epigenetic markers.

The abstract describes H3K27me3/H3K4me3 and genome-wide DNA methylation changes driven by lncRNA H19 in mechanistic/model studies, and separately cites clinical H19 expression data in patients, without clearly stating that the epigenetic marks themselves were measured in the human patient cohort.
DNA methylation at 840 CpG sites in FGFR/FGF/CCND1 genes was measured in TCGA HNSCC tumor and normal tissue samples and correlated with HPV status and predicted sensitivity to FGFR inhibitors.
DNA methylation was measured as a candidate biomarker of treatment response in this randomized phase 2 trial of azacitidine with/without durvalumab in older AML patients.
This cross-sectional survey of physicians' and pharmacists' prediabetes management views measures no epigenetic marker.
Blood leukocyte DNA methylation age acceleration (Horvath, Hannum, GrimAge, and other clocks) was measured in CHAMACOS study children and related to maternal adverse childhood experiences exposure.
This is a study protocol for the RENaBack multicenter RCT describing planned work, with no data reported and no epigenetic marker involved.
Cord blood DNA methylation age (Horvath and Knight clocks) was measured in the PROGRESS birth cohort and examined for association with prenatal lead exposure, a modifiable environmental exposure.
Epigenetic age (DNA methylation clocks) was measured in a randomized controlled trial of metformin and weight loss interventions in overweight postmenopausal breast cancer survivors.
This retrospective MRI study compares imaging characteristics between H3 K27M mutant and wild-type pediatric glioma groups defined by mutation status, without directly measuring an epigenetic marker.
DNA methylation-derived inflammatory measures (mdNLR and CRP-linked methylation loci) were measured in blood of a nested case-control study and related to lung cancer risk and survival.

Whole blood DNA methylome (Illumina 850K array) was directly measured in patients with different glucocorticoid states (Cushing's syndrome, eucortisolism, adrenal insufficiency) to build a diagnostic biomarker.

This retrospective exome sequencing cohort identifies pathogenic gene variants in BAF chromatin-remodeling complex subunits; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay was performed.
Genome-wide DNA methylation episignatures (Illumina EPIC array) were measured in blood of a cohort of 129 individuals with suspected chromatinopathies to improve molecular diagnosis.

This study measures allelic gene expression (imprinting status) by QCIGISH in situ hybridization as a diagnostic biomarker for lung cancer, which reflects gene expression rather than a directly measured DNA methylation or chromatin mark.
The Bladder EpiCheck test, based on DNA methylation changes in 15 genomic biomarkers, was measured in voided urine of a prospective cohort of NMIBC patients for post-treatment surveillance.
LINE-1 DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in leukocyte DNA of 488 women in this cross-sectional study and related to BMI and obesity status.

This pan-cancer bioinformatic study focuses on TMC gene expression and immunotherapy response prediction; DNA methylation is only mentioned in passing as a regulatory mechanism without being directly analyzed or reported.

DNA-methylation-derived epigenetic age acceleration was measured at midlife in a 30-year prospective cohort study and shown to moderate cortisol trajectories following childhood sexual abuse exposure.
This study of the lupus band test measures anti-chromatin autoantibodies (a serologic assay), not a directly measured DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state marker.

Newborn cord blood DNA methylation (epigenome-wide) was measured in the Drakenstein Child Health Study and associated with severe neurodevelopmental delay at 2 years, an early-detection/risk-stratification use.

450K DNA methylation profiling was used to determine molecular subgroup in medulloblastoma patients treated on this phase III trial (SJMB03), and subgroup was linked to distinct failure patterns guiding treatment strategy.

DNA methylation of immune-related genes was analyzed using individual-level TARGET/GEO osteosarcoma patient data to define immune-methylation patient subgroups linked to prognosis and immunotherapy rationale.
Genome-wide DNA methylation data from 646 individual TCGA/GEO lower-grade-glioma patients were used to build and validate a two-CpG methylation signature for prognosis and risk stratification.
The iColocomf dual-target stool DNA methylation test was measured in a multicenter case-control cohort of 1164 participants to evaluate diagnostic performance for colorectal cancer detection.
This study analyzes NF-Y transcription factor subunit expression and TCGA molecular subtypes in gastric adenocarcinoma; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is measured.

DNA methylation of TNF, IL1B, and IL6 genes was measured by EPIC array and pyrosequencing in pre- and post-neurosurgery blood of epilepsy patients to build a diagnostic index for postoperative delirium.
IL-6 promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in cumulus cells of women undergoing IVF and compared between smokers and non-smokers, a modifiable exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine were directly measured in circulating neutrophils of pregnant women and compared between normal, mild, and severe preeclampsia groups.
LEP promoter methylation was measured by MethyLight assay in formalin-fixed ovarian cancer tumor tissue and was a significant prognostic factor for recurrence and disease-specific survival.
AKT3 promoter hypomethylation was analyzed using individual-level testicular germ cell tumor methylation data (DiseaseMeth/GEO) and correlated with survival outcomes, alongside in vitro validation.
DNA methylation of three FYB gene CpG sites was measured by bisulfite-based assay in peripheral blood of a case-control study of early-stage lung cancer patients versus matched controls.
The only epigenetic-adjacent marker measured in humans is expression of the long noncoding RNA CYTOR; the chromatin-accessibility mechanism was shown only in mouse cells, not human participants.

DNA methylation profiles were measured in a reference cohort of 405 primary HNSC tumor samples and used to develop/validate machine-learning classifiers predicting the primary site of HNSC metastases of unknown origin.

Genome-wide blood DNA methylation (Illumina EPIC BeadChip) was measured before and after acupuncture treatment in a cohort of 11 burnout patients, linking methylation change to a modifiable intervention.

Cord blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) was measured at birth in a twin birth cohort and associated with dental caries and hypomineralization outcomes at age six, suggesting early risk-stratification biomarkers.

This retrospective pathology study of dermatomyositis measures myositis-specific autoantibodies and IHC muscle pathology features (including anti-Mi-2 antibodies), not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
This prospective study of a glucose management team's effect on glycaemic care in arthroplasty patients measures no epigenetic marker.
This retrospective series on esophageal differentiated-type dysplasia reports histology, TP53 mutation, and Ki-67 IHC, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Genome-wide 5-hydroxymethylcytosine profiles were measured directly in circulating cell-free DNA of a case-control study of late-onset Alzheimer's disease patients versus cognitively normal controls.
A 4-gene DNA methylation biomarker panel was measured in tissue and cell-free DNA of a case-control study to evaluate diagnostic accuracy for early pancreatic cancer detection.
DNA methylation was measured epigenome-wide in blood of 8161 individuals and associated with alcohol consumption, a modifiable exposure, with cross-validation in AUD cohorts.

Global DNA methylation (colorimetric ELISA) was measured cross-sectionally in blood of individuals from low- and high-air-pollution areas in North India and related to homocysteine and B-vitamin status.

Sperm DNA methylation (450K array and targeted CpG bisulfite sequencing) was directly measured and compared between heavy smokers and non-smokers, separate from the sperm chromatin condensation/fragmentation measures also reported.
A three-CpG DNA methylation signature was identified using TCGA lung adenocarcinoma data and validated in an independent Chinese patient cohort for prognosis prediction.
Multiple DNA-methylation-based biological aging clocks were measured in blood of Health and Retirement Study participants and used to test Black-White disparities in healthspan-related outcomes.

Alongside mouse experiments, genome-wide promoter DNA methylation at birth was measured in human cohort/RCT participants and related to maternal plasma folate and folic acid supplementation, a modifiable exposure.
Correlates 11p15 methylation difference with predicted leg-length discrepancy in a prospective cohort of hemihyperplasia/hemihypoplasia patients to guide treatment planning.
Measures NPY/WIF1 hypermethylation in matched tumor and liquid biopsy samples from colorectal cancer patients as a diagnostic/screening biomarker.
NGS mutation profiling of pediatric gliomas identifies genetic variants only; no methylation, histone or chromatin marker is measured.
Case-control study measuring APOE/ACKR3 DNA methylation in multiple sclerosis patients versus controls linked to heavy-metal blood levels.
The 'coarse chromatin' feature in this cervical cytology study is a visual cytomorphology finding, not a molecular epigenetic mark.
Study measures mitochondrial DNA copy number in Rett syndrome patients, which is not an epigenetic marker.
Multicenter cohort of over 3,000 meningiomas uses DNA methylation subgrouping to improve recurrence-risk stratification beyond WHO grading.
Histo-molecular characterization of MSI/dMMR pancreatic cancer reports mutations, including in chromatin remodeler ARID1A, but measures no epigenetic mark.
The study's own biomarker is single-cell mass; MGMT methylation is only referenced from matched genomics rather than measured as part of this assay.
Narrative review of genetic associations in type 2 diabetes complications, mentioning CLOCK gene methylation only in passing, reports no primary data.
TCGA-STAD secondary analysis integrates directly measured DNA methylation among the omics used to define prognostic gastric-cancer subtypes.
Prospective repeated-sampling study of urinary cell-free DNA methylation dynamics in metastatic NSCLC patients for detection test optimization.
Randomized controlled pilot trial measures degree of DNA methylation and TET2 as biomarkers of aging after hydrogen-rich water intake.
Retrospective cohort on distal radius fracture displacement risk factors involves no epigenetic measurement.
Isle of Wight birth cohort links grandmaternal smoking during pregnancy to differentially methylated CpGs in grandchildren.
Selection of endometrial carcinomas for p53 testing is based on nuclear morphology and p53 protein status, not an epigenetic mark.
Mass-cytometry measurement of gammaH2AX histone phosphorylation in lymphocyte subsets from ataxia telangiectasia patients versus healthy donors informs diagnostic DDR biomarker use.
STIM1 promoter indel case-control study measures genotype and ELF1 transcription-factor binding, not DNA methylation or histone modification.
Cross-sectional newborn study links maternal dietary fat composition to epigenetic age acceleration.
Long-term glioma trial follow-up analyzes MGMT promoter methylation, directly measured by Illumina 450K arrays, as a prognostic marker.
Lung cancer case-control study genotypes a DNMT3B promoter polymorphism and measures comet-assay DNA damage, not DNA methylation itself.
Pooled cohort analysis of four DNA methylation epigenetic clocks associated with incident atrial fibrillation risk.
Cohort study of placental genome-wide methylation associated with antenatal depression and stress exposure during pregnancy.
Case-control study of peripheral blood BRCA1 promoter methylation as a surrogate Alzheimer's disease biomarker.
Study identifies a stable DNA methylation signature distinguishing monozygotic twins from singletons, proposed as a retrospective diagnostic marker.
Retrospective diagnostic-accuracy comparison of urinary Bladder EpiCheck methylation test versus cytology for upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
Discovery/validation cohort of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia patients uses DREAM methylation sequencing and an SVM classifier for risk-stratified treatment.
Laboratory-wide association study of routine blood tests (calcium, albumin, ferritin, etc.) in metastatic renal cell carcinoma survival includes no epigenetic marker.
Citrullinated H3 is measured as a circulating plasma biomarker of sepsis, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Replication case-control study of CpG methylation differences associated with ACPA positivity in the CARTaGENE population biobank.
Longitudinal study of welders measures AHRR/F2RL3/B3GNTL1 methylation changes associated with welding fume exposure.
Longitudinal Framingham/ARIC cohort analysis of blood DNA methylation changes at AHRR/F2RL3 after smoking cessation.
Randomized trial of a psychosocial aftercare program for pediatric chronic pain measures pain and emotional outcomes, no epigenetic marker.
UTUC molecular profiling in aristolochic-acid-exposed patients measures miRNA/mRNA networks, the only epigenetic-type marker being non-coding RNA.
Cohort study of Bangladeshi infants measures histone H3K27ac in PBMCs linked to undernutrition and stunting.
Diagnostic-accuracy study of fecal NDRG4 methylation testing for detection of colorectal precancerous polyps.
Deep-learning MRI brain-age harmonization study predicts age from imaging, not an epigenetic clock.
Phase 1 trial of entinostat plus clofarabine reports 'global protein lysine acetylation' without specifying whether histone acetylation itself was assayed.
Prospective study of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma in wood-dust-exposed workers performs methylome analysis comparing tumor and healthy exposed/non-exposed mucosa.
Worldwide diagnostic-accuracy study of the S5 DNA methylation test for cervical CIN3/cancer triage across income settings.
Methylation profiling clusters TSC2-mutant uterine sarcomas against LGESS/HGESS comparator groups to aid diagnosis and mTOR-inhibitor treatment selection.
Randomized trial of HDAC inhibitor FRM-0334 in progranulin-related FTD measures plasma/CSF progranulin and PET imaging, not histone acetylation itself.
Dutch IMPROVE screening cohort validates ASCL1/LHX8 methylation classifiers for triage of hrHPV-positive women.
Retrospective analysis of iatrogenic immunodeficiency-associated lymphoproliferative disorders reports KMT2D/TNFAIP3 mutations, not a measured epigenetic mark.
Multi-omic ARDS mortality study includes directly measured DNA methylation data among integrated predictors of non-survivor status.
GUSTO prospective cohort measures cord tissue NECAB3 DNA methylation associated with assisted reproductive technology conception.
Chondrosarcoma epigenetic-drug study is performed in cell lines and xenografts with no human participants.
Molecular reclassification of pediatric low-grade epilepsy-associated tumors uses DNA methylation profiling compared across histological clusters for WHO diagnosis.
Randomized exercise-intervention trial measures EVL/CDKN2A/ESR1 DNA methylation in sigmoid colon biopsies.
Chordoma drug-combination screening is conducted entirely in cell lines (UM-Chor1, MUG-Chor1, U-CH1) with no human participants.
CBF-AML prognostic study reports clonal mutations including in chromatin-modifier genes (ASXL1, ASXL2), not a measured epigenetic mark.
Cross-sectional genome-wide RRBS methylation study compares nociceptive and neuropathic chronic pain patients to healthy controls.
Radiation-induced high-grade gliomas are classified by DNA methylation profiling against reference pediatric glioma subtypes to inform subgroup-directed therapy.
Case-control study of PDCD-1/LAG-3 blood methylation as colorectal cancer risk biomarkers, validated against a public methylation dataset.
Cohort-based integrative genomic profiling of 163 pediatric liver tumors reports hepatoblastoma-specific DNA methylation of enhancers for risk stratification.
Prospective study compares imprinted-gene and transposable-element DNA methylation between fresh/frozen embryo transfer and natural-conception newborns.

This bidirectional and 2-step Mendelian randomization study derives methylation-HbA1c associations from summary genetic instrumental variables in the Taiwan Biobank, not individual-level methylation data.
Methylation-specific PCR and bisulfite sequencing measure FOXD3 promoter methylation directly in primary colorectal tumors and correlate it with metastasis and prognosis.
A nested case-control study uses EPIC methylation arrays to compare high-grade serous ovarian cancer tumors, normal fallopian tube tissue, and primary-versus-recurrent disease.
A 39-case glioblastoma cohort compares methylation-array-derived MGMT promoter methylation status against methylation-specific PCR and pyrosequencing gold standards.
Anti-double-stranded-DNA and anti-histone autoantibody levels in lupus immune complexes are immunological measurements, not epigenetic marks.
Pyrosequencing measures GPVI promoter methylation in leukocytes from coronary heart disease patients and links it to GPVI expression as a candidate CHD biomarker.
A case series of 9 colorectal cancers with heterogeneous MSH6 staining (6 linked to MLH1 methylation) has no comparison group beyond intra-tumor sequencing.
KLF9 promotes neuroblastoma differentiation via the sonic hedgehog pathway, assessed by immunohistochemistry and ChIP for transcription-factor binding, not an epigenetic mark.
A phase I trial of vorinostat with gefitinib measures acetylated histone H3 protein in PBMC as a pharmacodynamic marker in BIM-deletion EGFR-mutant NSCLC patients.
Case-control comparison of DPN vs non-DPN T2DM patients measured genomic DNA methylation by LC-MS/MS in leukocytes and linked it to DPN risk stratification.
Cohort of older adults measured DNAm PhenoAge, an epigenetic clock, and related epigenetic age acceleration to health outcomes and mortality.
Retrospective case-control study measured DNA methylation by qMSP in cervical scrapings to detect endometrial cancer.
Study tracks IgG anti-nuclear antibody patterns in SLE by immunofluorescence; no epigenetic marker is measured.
ATAC-seq chromatin profiling was performed only in ICC cell lines in vitro; the human specimens were assessed solely for MFAP5 protein by immunostaining.
Case-control study measured DNA methylation in ovarian tumour tissue and cervical scrapings to build an ovarian cancer detection panel.
Prospective cohort of breast-surgery patients measured methylation of TLR4, OPRM1 and LINE1 and linked it to persistent postoperative pain phenotype.
Case-control EWAS measured 5mC/5hmC in AD brain tissue and blood, linking methylation to conversion to AD dementia.
ALSPAC cohort validated a DNA methylation alcohol biomarker (DNAm-Alc) against alcohol intake, a modifiable exposure.
Record is explicitly a protocol for a prospective observational study describing planned ovarian tissue collection, with no results reported.
Study sequences ACTG2 and identifies missense mutations in visceral myopathy; this is a genetic, not epigenetic, marker.
Multicenter cohort applied array-based DNA methylation profiling across diverse human uterine neoplasm categories as an ancillary diagnostic classifier.
DNA methylation is invoked only as background mechanism; the study itself measures anthropometrics and ultrasound intima-media thickness, not methylation.
Cross-sectional analysis of consistency across hypertension clinical practice guidelines; no epigenetic marker is involved.
Case-control and longitudinal EWAS in panic disorder patients measured DNA methylome changes associated with CBT treatment response.
Postmortem case-control RNA-seq study of bipolar disorder measured coding RNA plus lncRNA and circRNA; only ncRNA is the epigenetic-adjacent marker measured in humans.
Secondary analysis of TCGA DNA methylation and RNA-seq data built a 13-gene epigenetic signature predicting breast cancer survival.
Mechanistic study of FXYD5/TGF-beta/SMAD signalling driving ovarian cancer EMT; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Genome-wide methylation array plus bisulfite pyrosequencing compared thymoma and thymic carcinoma tissue for diagnostic methylation markers.
Flow-cytometry sperm chromatin/nuclear maturity assay measures DNA packaging and condensation, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Cohort of paired primary-recurrent GBM samples measured MGMT promoter methylation, which remained prognostic for tumour recurrence.
Secondary TCGA-SARC analysis measured CpG methylation correlated with a prognostic ITGA10/PPP2R2B gene signature in UPS/MFS.
Comparative cohort study of reoperation for recurrent GBM measured MGMT promoter methylation among covariates significantly predicting survival.
Case-control PBMC methylome study distinguished gout patients from controls, with findings replicated in an independent validation cohort.
EBADIMEX is primarily a statistical method paper demonstrated on simulated data and a TCGA cohort, not a clinical evaluation study.
Targeted next-generation sequencing identifies genomic mutations (e.g. in chromatin-modifying genes) in urothelial CIS; no epigenetic mark itself is measured.
Controlled study measured PBMC DNA methylation before/after intensive meditation versus a leisure-activity control group, a modifiable intervention.
Study measured the lncRNA HERES in a human ESCC cohort; no DNA methylation or histone modification was directly measured.
Case-control study measured GSTP1 promoter methylation and serum organochlorine pesticide exposure (modifiable) in HCC risk.
CARDIA cohort measured epigenetic age acceleration from DNA methylation and linked it to incident metabolic syndrome.
Longitudinal OAI pilot study measured PBMC DNA methylation models predicting radiographic knee osteoarthritis progression.
Postmortem case-control study of mTBI athletes versus controls measured loss of H3K27Me3, a histone modification, by immunohistochemistry in brain tissue.
Discovery and validation case-control cohorts measured blood-based DNA methylation markers (TriMeth) for colorectal cancer detection.
Retrospective cohort of pituitary adenomas measured phosphohistone-H3, a histone post-translational mark, by immunohistochemistry as a prognostic recurrence biomarker.
Biological age is estimated from genetic, clinical, metabolomic and proteomic assays; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker is measured.
Retrospective cohort of elderly GBM patients measured MGMT promoter methylation by pyrosequencing in relation to treatment outcome.
Cohort of elderly hip-surgery patients measured global leukocyte DNA methylation (5-mC) associated with postoperative cognitive dysfunction diagnosis.
GWAS of SNPs in CBP-pathway genes (HDAC2, PPARGC1A) linked to NSCLC survival; these are genetic variants, not measured epigenetic marks.
Human validation cohorts (pilot n=266, validation n=1000) measured blood DNA methylation of host genes associated with CRC-linked gut dysbiosis.
Study measures HDAC1 protein expression by immunohistochemistry in cholangiocarcinoma; enzyme expression is not a directly measured chromatin mark.
Study measures NO66 histone demethylase protein expression by immunoblot, not the histone modification it catalyses.
H3 K27M status assessed in thalamic gliomas is a genetic point mutation, not a directly measured histone modification.
Retrospective cohort of newly diagnosed GBM patients measured MGMT promoter methylation by qMSP and linked cutoff values to survival prognosis.
Study profiles genetic mutations (DNMT3A, TET2, IDH1/2, FLT3) in AML-NPM1 subgroups; these are mutations, not measured methylation marks.
Study of physiological dysregulation in helicopter pilots uses blood-chemistry biomarkers; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Discovery and validation cohorts measured genome-wide 5mC in circulating cfDNA to build HCC-in-cirrhosis diagnostic biomarkers.
Abstract does not clearly state whether SMAD3 promoter methylation compared between ADC and SCC was measured directly in patient tissue or only in cultured patient-derived fibroblasts.
Study classifies pediatric gliomas by H3 K27M mutation status and diffusion MRI; mutation status is genetic, not a measured histone modification.
Biological aging algorithms (Klemera-Doubal, Levine) here are built from blood-chemistry biomarkers in NHANES/Duke-EPESE, not DNA methylation.
Study measures MYST1 histone-acetyltransferase enzyme expression in glioblastoma tissue/cell lines, not the H4K16 acetylation mark itself.
Cohort of 491 advanced gastric cancer patients measured tumoral LINE-1 methylation by pyrosequencing as a prognostic marker.
Case-control study measured bisulfite-sequencing DNA methylation of aging-related genes in peripheral blood of COPD patients versus controls.
Study examines HMGA2 gene expression signature and a drug-repurposing screen; no epigenetic marker is directly measured.
Three human cohorts measured whole-blood MORC1 DNA methylation and related it to childhood maltreatment and depressive symptoms.
Retrospective study applied array-based DNA methylation profiling to classify histological ependymoma variants for diagnosis.
Nested case-control study within a prospective cohort measured DNA methylation risk scores predicting breast cancer incidence.
Study applied DNA methylation array profiling to pediatric pilocytic astrocytoma variants for diagnostic and prognostic classification.
Samples from the CCTG MA.12 randomised trial were used to measure GR promoter methylation as a predictive/prognostic biomarker for tamoxifen benefit.
Record is explicitly a protocol for a cluster-randomized controlled trial of an SLE guideline implementation intervention, with no data yet.
Plasma histone H4 is measured by ELISA as a circulating protein biomarker of septic cardiomyopathy, not a chromatin-state measurement.
Randomized clinical trial of vitamin D3 supplementation (modifiable intervention) measured baseline DNA methylation of CYP/VDR genes predicting serum response.
Case-control study measured GSTP1 and other gene promoter methylation in repeat negative prostate biopsies to predict missed cancer.
Cross-sectional family-based study links PEAR1 DNA methylation to platelet and leukocyte function markers, without a modifiable exposure or a listed clinical/public-health decision.
Comet assay measures DNA fragmentation/genomic instability in smokers versus non-smokers; this is strand-break damage, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Cross-sectional study of Vietnam veterans measured sperm DNA methylation by Illumina 450K in relation to Agent Orange dioxin exposure.
Two human cohorts measured DEFA5/TNF promoter methylation signatures distinguishing Crohn's disease patients from healthy controls.
Study measures MLL2 protein expression by immunohistochemistry in oral squamous cell carcinoma; MLL2 is the H3K4me3 methyltransferase, not the mark itself.

Nested case-control pregnancy cohort linked in utero PBDE exposure (modifiable) to placental DNA methylation changes and fetal growth retardation.
Phase I trial measured serum microRNA-605 expression, a non-coding RNA, correlating with treatment response; no DNA methylation or histone mark was measured.
Study measures SETD3 protein/mRNA expression in HCC patients; the DNA methylation change at the DCLK1 promoter is shown mechanistically rather than measured across the patient cohort.
Diagnostic accuracy study applied a methylation-specific quantitative melt assay (MS-QMA) to probands and controls for fragile X methylation status.
Case-control study measured RASSF1a and BRCA1 promoter methylation in circulating cell-free DNA as an ovarian carcinoma biomarker.

Cohort of CRC patients with matched tumour/mucosa measured CpG promoter methylation of DNA-repair genes linked to disease-free survival.
Abstract references 'chromatin modification' of ANO1 only vaguely; the markers actually measured are mRNA/protein expression in patient biopsies, mice and an in vitro model.

Exome/transcriptome analysis of conjunctival melanoma finds mutations in chromatin-remodelling genes (e.g. ATRX); these are genetic mutations, not measured epigenetic marks.

Study evaluates consistency between Traditional Chinese Medicine clinical practice guidelines and clinical cases; no epigenetic marker is involved.
Study measured locus-specific LINE-1/Alu repetitive-element DNA methylation in HCV-associated HCC tissue, validated against TCGA.
Twin/cohort study measured DNAm age and average DNA methylation as candidate breast cancer risk factors correlated with lifestyle exposures.

Case-control study measures BDNF promoter methylation in MDD patients versus controls in relation to neurocognitive performance, but the abstract does not clearly tie this to a modifiable exposure or a listed clinical decision rather than a mechanistic correlate.
Cross-sectional study measured skeletal muscle 5-mC/5-hmC/5-fC in bipolar patients on different pharmacologic treatments versus healthy controls.
Genomic mutation profiling in AL amyloidosis includes a point mutation in the histone gene HIST1H1E, not a measured epigenetic modification.
Study (primarily in ApoE-/- mice) measures HDAC isoenzyme protein levels in human arterial tissue, not the histone acetylation mark itself.
Coexpression network analysis of gene expression and copy-number alterations in HCC; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Cross-sectional study measured a cervical-scrape methylation signature (GynTect) alongside 3q26 amplification in CIN2/3 patients stratified by age.
Cross-sectional ARIC and Scottish cohort analyses related blood-based epigenetic age acceleration to cognitive test performance as an aging biomarker.
Immunohistochemistry shows loss of SWI/SNF complex subunit protein expression in NSCLC; this is chromatin-remodeller protein loss, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Case-control study measured genome-wide blood DNA methylation (Illumina EPIC) for AI-based detection of pediatric concussion.
TCGA cohort plus an independent validation cohort measured IDO1 promoter methylation correlated with HNSCC survival and HPV status.
Retrospective machine-learning analysis of gene-expression microarrays in multiple sclerosis; no epigenetic marker is measured, HDAC inhibitors appear only in a drug-repositioning discussion.

Randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled pilot trial of oral vitamin C in myeloid cancer patients on azacitidine measured global 5mC and the 5hmC/5mC ratio.

A computer-simulated Markov model comparing gene-PSA-guided screening strategies reports no primary human data or measured epigenetic marker.
The study analyses TCGA alternative-splicing (PSI) events in sarcoma, which is a splicing measure, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.
TET2 mRNA level was measured by real-time PCR in pediatric ALL, which is gene expression rather than a directly measured epigenetic mark.
NR3C1 promoter methylation was assayed in infant saliva within a prospective mother-child cohort linking postnatal depression exposure to methylation and child symptoms.

CDH1/GFRA1/P16/ZNF382 methylation was measured by MethyLight in urine of a prospective double-blind gastric-cancer cohort predicting metastasis.
This is a hepatitis B vaccine immunogenicity trial in diabetics with no epigenetic marker measured.
LINC00460, a long non-coding RNA, is the only marker measured in human HNSCC tissues and paired normal tissues.
MGMT promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in glioma patients and linked to a noninvasive PET-based prediction and prognosis model.
Antinuclear immunoglobulin G is an autoantibody assay in pediatric lupus, not an epigenetic marker.
A DNA-methylation-based telomere-length estimator (DNAmTL) is validated across multiple large human cohorts predicting mortality and cardiovascular disease.
MGMT promoter methylation was quantified with the MethyQESD method in glioblastoma patients and correlated with overall survival.
A 13-case series describes a new spinal ependymoma subgroup with survival compared only against previously published cohorts, not a concurrent comparison group.
NKG2D promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in HCC patients, chronic hepatitis B patients, and healthy controls for diagnostic value.
Phospho-histone H3, a histone modification, was measured by multiplex immunofluorescence on TNBC tissue microarrays and found prognostic for survival.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K array, validated by pyrosequencing) was measured in choroid plexus tumors to distinguish aggressive carcinoma from papilloma.
This randomised trial of a homocysteine-lowering supplement measured plasma homocysteine only, with no DNA methylation measured in this study.
TFPI2, SOX17, and GATA4 promoter hypermethylation was measured in primary OSCC tumors versus normal oral mucosa and linked to survival via TCGA data.
BRG1 (SMARCA4) immunohistochemistry measures loss of a chromatin-remodeling protein's expression, not a chromatin-state mark itself.
Global LINE-1 and BRCA1/PR promoter methylation was measured in blood/tumor of a population-based breast cancer cohort interacting with aspirin use and mortality.
H3K27me3, a histone modification, was measured by immunohistochemistry across normal and neoplastic thyroid tissue and associated with aggressiveness and recurrence.
This study genomically classifies myelofibrosis by mutations and cytogenetics; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state was measured.
LINC00511, a long non-coding RNA measured in human breast cancer/TCGA, drives the prognostic finding, while histone methylation was only shown in cell-line mechanism experiments.
Leukocyte LINE-1 methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in a cross-sectional study of dietary patterns in Southern Italian women.
Genome-wide blood leukocyte DNA methylation (450K array) was measured in a case-control sample of adolescents with depression and sleep symptoms versus healthy controls.
This is a methodological comparison of blood versus saliva DNA methylation profiles in healthy volunteers with no exposure or clinical-decision link examined.
Phospho-histone H2AX, a histone modification, was measured in human spermatozoa and its level was linked to live-birth outcome after assisted reproduction.
FAM19A4/miR124-2 promoter methylation was measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR across a worldwide series of invasive cervical carcinomas for diagnostic triage.
GSTP1 promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in a Kashmiri colorectal-cancer case-control study of risk modulation.
This ADAM10/EGR1 case-control genotyping study used ChIP only as an in-vitro transcription-factor binding assay, with no epigenetic marker measured in the patient cohort.
An epigenome-wide DNA methylation array was applied to saliva of European American veterans and linked to alcohol consumption.
FAM19A4/miR124-2 methylation was measured in cervical scrapes of HIV-positive South African women for CIN3+ triage strategies.
A DNA-methylation-based stemness index (mDNAsi) computed from TCGA methylation data in medulloblastoma was linked to overall survival.
RARB, RASSF1, and GSTP1 urinary methylation was measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR in a 1056-patient prostatectomy cohort predicting upstaging and upgrading.
This NF-kB SNP case-control study used ChIP only as a mechanistic binding assay for genotype variants, with no epigenetic marker measured in patients.
DNA methylation array profiling of cord tissue was measured in a Japanese birth cohort and linked to maternal PCB exposure.
LINE-1, MGMT, and hMLH1 methylation were measured by high-resolution melting in a cohort of benzene-exposed workers compared with controls.
This genome-wide SNP interaction study of tobacco-smoke exposure and childhood asthma onset cites DNA methylation from external literature rather than measuring it in this cohort.
Differentially methylated CpG sites were measured (GEO data plus the authors' own MassARRAY validation) comparing osteoarthritis cartilage to normal controls as candidate biomarkers.
SAMHD1 protein expression was measured by immunohistochemistry as a biomarker of decitabine response, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
A Horvath epigenetic-clock DNA methylation age was computed from TCGA colorectal cancer methylation data and linked to molecular subtype and survival.
This randomised trial of soluble fibre in asthma measured sputum HDAC9 gene expression, not a histone-modification state itself.
This is a pilot-study protocol paper for a self-management depression intervention, explicitly described as currently ongoing with no results yet.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assessed alongside an SNP genotype in an oral-lichen-planus case-control study linked to malignant-transformation risk.
This BORICC Follow-Up paper reports cohort recruitment and baseline characteristics rather than measured DNA methylation results.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC array) identified hypomethylated lncRNA loci in cervical cancer samples, with prognostic value confirmed using TCGA survival data.
BDNF promoter methylation was measured longitudinally in stroke patients and predicted poststroke anxiety at 2 weeks and 1 year.
MGMT methylation was measured in paired blood and tissue samples of glioblastoma trial patients, comparing detection methods for clinical monitoring.

WT1 and IGF2 promoter methylation were measured by high-resolution melting in a gastric-cancer case-control study interacting with H pylori, smoking, and alcohol.
CYP1A1 methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in coke-oven workers, mediating the effect of smoking and occupational PAH co-exposure on oxidative DNA damage.
This study measured NR2F1 protein expression and used ChIP only as a mechanistic transcription-factor binding assay, not a disease-relevant epigenetic marker.
SLC6A4 promoter methylation was measured in two independent case-control samples of panic disorder patients with and without comorbid depression.

The abstract briefly cites SLC22A1 promoter methylation from a TCGA HCC cohort, but the rest of the study is an in vitro/Xenopus/mouse transport-mechanism paper and the design of the human methylation analysis is not clear.
DNA methylation profiling was measured on Chinese NSCLC tumor tissue, validated with TCGA data, and linked to tumor mutation burden as an immunotherapy biomarker.
This is a survey of mosaic single-nucleotide variants from clinical exome sequencing, with no epigenetic marker measured.

H3K27me3 immunohistochemistry was measured in a retrospective cohort of H3K27M-mutant diffuse midline gliomas to identify new prognostic markers.

Targeted sequencing detected mutations in epigenetic-modifier genes in AML patients, but the epigenetic marks themselves were not measured.

BIN1 CpG methylation was measured by bisulfite sequencing in a Colombian case-control study of late-onset Alzheimer disease.
Plasma EBV DNA methylation was measured in a prospective NPC screening cohort, but it is unclear whether pathogen-genome methylation in a human-derived sample meets the eligible-marker criterion.
Genome-wide DNA methylation, including LINE-1 hypomethylation, was measured in AML patients from a phase I/II guadecitabine trial predicting treatment response.
EPIC-array DNA methylation was measured in oral masticatory mucosa biopsies comparing current smokers to never smokers.

ARG2 and NOS2A gene methylation were measured in a longitudinal panel study of young adults linked to PM2.5 constituent exposure.

CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR in pancreatic tumor tissue and cytology samples for diagnostic use.

p66Shc promoter methylation was measured in mononuclear cells within a randomised controlled high-intensity interval training trial (EXAMIN AGE).
DNA methylation survival CpG markers for SDPR were identified via MethHC/Methsurv mining of individual-level cancer methylation data across 17 cancer types.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation was measured in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 and linked via Mendelian randomisation to neurological plasma protein biomarkers.
Methylated septin 9 was measured in pre- and post-operative blood of colorectal cancer patients for diagnosis and postoperative monitoring.
APOE and F13A promoter methylation were measured by methylation-specific PCR in a case-control study of aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage risk.
Repetitive-element and gene-specific DNA methylation were measured by pyrosequencing before and after a 3-month aerobic-exercise intervention.
Aniline blue, toluidine blue, and sperm chromatin dispersion tests measure sperm DNA strand packaging, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, per the instrument's sperm-test exception.
EPB41L3 and HPV16 gene methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in oral gargles distinguishing oropharyngeal cancer cases from matched controls.
Monocyte methylome profiling was measured in a prospective RRMS patient cohort and linked to dimethyl fumarate treatment response.

A five-CpG methylation signature was built and validated from GEO/TCGA methylation data for thyroid cancer diagnosis.

A genome-wide blood DNA methylation signature was measured in a SMARCA2/NCBRS case-control cohort and used to classify variants as pathogenic or benign.
SLCO4C1 promoter methylation was measured (GEO/TCGA data plus the authors' own bisulfite amplicon sequencing) as a prostate-cancer recurrence biomarker.
SIRT1 mRNA expression was measured by qPCR in age-related cataract patients, not histone acetylation status itself.
This is an epidemiological analysis of diabetes prevalence and insulin-pump use in the Czech Republic with no epigenetic marker measured.
FOXK2 protein expression and mechanistic ChIP-based transcription-factor assays were used in this colorectal-cancer metastasis study, with no epigenetic disease-marker measured in the cohort.
Global blood %5-methylcytosine and %5-hydroxymethylcytosine were measured in children exposed to incinerator dioxins versus unexposed controls.
DNMT3A promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in a large papillary thyroid carcinoma cohort and linked to aggressive clinical outcome.
IFNG gene methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in a case-control study of Graves' disease and Hashimoto's disease and linked to intractability/prognosis.
This PCOS iPSC-derived and primary granulosa-cell methylation array case-control study investigates pathogenesis mechanism without a stated screening, diagnosis, or treatment decision link.
Cohort study measuring DNA methylation-based DNAmPhenoAge acceleration and its association with smoking pack-years, an eligible modifiable-exposure link.
Cross-sectional study measuring MSP methylation of several genes in pediatric pyeloureteral-junction surgical samples to assess prognostic/diagnostic value.
Genome-wide methylation array compared ectopic/eutopic endometriosis tissue with healthy-control endometrium, informing diagnosis/treatment of endometriosis.
Only leukocyte telomere length was measured; telomere length is not one of the eligible epigenetic marker categories.
Narrative overview of biomarkers 'assessed in occupational cohorts' with no specific study population, design, or new data reported here.
Offspring blood DNA methylation measured directly in 2821 individuals from five prospective birth cohorts, linked to maternal smoking exposure and disease outcomes.

Uses in vivo/in vitro/ex vivo/organoid models plus a patient cohort for classification but does not specify an eligible epidemiological design or which measurements were made directly in human tissue.
Two-sample Mendelian randomization drawing methylation-disease associations purely from GWAS summary statistics, the explicit no-individual-level-data example.
Biological age score built from metabolic and periodontal biomarkers; no epigenetic marker is measured.

Radiomic classifier trained/validated against TCGA- and Stanford-cohort DNA methylation subtypes (individual-level data) to guide treatment-relevant subtype identification.
NICU genetic-diagnosis cost study; no epigenetic marker of any kind is measured.

Clinical-practice-guideline contextualisation methodology study; no epigenetic marker measured.

Histone marks (H3K9ac/H3K27ac/H3K4me3/H3K9me3) at the ZNF518B locus are analysed, but the abstract does not make clear whether this was done in patient tissue or only in CRC cell lines.
Case-control genome-wide DNA methylation study (49 vs 51) of antituberculosis drug-induced liver injury, a treatment-related adverse-event risk marker.

Case-control study comparing NKCC1/KCC2 promoter methylation between refractory temporal lobe epilepsy patients and healthy controls, relevant to disease classification.

Comparative TCGA-derived methylome analysis of IDH-mutant vs wild-type gliomas (and other cancers), with methylation status as a prognostic marker.

Paediatric asthma guideline-adherence audit; no epigenetic marker is measured.

Study of predictors of prehospital scene time; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Tumour-vs-control ACE gene methylation measured by MSP in colorectal cancer samples, with prognostic association via Cox regression.

Discovery-validation cohort study (including TCGA, n=478, and 254 radical prostatectomy samples) of GBX2 promoter methylation as a biochemical-recurrence predictor in prostate cancer.

MEND study design/methods paper; recruitment ongoing and methylation data 'are expected by the end of the study period', with no primary methylation findings reported.

Retrospective/prospective prevalence study of clinically and molecularly diagnosed imprinting disorders; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic assay result is reported.

Population-based HPV-screening cohort using FAM19A4/miR124-2 DNA methylation triage, with 14-year CIN3+ risk as the clinical-decision link.
