Case-control study of neural-tissue global DNA hydroxymethylation (5hmC) in neural tube defect cases vs controls, linked to PAH exposure.
Nested case-control study within the EPIC-Italy cohort measuring leucocyte DNA methylation as a mediator between Mediterranean diet and colon cancer.
Biological age constructed from physiological biomarkers (eGFR, FEV1, etc.); no epigenetic marker is measured.
Cross-sectional survey measuring GNASAS/IGF2/IGF2-R/IL10/LEP methylation as a mediator between birth weight and adulthood obesity in Chinese women.
Case-control bisulfite-sequencing study of peripheral blood methylation in familial/early-onset breast cancer patients vs unaffected controls/carriers.
Longitudinal veteran cohort measuring Horvath/Hannum DNAm age acceleration as a prognostic marker for metabolic syndrome.
New HRM assay for ABCB1 promoter methylation evaluated in breast/ovarian carcinoma patients pre/post chemotherapy, with prognostic correlation to progression-free survival.
DepthFinder is a bioinformatics read-depth tool benchmarked on reference sequencing datasets across species; no human clinical evaluation sample.
TCGA-based retrospective cohort study deriving and validating a four-CpG DNA methylation signature predicting melanoma survival.
Epigenome-wide association study in 5841 individuals linking dietary folate/B-12 intake (modifiable exposure) to blood DNA methylation.
Case-control study (57 gout patients vs 103 controls) measuring blood COMT methylation as a candidate diagnostic biomarker for gout.
Circulating extracellular histones measured in ICU patient serum as toxicity mediators, a circulating-protein readout rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Multi-institution retrospective cohort using tumour DNA methylation profiles to build/validate a nomogram predicting meningioma recurrence for adjuvant-therapy decisions.
Double-blind RCT of broccoli-sprout-extract supplementation measuring prostate tissue H3K18 acetylation and blood HDAC activity.
Diagnostic-accuracy study comparing the methylation-based Bladder EpiCheck test with cytology/cystoscopy in NMIBC follow-up.
Small case-control study (6 GDM/6 PE/6 controls) profiling inflammation-gene promoter methylation in pregnancy, with stated clinical-application relevance.

DNMT1/PRMT6 protein levels (not the DNA/H3R2 methylation marks themselves) were assessed by immunohistochemistry in human colon tumours; the actual epigenetic marks were measured only in mouse models.
Immunohistochemical detection of H3K27M mutant protein, ATRX loss, p53 and IDH1 status in pediatric GBM measures mutant proteins, not a directly assayed histone modification.
LifeLines cohort epigenome-wide study of occupational gases/fumes and mineral-dust exposure and blood DNA methylation in never-smokers.
Retrospective glioblastoma cohort reporting MGMT promoter methylation status alongside MRI texture features, methylation used as a prognostic stratifier.
KMT2C mutation status was determined by sequencing; this is a genetic mutation of a histone methyltransferase gene, not a measured histone modification.
Urinary histone 4 protein levels measured by proteomics as a circulating biomarker, not a chromatin-state assay.

Genetically predicted DNA methylation levels are tested against breast cancer risk using large GWAS summary statistics (122,977 cases/105,974 controls), the summary-statistics-only design explicitly excluded.
10-year cohort study of PBX3 promoter methylation in peripheral blood leukocytes as a colorectal cancer prognostic marker.
Case-control study (100 vs 100) of colorectal aberrant crypt foci including MGMT hypermethylation among the molecular features tested for CRC-risk biomarker validity.
HIPO-HNC cohort (n=87) with TCGA validation measuring RYR2 promoter methylation across normal-dysplastic-cancer HNSCC samples, linked to malignant-conversion risk assessment.
GWAS of PPARG SNPs and pharmacosurveillance of thiazolidinedione exposure in osteonecrosis; no epigenetic marker is directly measured.
HEALS cohort epigenome-wide study of arsenic-contaminated drinking-water exposure and whole-blood DNA methylation in Bangladeshi adults.

DNA methylation was profiled in polymyositis/dermatomyositis muscle biopsies, but the abstract does not state a clear comparison group or analytic design for these human samples versus the in vitro infection model.
Molecular subtyping of colon cancer stages uses gene-expression consensus molecular subtypes and MSI status; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Primary measurement is a transcriptome-based molecular brain-age gauge; the DNA methylation age gauge is only cited as an external correlate, not measured in this study's cohorts.
Longitudinal cohort measuring salivary AVP methylation in pregnant/postpartum women in relation to psychosocial stress and sleep disturbance.
Retrospective cohort (80 GBM) measuring MGMT promoter methylation by MSP, an established prognostic marker for recurrence-free survival.
Transcriptomic gene-expression signature and genomic score for prostate SC/NE-like tumours; no epigenetic marker is measured (HDAC-inhibitor sensitivity only tested in vitro).
Combined miRNA/methylation marker panel (miMe) with methylation markers measured by qPCR in radical-prostatectomy tissue across three cohorts, predicting biochemical recurrence.
Radiogenomic correlation of somatic mutations (TP53, FAT1, KMT2D) via sequencing; mutation of a chromatin-modifier gene is not itself a measured epigenetic mark.
Cross-sectional diagnostic study measuring PBMC 5-mC/5-hmC levels combined with carotid plaque score for coronary atherosclerosis diagnosis.
Two-cohort study measuring dynamic FKBP5 methylation changes in blood following a dexamethasone challenge, an experimental pharmacological intervention.
PDX-derived gene-expression signatures validated in a glioblastoma clinical cohort; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Case-control study (100 GC, 50 CAG, 45 controls) measuring serum/tumour RASSF10 promoter methylation as a diagnostic and prognostic indicator.
Case-control study of gallbladder disease measuring XRCC1/hOGG1 promoter hypermethylation alongside oxidative-stress markers, with prognostic significance stated.
Institutional plus TCGA cohort study identifying ZNF492/GPR149 hypermethylation as independent prognostic markers in ccRCC, validated by pyrosequencing.
Retrospective cohort (300 CRC vs 54 normal) plus TCGA validation measuring preoperative serum methylated septin 9 as a diagnostic/prognostic/monitoring marker.
Entinostat efficacy and HDAC-dependent mechanism were tested in orthotopic allograft and patient-derived xenograft mouse models, not in human participants.
Cross-sectional study of night-shift workers measuring oxidative/methylated DNA base damage and telomere length; no eligible regulatory epigenetic marker is described.
H3K27Ac/H3K4Me3 were measured at the RUNX2 P1 promoter in 16 NSCLC patient tumours, but no comparison group or analytic design is stated for this human tissue series.
Diagnostic comparison of NanoString, IHC/FISH, and DNA methylation array for molecular subgrouping of medulloblastoma, informing risk-stratification.
Case-control study (discovery + validation) of peripheral blood genome-wide DNA methylation differences between infertile and fertile men, proposed as a screening marker.
Prospective multicenter blinded clinical trial of the DNA-methylation-based Bladder EpiCheck test for NMIBC surveillance.
Comparison of sperm DNA fragmentation assays (SCSA vs SCD); sperm DNA integrity tests are explicitly not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
RCT (NCT02661789, 30 GnRHa vs 30 placebo) generating longitudinal DNA methylation (450K array) data alongside gene expression in a pharmacological hormone-manipulation intervention.
Cohort of surgically treated ccRCC patients with 450K methylation profiling of ZNF278/FAM155A/DPP6 linked to metastasis risk.
Phase 1b HDAC-inhibitor trial reports no measured epigenetic marker; pharmacodynamic biomarker assessment was inconclusive.
Cross-sectional 450K methylation comparison of famine-exposed versus control blood samples links a modifiable in-utero exposure to DNA methylation.
Case-control MSP methylation panel in DLBCL versus lymphoid hyperplasia tied to survival and chemoresistance.
Medical-record audit of URTI guideline adherence measures no epigenetic marker at all.
Colorectal cancer subtyping relies solely on gene expression profiling, no methylation or histone data.
GIDB is a curated knowledge database built by text/data mining, not a primary human study.
VISTA/HIF1a hypoxia work is chromatin IP in a mouse tumor model; the human cohort only assessed VISTA/HIF1a protein correlation.
Retrospective GBM cohorts profiled by methylation array yield a 7-CpG signature predicting temozolomide response.
Epigenome-wide 450K case-control study validated in two replication cohorts identifies a diagnostic methylation marker for atherosclerotic stroke.
Only miR-376a (a microRNA) and HDAC9 mRNA/protein were assayed in HCC tissue; no DNA methylation or histone mark was measured.
Matched case-control immunohistochemistry of 5mC and multiple histone marks in human fetal/infant brain tissue links prenatal alcohol exposure to global epigenetic changes.
Abstract centers on a novel mediation-testing statistic and does not clearly state whether the Norwegian cohort application used individual-level methylation data.
Study measures serum vitamin/homocysteine levels in head-and-neck cancer, not any epigenetic mark.
Genomic analysis of sarcomatoid bladder cancer covers mutations and expression only, no methylation or histone data reported.
Chart review of BWS twin phenotypes does not report any direct methylation or imprinting assay.
Case-control Sequenom methylation validation links CASP8 promoter hypomethylation to PAH exposure and neural tube defects.
This is a trial protocol describing planned inspiratory-muscle-training methodology, not measured data.
Cambridge Prognostic Groups model uses PSA/grade/stage only; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Cross-sectional EPIC array study of 426 placentas ties maternal socioeconomic adversity to differential CpG methylation.
Vasculogenic mimicry experiments are conducted entirely in TNBC cell lines with entinostat, no human participant samples.
Cohort of IUGR versus AGA neonates measures cord-blood global 5-mC methylation as a diagnostic biomarker.
SOCS3 promoter methylation tracked by bisulfite sequencing across pediatric ALL disease stages versus healthy controls.
Prospective NHS/HPFS cohort stratifies dietary fiber-CRC associations by directly assessed CIMP methylation phenotype.
High DNA stainability from the sperm chromatin structure assay reflects strand packaging, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, per the explicit sperm-assay exclusion.
EZH2 and EMT markers are assessed by immunohistochemistry as protein expression, not as a measured histone modification.
US Normative Aging Study cohort compares a CpG-based mortality score against DNAm-clock aging biomarkers for predicting mortality.
MGMT promoter methylation was measured as part of profiling but the abstract's reported results concern only PIK3CA mutation, leaving the methylation-outcome link unstated.
Case-control 450K methylation array in newborn blood builds an AI-derived diagnostic predictor for cerebral palsy.
Four-patient descriptive case series of long-surviving GBM with no comparison group.
EWAS of blood methylation against circulating inflammatory proteins in a general cohort has no stated exposure/intervention or clinical-decision link.
Cross-sectional Japanese cohort links dietary vegetable intake to ABCA1 promoter methylation by pyrosequencing.
Blood methylation episignatures in ADNP syndrome patients are used to build and validate a diagnostic classifier.
RICHS cohort EWAS of placental methylation tests night-shift work, a modifiable occupational exposure, against CpG sites.
German Glioma Network cohort combines methylome and transcriptome data to define prognostic LGG subtypes.
DNA methylation array was one of several profiling assays in this DIPG registry, but reported target findings involve gene fusions rather than the methylation results specifically.
Case-control 450K methylation array compares post-mortem schizophrenia and control brain tissue for diagnostic-relevant differences.
Adamantinoma sequencing study reports mutation and expression profiling only; KMT2D alteration is genetic, not a measured epigenetic mark.
TCGA/Rennes training-validation cohorts identify a 5-CpG miRNA-methylation risk score prognostic for non-G-CIMP GBM survival.
METTL3 promoter hypomethylation is shown only in a pancreatic cell-line model; the only marker measured in human tissue is miR-25-3p expression.
Retrospective transplant cohort compares hypomethylating-agent treatment outcomes without measuring any methylation marker itself.
Prospective MARBLES cohort whole-methylome analysis of placenta identifies CYP2E1/IRS2 methylation associated with later ASD diagnosis.
Eighteen-cohort analysis relates education and lifestyle exposures to epigenetic clock and stochastic-epigenetic-mutation aging biomarkers.
Urinary hypermethylation signature validated across a male screening cohort and mixed-gender replication sets for noninvasive urothelial cancer diagnosis.
The abstract does not specify whether the in-house H3K27me3 ChIP-seq data came from patient tissue or cell lines, so the eligible-marker material is unclear.
Case-control blood methylation study of SLC6A4 promoter compares alcohol-dependent individuals and healthy controls.
ADC imaging is used to noninvasively predict H3 K27M mutation status; no epigenetic mark is directly measured.
Case-control MSP methylation of p16/MGMT promoters links pesticide serum levels, a modifiable exposure, to colorectal cancer.
NOVI preterm cohort ties buccal-cell DNA methylation and epigenetic age to neurobehavioral profile classification used for monitoring.
Rotterdam Study biological-age composite uses CRP, creatinine and other physiological markers only, no epigenetic assay.
Methylation microarray comparison of sinonasal inverted papilloma versus arising carcinoma tissue identifies malignant-transformation biomarkers.
WT1 expression by immunohistochemistry is correlated with pre-existing H3 K27M subtype classification but no epigenetic mark is newly measured here.
Case-control MSP methylation of RASSF1A/p14ARF in leukocytes distinguishes CRC and IBD subtypes from controls for early-detection use.
Sister Study prospective case-cohort 450K analysis with EPIC-Italy replication links blood methylation to invasive breast cancer risk.
Prospective validation of SPARCL1 promoter hypermethylation in upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma tissue is tied to recurrence outcome.
Cross-sectional comparison of e-waste-exposed and reference workers' blood methylation array data links PCB exposure to differential methylation.
Human cord-blood mtDNA methylation is linked to mitochondrial-peptide levels rather than directly to the prenatal air-pollution exposure, leaving the exposure-marker link unclear.
Rett syndrome study measures epidermal nerve fiber density only, no methylation or histone assay.
AGO-TR1 observational cohort pairs BRCA1/PALB2/RAD51C promoter methylation with somatic variant testing to guide targeted-therapy selection.
Case-control 450K placental methylation study builds an AUC-validated biomarker panel for tetralogy of Fallot detection.
Prospective SJYC07 trial cohort uses EPIC methylation array classification of ependymoma tied to progression-free survival outcomes.
Retrospective cohort study of PDCD1 promoter methylation in Merkel cell carcinoma is an independent prognostic factor for overall mortality.
SP1/LOXL2 chromatin immunoprecipitation is performed in a pancreatic cancer cell line; human tissue analysis is limited to protein immunohistochemistry.
Case-control bisulfite sequencing of cumulus granulosa cell DNA methylome distinguishes PCOS from control women.
Matched case-control RRBS methylation profiling compares young MI patients with and without recurrent cardiac events.
Pancreatic cancer gene-panel sequencing reports somatic mutations including KMT2 family genes, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Citrullinated histone H3 is assayed as a circulating NET biomarker in plasma, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
AML prognostic panel genotypes DNMT3A/FLT3/NPM1/CEBPA mutations rather than measuring DNA methylation itself.
PCNSL transplant-conditioning outcome study reports no epigenetic marker measurement.
Prospective NHS/HPFS cohort examines calcium intake, a modifiable dietary exposure, against colon cancer risk stratified by tumor CIMP methylation status.
PRMT5 expression and localization are assessed by immunohistochemistry as protein levels in human breast tumors, not as a measured histone mark.
Cross-sectional hrHPV-positive cervical scrapes combine a miRNA classifier with directly measured FAM19A4 DNA methylation for CIN3 triage.
Cross-sectional Brazilian cohort links ADRB3 promoter methylation in leukocytes to trans-fat dietary intake, a modifiable exposure.
Longitudinal PCOS cohort measures methylated versus unmethylated insulin-gene cell-free DNA as a candidate biomarker for progression to type 2 diabetes.
Bariatric surgery cohort measures GHRL/NAMPT/FAS promoter methylation in peripheral blood before and after a very-low-calorie diet and sleeve gastrectomy intervention.
Retrospective cohort of resected esophageal cancers uses pyrosequencing of tumor LINE-1 methylation tied to immune infiltration and prognosis.
Only miR-204 expression is measured across medulloblastoma cohorts; no DNA methylation or histone mark is assessed.
Serum-based ddPCR assay measures DNA methylation of the miR-134b/c locus in circulating DNA to diagnose malignant pleural mesothelioma.
NAMPT-AS, a lncRNA, is the epigenetic-category marker measured in the human breast cancer cohort; the cited histone marks come from public ENCODE/FANTOM5 reference data, not patient samples.
EPIC cohort 450K analysis of leukocyte methylation tests dietary folate and alcohol intake, both modifiable exposures, against CpG methylation.
Case-control study of malignant versus benign breast tumors measures BRCA-1/MGMT/P16 promoter methylation and H3K9ac/H3K18ac/H4K20me3 histone marks tied to survival.
Sister Study discovery and replication EWAS directly tests alcohol consumption, a modifiable exposure, against blood and breast-tissue DNA methylation.
Multi-cohort EWAS identifies a peripheral-blood methylation signature of hepatic fat that functions as a candidate risk biomarker for type 2 diabetes.
SOX gene family methylation profiling in endometrial carcinoma tissue and TCGA cohort links SOX11 hypermethylation to microsatellite instability and diagnosis-relevant subtyping.
Generation Scotland EPIC-array cohort study of respiratory function identifies differentially methylated sites that improve COPD risk prediction.
HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer study reports mutations in chromatin-regulator genes (KMT2C/D, CREBBP, EP300), not a measured methylation or histone mark.
DACHS discovery and replication cohorts perform epigenome-wide methylation profiling of colorectal tumors stratified by oestrogen receptor beta expression.
Case-control study of dental implants measures global 5mC by immunohistochemistry and links it to titanium dissolution, an environmental exposure.
Population-based cross-sectional study compares post-colonoscopy and detected colorectal cancers on CpG island methylation among other molecular features relevant to surveillance.
Genome-wide peripheral blood methylation classifier is validated for diagnosing syndromic neurodevelopmental disorders in an unresolved patient cohort.
RRBS methylation profiling compares African-American and Caucasian prostate cancer patients and links methylation clusters to recurrence and survival.
Histone H4 acetylation flow-cytometry assay is validated across in vitro, healthy-volunteer and single-arm ependymoma trial blood samples without a clear comparative epidemiological design.
Case-control study of blood BDNF promoter methylation compares major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder and healthy controls.
Project Viva and Generation R cohorts test maternal antidepressant use and mood symptoms against cord-blood DNA methylation with childhood follow-up.
Cross-sectional comparison of pesticide applicators and unexposed controls measures CDKN2B/CDKN2A promoter methylation by pyrosequencing.
Descriptive cross-sectional mapping of KvDMR1 methylation across normal pregnancy tissues has no stated exposure or clinical-decision link.
SETD2 tag-SNP genotyping study assesses genetic polymorphism, not measured H3K36 methylation itself.
TCGA and multi-cohort validation link PCDH17 promoter hypermethylation in AML leukemic stem cells to overall survival.
Small randomized-assignment exercise/ginseng-supplementation study measures H3K36 histone methylation in human skeletal muscle biopsies.
Cohort of breast cancer tumor versus adjacent normal tissue measures gamma-H2AX by immunohistochemistry, an eligible histone mark per the instrument's explicit example, tied to TNM staging.
Compares DAPK1 promoter methylation between breast tumor and paired normal tissue in 128 patients, linking methylation to clinicopathological features as a candidate diagnostic/prognostic marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K array) is compared in obese vs non-obese children's blood in a cohort, relating methylation to the obesity outcome.
The only marker actually measured in human prostate epithelium is piRNA (non-coding RNA); the VDR ChIP-seq assesses transcription-factor binding sites, not DNA methylation or histone modification.
OGDHL promoter methylation is measured by qMSP in paired tumor/adjacent-normal tissue from 40 colorectal cancer patients and evaluated as a diagnostic biomarker via ROC analysis.
Global DNA methylation (5-mC%) is measured in blood of stunted vs non-stunted children and related to dietary intake, a modifiable exposure.
Case-control methylation profiling (autism/schizophrenia cohorts vs population controls) identifies rare epivariations as potential disease-risk markers.
Study measures sperm aneuploidy (FISH), whole-exome sequencing, and gene expression (RNA-seq) in infertile men; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is reported.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is compared in placenta of VSD-affected vs unaffected term infants, proposed as a detection biomarker for a congenital heart defect.
IL12B CpG-island methylation is measured and compared between 99 ankylosing spondylitis patients and 99 healthy controls, evaluated by ROC for diagnostic discrimination.
DNAm age (epigenetic clock) is computed from genome-wide methylation in a small case-control aging pilot study and correlated with behavioral/health measures.
CpG methylation at four sites is correlated with GDF11 expression and overall survival using primary and TCGA-UVM individual-level data in uveal melanoma.
Compares decitabine (a hypomethylating agent) with intensive chemotherapy in elderly AML by clinical outcomes only; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker was measured.
DRD2 promoter methylation is measured by pyrosequencing in high- vs low-familial-risk offspring, linked to brain structure as a risk-stratification marker for alcohol dependence.
Study examines a DNMT3L coding variant, vitamin B intake, cognition and in-silico protein modeling; DNA methylation itself is not reported as measured in participants.
Abstract attributes reduced gene expression in CD8+ T cells to 'histone deacetylation' without stating that a histone modification or chromatin assay was actually performed.
SDC2 stool-DNA methylation test is evaluated for sensitivity/specificity in a large prospective colorectal cancer screening cohort with clinical trial registration.
DNA methylation profiling classifies 27 astroblastoma cases into molecular subgroups that differ significantly in overall survival, a prognostic cohort design.
Presents the bigmelon R software package for large-scale methylation-data analysis; this is a technical/bioinformatics tool paper, not a human evaluation study.
Genome-wide DNA methylation is compared between FASD cases and controls across discovery and replication cohorts to identify diagnostic/prognostic loci.
TP53 promoter methylation is assessed by methylation-specific PCR alongside mutation analysis in 74 DLBCL patients, contributing to prognostic characterization of the cohort.
Promoter methylation of CDKN2A/APC/MLH1 and LINE-1 is measured in blood of construction workers versus unexposed workers, linking methylation to an occupational/environmental exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation is compared between newborns with orofacial clefts and controls, linked to periconceptional folic-acid exposure as the modifiable factor.
Study genotypes PHLDB1 SNPs in a case-control design; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark is measured, only a bioinformatic prediction that one SNP overlaps a CpG site.
H3 K27M is detected as a genetic mutation by immunohistochemistry for the mutant histone protein, not as a measured histone modification/chromatin mark.
Epigenome-wide methylation study identifies and pyrosequencing-validates CpG sites discriminating Behcet's disease patients from controls as diagnostic markers.
DNA methylation array is included in multi-omics profiling of matched diagnosis-relapse BCP-ALL samples (cohort design) to characterize relapse-specific molecular alterations.
Neoadjuvant soy isoflavone trial measures LINE-1 methylation change by pyrosequencing in HNSCC patients, a non-randomised interventional design linking methylation to a modifiable intervention.
Precision-medicine trial for DIPG relies on whole-exome/RNA sequencing and ctDNA H3K27M mutation detection; no epigenetic mark (methylation or histone modification) is directly measured.
Methylation profiling (EPIC array) compares 18 high-myopia cases with 18 matched controls, an eligible case-control design directly measuring DNA methylation.
SOX12 study measures gene/protein expression and metabolic pathway activity in colorectal cancer; no DNA methylation or histone modification is assayed.
The only marker measured is lincRNA-p21, a long non-coding RNA, with no DNA methylation or histone modification assay reported.
HDAC-inhibitor belinostat is evaluated by MRI/clinical outcome in a small human pilot alongside animal experiments; no histone acetylation or other epigenetic marker was measured in patients.

Abstract does not specify whether CpG island methylator phenotype status was itself measured by this study or only cited as an existing TCGA annotation alongside the gene-expression classifier that is the actual focus.

A new SFRP2 MethyLight assay measures promoter methylation in paired tumor/paracancer tissue and serum from colorectal cancer patients versus normal individuals, assessed for screening sensitivity/specificity.
Phase II trial of a tumor-cell vaccine with CpG-B adjuvant and IFN-alpha assesses immune activation and clinical response; CpG-B is a therapeutic oligonucleotide, not a measured epigenetic marker.
Methylation at two CpG sites is examined against LGALS3 expression and survival using online (TCGA-derived) individual-level glioblastoma data, a secondary-analysis prognostic design.
Single-patient case report of a novel NUP98-LEDGF AML rearrangement monitored by RT-PCR; a case report is excluded regardless of the epigenetic background discussion.
HOXA9 promoter methylation is measured by qMSP in 145 paired HNSCC/normal tissue plus TCGA validation, evaluated for diagnostic value (AUC).
A DNA-methylation-based epigenetic BMI score is derived and tested in the Lothian Birth Cohort against health outcomes, linking methylation to the modifiable BMI/obesity exposure.
Prospective screening study tests a blood DNA-hypermethylation biomarker (Colvera, BCAT1/IKZF1) alongside FIT for detecting colorectal precursor lesions.

Core classifier for medulloblastoma subgrouping is gene-expression-based (TLDA); methylation array is used mainly as an existing reference/validation standard, so it is unclear whether DNA methylation is the marker being evaluated for the clinical decision.
In-vivo HDAC-inhibitor trial in HIV+ individuals assesses NK-cell phenotype and function; no histone acetylation or other epigenetic marker is measured as an outcome.
Blood DNA methylome (450K) is compared between AUD and healthy control subjects and correlated with insular surface area, a case-control design directly measuring methylation.
Whole-blood methylation of VIM/CXCR4/DOK7/SPDEF genes is measured and compared between 60 breast cancer patients and 40 healthy controls as diagnostic/prognostic biomarkers.
Genome-wide promoter methylation is compared in skeletal muscle of lifelong physically active versus sedentary aged men, linking methylation to the modifiable exercise exposure.
H3 and H4 histone acetylation are measured by ChIP in 173 term placentas and linked to maternal olive oil and fish intake, modifiable dietary exposures.
DNA methylation at 30 breast-cancer genes is measured in blood of daughters with prenatal DDT exposure data in a prospective cohort, linking methylation to the DDT exposure.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is measured in blood and linked to long-term ambient air pollution (PM10, NO2) exposure in a Korean adult cohort.
Three epigenetic-clock measures are computed from methylation data in a TILDA sub-sample and compared with allostatic load as candidate biological-embedding mechanisms for socioeconomic position.
CHST7 methylation is measured in white blood cells and associated with colorectal cancer risk, validated in an independent GEO dataset, proposed as a risk biomarker.
MTHFD1 promoter methylation is measured by qMSP and compared between hypertensive stroke cases and hypertensive controls, with diagnostic AUC/sensitivity/specificity reported.
Children's Oncology Group ependymoma trial uses DNA methylation profiles to classify posterior fossa molecular subgroups and relates this classification to event-free survival.
NR3C1 promoter methylation is measured in postmortem brain of physically abused versus non-abused children, linking methylation to the early-life-stress exposure.
PDCD1 promoter methylation is measured and compared between 206 rheumatoid arthritis patients and 234 controls alongside expression and genotype data.
Whole-exome sequencing is performed on established multiple myeloma cell lines and EBV-immortalized B-cell lines; this is an in-vitro cell-line study with no primary patient samples analyzed.

Randomized controlled trial in children with cow's milk allergy measures FoxP3 and cytokine gene methylation before/after two dietary interventions, directly linking methylation to a modifiable treatment.
Genome-wide and exome-wide association studies identify NUDT15/TPMT genetic variants linked to thiopurine myelosuppression; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker is measured.
Targeted bisulfite sequencing measures DNA methylation in cardiac tissue across heart-failure subtypes versus non-failing controls, proposed as a diagnostic/therapeutic target.
DNA methylation and H3K27ac/H3K4me3 histone modification changes at the DLEU1 locus are measured using TCGA and cohort tumor data and linked to cancer prognosis.
Blood DNA methylome is measured in non-atopic asthma cases versus controls from the SAPALDIA cohort, examining effect modification by BMI, a modifiable exposure.
MGMT-unmethylated status is used only as a cohort inclusion criterion; the study's actual analysis relates postoperative tumor volume, not methylation, to survival.
DNA methylation data (secondary analysis of ICGC/TCGA individual-level data) is compared between mucinous and ductal breast cancer to identify MUC2 methylation as a subtype-distinguishing mechanism.

DNA methylation array profiling is used as a diagnostic classifier for adult brain tumors across roughly 1550 patients, changing or refining the histological diagnosis in the majority of referred cases.
MGMT promoter methylation is measured by HRM and compared between lung cancer cases and controls, linked to lung cancer risk in a case-control design.
Cohort study of wartime parental separation and later work-career outcomes; no epigenetic marker is measured, only administrative pension/employment records.
Blood DNA methylation (850K) is measured in pediatric Crohn's disease patients versus controls at diagnosis and follow-up, linked to disease progression and treatment response.
Urinary DNA methylation (CRIP3) combined with miRNA is measured in prostate cancer patients on active surveillance to predict reclassification, a monitoring application.
Randomized controlled trial of folic acid supplementation in pregnancy measures epigenome-wide and pyrosequencing-validated DNA methylation changes at ZFP57 in cord blood.
Phase 2 trial of eltrombopag in hypomethylating-agent-failure MDS reports platelet/survival outcomes only; DNA methylation itself is not measured in this study.
FHIT and p16 promoter methylation is measured by MSP and compared between liver cancer patients and non-hepatoma controls as an independent risk factor.
p66shc promoter hypomethylation is reported as associated with flow-mediated dilation in human coronary artery disease patients versus healthy controls, alongside the primary mouse mechanistic work.

NAC-supplementation trial in infertile men measures sperm chromatin integrity (protamine/CMA3, TUNEL DNA fragmentation), which the instrument specifies as DNA damage/packaging assays, not epigenetic marks.
Genome-wide leukocyte DNA methylation is measured in a Philippines cohort and associated with socioeconomic status across development, an exposure-linked cross-sectional design.
A polyepigenetic DNA methylation score for smoking is validated longitudinally in two birth cohorts, directly linking methylation to the modifiable smoking exposure.
G0S2 promoter methylation is measured by qPCR/bisulfite sequencing in an independent cohort of adrenocortical tumors, explicitly proposed for routine clinical decision-making.
Posterior fossa ependymoma subgroups are assigned by genome-wide methylation array and H3K27me3 immunoreactivity, then related to long-term survival and neurocognitive outcomes.
Methylation data (from GEO/TCGA individual-level datasets) is analyzed to show hypomethylation drives SLC6A6 overexpression, linked to gastric cancer prognosis.

DNA methylation and H3K27me3 histone methylation are described as regulating tumor-suppressor lncRNAs, but the abstract does not make clear whether these marks were measured directly in patient tissue or only in the in-vitro mechanistic experiments for the single validated gene.
Randomized, double-blind, repeated-measures trial measures global and gene-specific (PPARGC1A, IL6) DNA methylation in leukocytes before/after aerobic exercise and fatty-acid supplementation.
Longitudinal epigenome-wide DNA methylation is measured in blood of African American cohort participants and linked to smoking status, a modifiable exposure.
Phase 2 trial of pracinostat (an HDAC inhibitor) plus azacitidine in AML reports clinical response and somatic mutation clearance; histone acetylation or methylation is not measured as an outcome.
DNA methylation array profiling of 28 brain tumors identifies a distinct methylation class for papillary glioneuronal tumor, used diagnostically against a large reference cohort.
A mathematical model parameterized on clinical MGMT promoter methylation data from primary and recurrent glioblastoma is used to inform optimal temozolomide dosing, a treatment-selection application.

Chromatin immunoprecipitation and chromosome-conformation-capture assays showing SND1-driven chromatin topology changes are mechanistic experiments, while the 187 patient gliomas were assessed only by protein immunostaining, not by a direct chromatin assay.
Global DNA methylation is measured by a KASP-linked analysis in benzene-exposed shoe-factory workers versus unexposed controls, linking methylation to an occupational exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is measured in cord blood and cord tissue of preterm versus full-term infants in a large birth cohort, identifying biomarkers of gestational age/prematurity.
GEO gene-expression and DNA-methylation data are integrated (secondary analysis of individual-level case-control data) to build blood-based Parkinson's disease classifiers.
Genome-wide 6-methyladenine DNA modification is measured by 6mA-IP-seq in PBMCs of SLE patients versus healthy controls, proposed as an early diagnostic marker.
MASPIN promoter methylation is measured by MSP and compared across cholelithiasis, gallbladder cancer, and control tissue, correlated with survival.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EWAS) is measured in the ALSPAC cohort and tested against multiple modifiable in-utero/postnatal exposures as a potential mediator of childhood ALL risk.
MST1/Hippo promoter methylation is measured by methylation-specific PCR in 223 patients from the MAPS phase 3 mesothelioma trial and evaluated for prognostic value.

Describes development of a novel single-base methylation quantification assay, technically validated against existing methods in only 10 colorectal cancer samples with no case-control clinical evaluation.
C8orf76 study measures gene amplification, lncRNA induction, and MAPK/ERK signaling via sequencing and reporter assays; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured.
Single-center retrospective survival study of glioblastoma treatment evolution over two decades; no epigenetic marker is measured.
AHRR (cg05575921) leukocyte DNA methylation is measured in 465 lung cancer patients and tested for association with survival in a prospective cohort.

Promoter DNA methylation changes are listed among several multi-omic TCGA features correlated with radiomic imaging, but the abstract does not establish methylation itself as directly linked to a specific clinical decision rather than an incidental correlate.
Repressive H3K27me3 histone methylation is measured via EZH2 recruitment in postmortem human amygdala of early- versus late-onset alcohol-use-disorder cases and age-matched controls.
Study measures leukocyte telomere length, which is not one of the eligible epigenetic markers (DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or epigenetic clock).
MLH1 promoter hypermethylation is measured and used to subgroup mismatch-repair-deficient colorectal carcinomas, linked to prognosis and a fusion-screening strategy.
Gene-specific promoter DNA methylation of M1/M2 macrophage markers is measured by MS-HRM and compared between 25 coronary artery disease patients and 25 controls.
Primary work is an in vitro/xenograft functional screen of miR-30 with TCGA methylation and copy-number data used only as ancillary correlative support, not a described human cohort design.
TANK methylation is linked to a genotype and brain-imaging phenotype, not to a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public-health decision.
Only CHAF1B mRNA/protein expression and downstream p53 signalling were measured; no DNA methylation or histone modification was assayed.
Cross-sectional genome-wide DNA methylation analysis in blood from two human cohorts relates methylation to self-reported insufficient sleep and shift work, a modifiable exposure.
ALSPAC birth cohort DNAm profiles at multiple ages are related to childhood/adolescent psychotic experiences as candidate early-identification biomarkers.
A cohort of 30 glioblastoma patients had MGMT promoter methylation measured by MSP and related to temozolomide treatment response and survival.
Retrospective single-group case series of 104 meningioma patients correlating IHC markers with each other, with no comparison group or exposure/outcome design.
Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing in liver and blood distinguishes Wilson disease patients from healthy and disease controls and correlates with phenotype, a case-control diagnostic design.
Only HAT1 mRNA/protein expression and its transcriptional regulation of PD-L1 were assessed; no histone acetylation mark itself was measured.
Blood DNA methylation-derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio was measured in a retrospective cohort of pediatric medulloblastoma patients and related to survival.
A retrospective cohort of 702 CRC/EC patients had MLH1 promoter hypermethylation assessed as part of a paired tumor/germline Lynch syndrome diagnostic algorithm.
A longitudinal cohort of Iowa adoptees had blood methylation at the smoking-associated CpG cg05575921 measured and linked to smoking exposure and all-cause mortality.
The population-based SHIP cohort (n=3965) had FKBP5 methylation measured and related to genotype, childhood maltreatment, and depression.
Paired breast cancer/para-cancer tissue had LPAR6 promoter CpG methylation measured and related to molecular classification and prognosis.
Longitudinal epigenome-wide methylation study compared active, remitted, and non-eating-disordered women, tracking state-related methylation changes.
This is a cross-disorder GWAS of psychiatric traits; chromatin activity is inferred from public annotation enrichment, not directly measured in these subjects.
Human IGF-II promoter CpG methylation was measured by MSP in HCC, para-cancerous, and distal noncancerous liver tissue and linked to diagnostic biomarker potential.
ZNF326 transcriptionally activates HDAC7 and alters beta-catenin acetylation, but no histone modification itself was assayed, only enzyme/protein expression.
This study reports UCHL1 protein expression and functional re-expression experiments; the CpG hypermethylation mentioned is prior literature, not measured here.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating serum NET biomarker in tuberculosis patients, a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Paired gastric cancer/margin tissue had CDX1, CDX2, and KLF5 promoter methylation measured by methylation-specific sequencing and related to gene expression as a cancer biomarker.
Liver biopsies from AATD patients had genome-wide 5-methylcytosine measured and compared with normal liver, cirrhosis, and HCC to stratify liver disease risk.
A case-control study of 959 CHD cases and 514 controls measured BAX promoter methylation by qMSP and tested its association with CHD risk.
German population-based cohort had blood promoter methylation at oxidative-stress genes measured and linked to cancer incidence and mortality outcomes.
CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR across small bowel cancer, colorectal cancer, and non-cancerous tissue as a prognostic marker.
A retrospective cohort of 48 glioblastoma patients had MGMT promoter methylation status measured and correlated with imaging features for pretreatment prediction.
Peripheral blood methylation of LDLR, SREBF2, and ABCA1 was measured in patients undergoing cardiac CT and related to coronary heart disease risk stratification.
The only human epigenetic marker measured is microRNA-551a expression in breast carcinoma samples; no DNA methylation or histone modification is assessed.
A prospective cohort study measured methylation of eight candidate CpG markers in EsophaCap cytology samples to build a diagnostic model for Barrett's esophagus.
DNAm GrimAge, a DNA methylation-based epigenetic clock, was validated across thousands of individuals and shown to predict lifespan and healthspan outcomes.
Multiple spatially separated biopsies from 12 glioblastoma patients had genome-wide DNA methylation measured to characterize intratumor heterogeneity affecting MGMT-based classification.
Human neural tube defect cases and controls had PAX3 methylation measured and its degree correlated with maternal PAH exposure levels.
A longitudinally monitored patient cohort of pre-invasive lung carcinoma-in-situ lesions had methylation profiled to predict progression versus regression.
A single-center trial of the Lunasin intervention in ALS patients directly measured blood histone H3/H4 acetylation before and after treatment.
H3 K27M is a genetic mutation status used with imaging features to build a classifier; no histone modification level was directly measured.
A twin study measured DNAm age (Horvath clock) and examined its relationship to genetic/environmental factors including leisure-time physical activity.
A prospective multi-center cohort measured a urine methylation biomarker test (Bladder EpiCheck) and evaluated its impact on surveillance decision-making for bladder cancer.
This study genotypes TLR9 promoter SNPs and correlates them with immune activation in HIV patients; no DNA methylation or histone mark was measured.
The Framingham Heart Study cohort had blood methylation at smoking (cg05575921) and alcohol (cg04987734) CpGs measured and tested against all-cause mortality.
This is a genetic analysis of F9 gene variants and mosaicism in hemophilia B pedigrees; no epigenetic marker was measured.
MLH1 promoter hypermethylation status was confirmed in a large retrospective colorectal carcinoma cohort and linked to a targetable kinase-fusion subgroup relevant to treatment selection.
This is a single-patient case report of an exceptional chordoma response, explicitly excluded as a case report despite measuring H3K27 trimethylation.
A case-control epigenome-wide study of RPE from 25 AMD and 19 control donor eyes measured DNA methylation at specific loci associated with AMD.
DNA methylation microarray profiling alongside lncRNA expression was performed on diagnosis and relapse BCP-ALL patient samples to define molecular subtypes for classification.
A case-control epigenome-wide study of Yucheng cohort offspring measured blood DNA methylation related to perinatal PCB/PCDF exposure levels.
A prospective cohort of adolescents undergoing spine fusion had blood DNA methylation measured with MethylationEPIC arrays and related to chronic postsurgical pain outcomes.
This is a discussion/perspective piece on using real-world evidence in clinical practice guidelines, reporting no primary epigenetic data.
TCGA and an independent validation cohort of ovarian cancer patients had ZNF671 DNA methylation measured and linked to recurrence prognosis.
A prospective cohort study measured SHOX2 gene body methylation in tissue and circulating cell-free DNA to risk-stratify renal cell carcinoma patients.
This is a retrospective autopsy case series of six AAV patients with no comparison group, despite immunostaining for citrullinated histone H3.
A birth cohort study measured cord blood genome-wide DNA methylation and related it to maternal swimming pool exposure during pregnancy.
Mass spectrometry and hMeDIP-sequencing measured 5-hydroxymethylcytosine and 5-methylcytosine in CLL patients versus naive/memory B-cells as a diagnostic hallmark.
Sequential tumor samples from 62 breast cancer patients undergoing extended neoadjuvant aromatase inhibitor therapy had 5mC/5hmC measured to monitor treatment response and resistance.
A TCGA endometrial cancer cohort had ESR1/PGR promoter methylation measured and linked to DNMT3A/3B overexpression and disease-free survival.
A case-control study of 100 CAD patients and 100 controls measured C3 promoter methylation by bisulfite sequencing to test association with coronary heart disease risk.
This is a retrospective single-arm case series of 12 Ewing sarcoma patients evaluating an outpatient chemotherapy protocol, with no epigenetic marker or comparison group.
Only mRNA expression of genes including HDAC1 was measured by qPCR in colorectal cancer patients; no histone acetylation mark itself was assayed.
Genome-wide and targeted DNA methylation was measured in muscle-invasive bladder tumors and validated in two cohorts to predict nodal metastatic risk.
PER2 and POMC gene methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in blood of moderate, binge, and heavy drinkers and linked to alcohol motivation.
A cross-sectional study of men undergoing fertility assessment measured sperm LINE-1, H19, and LIT1 DNA methylation and linked it to urinary phthalate exposure.
An ALSPAC birth cohort epigenome-wide association study measured DNA methylation at three life stages in relation to parental socioeconomic position.
Individual-level methylation microarray data from GEO and TCGA were compared between type-2-diabetes samples and controls, and HCC samples and controls, to find shared methylated genes.
Genome-wide nasal epithelium DNA methylation was measured in Puerto Rican children and replicated in two cohorts to classify atopy and atopic asthma.
This exposome-wide association study measures endocrine-disrupting chemical levels against semen quality; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
The only marker profiled is a microRNA panel (miR-23a, miR-27a) associated with survival in bladder cancer patients; no DNA methylation or histone mark is measured.
Chornobyl clean-up workers versus controls had gamma-H2AX histone phosphorylation measured by flow cytometry and correlated with radiation dose exposure.
Alu repeat methylation was measured by droplet digital PCR in hematologic malignancy patients versus healthy donors for diagnostic/prognostic profiling.
Archived colorectal cancer tumor samples from prior MGMT-methylated trials had MGMT status reassessed by methyl-BEAMing methylation quantification and correlated with survival after temozolomide.
A case-control study measured APOE promoter methylation by qMSP and found it associated with coronary heart disease risk in men.
A population-based cohort of 762 colorectal carcinomas had MLH1 promoter methylation status used to distinguish Lynch-like syndrome from Lynch syndrome and sporadic cases.
A TCGA lung adenocarcinoma/squamous cohort had methylation at two PHD2 CpG sites measured and linked to overall and recurrence-free survival.
This is a laboratory xenotransplantation study of MDS-derived mesenchymal stromal cells assessing hematopoietic engraftment, not a described human cohort/case-control design.
TET1/2/3 mRNA and protein expression were measured in endothelial progenitor cells, but the resulting DNA hydroxymethylation/demethylation status itself was not assayed.
The Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 had Horvath and Hannum epigenetic age acceleration measured and related longitudinally to inflammatory biomarker trajectories.
This study uses immunohistochemistry, microsatellite instability, and germline mutation screening for Lynch syndrome testing; no DNA methylation assay is reported.
This is a phase I/Ib neoantigen vaccine trial in glioblastoma measuring T-cell responses; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Neonatal foreskin tissue from smoking versus non-smoking mothers had chemerin DNA methylation measured and linked to in utero cigarette smoke exposure.
This is a transcriptional profiling study of Cryptococcus fungal isolates from HIV/AIDS patients; no epigenetic marker in the human host was measured.
A Mendelian randomization analysis measured DNA methylation at the AHRR locus directly in the individual-level ALSPAC cohort in relation to BMI and smoking behavior.
This study applies genetically predicted DNA methylation levels to ovarian cancer GWAS summary statistics rather than individual-level case data, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
A pilot feasibility study measured Prader-Willi syndrome methylation status by methylation-specific PCR on newborn screening card DNA from confirmed cases and controls.

Among the human markers measured (sperm DNA fragmentation, protamine expression, seminal miRNA), only the seminal plasma microRNA profile is an eligible non-coding-RNA marker, so ncrna_only applies over the excluded chromatin-integrity tests.
Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from premanifest and manifest Huntington disease patients versus controls had gamma-H2AX histone phosphorylation measured as a disease biomarker.
This study defines a gene-expression signature (DHITsig) in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma by RNA sequencing; no epigenetic marker was measured.

This is a cohort-profile/consortium description of the ColoCare study's recruitment and biospecimen infrastructure, referencing previously published DNA methylation associations rather than reporting its own primary analysis.
This study scores micronuclei and condensed chromatin morphology in buccal cells of dental technicians by cytogenetic assay, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
A TCGA hepatocellular carcinoma cohort (363 samples) had DNA methylation integrated with expression via MethylMix to build a prognostic epigenetic driver signature.
TMEM196 methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in lung cancer tissue, plasma, and sputum samples and tested as a diagnostic/prognostic biomarker.
A case-control study measured global DNA methylation by ELISA in children with tuberculosis versus healthy controls as a potential diagnostic biomarker.

Although mir-192 promoter hypermethylation was measured in human HCC tissue, it is presented as a mechanistic driver of cancer stem cell phenotype rather than linked to a modifiable exposure or clinical decision.
A 40-CpG DNA methylation classifier was developed and validated in a diagnostic comparison series of human melanomas versus nevi for melanoma diagnosis.
Placental tissue from late-onset preeclampsia versus normal pregnancies had CD39 and ZDHHC14 gene body methylation measured by MassARRAY EpiTYPER.
A randomized exercise intervention in healthy women measured KIR2DS4/KIR3DL1 promoter methylation in NK cells before and after acute and chronic exercise.
This is a registry-based survival analysis of statin/NSAID use in glioma patients; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Bone marrow samples from AML patients and controls had AWT1 promoter methylation measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing and linked to remission outcome.

The abstract blends a theoretical re-methylation model with an illustrative check in a human famine-exposed cohort, without describing the underlying cohort's design or comparison groups clearly enough to classify.
Sperm DNA fragmentation was measured by SCSA in relation to seminal HPV status, a DNA strand-breakage assay rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark per the instrument's explicit rule.
Primary versus recurrent glioblastoma samples had MGMT methylation assessed among established epigenetic markers and linked to treatment-relevant immune profiling.
Pooled data from 4,041 glioblastoma patients across four randomized trials had MGMT promoter methylation quantified to define a treatment-selection cutoff for omitting temozolomide.
A randomized double-blind controlled trial in obese adults measured DNA methylation and MeCP2 levels in monocytes before and after juçara berry supplementation.
Retrospective cohort of paired primary/recurrent GBM measuring MGMT promoter methylation by methylation-specific PCR and relating it to treatment response, recurrence and survival.
Case-control study (67 OSCC patients vs 59 normal controls) measuring p16 promoter methylation by MSP and linking it to HPV/smoking status and classification of patients for treatment.
Cross-sectional diagnostic accuracy study of a DNA methylation marker panel (GynTect) in cervical scrapes compared against histology to detect cervical cancer/CIN.
HDAC1 was assessed by immunohistochemical protein expression as a prognostic factor, not as a measured histone modification or other eligible epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation genes (DNMT3A, TET2 etc.) were assessed only for mutation status by NGS; no methylation or other epigenetic mark was directly measured.
Retrospective study of 77 acromegaly patients measuring GSTP1 promoter methylation and relating it to resistance to somatostatin analog treatment.
Cross-sectional study measuring FAM19A4 methylation by qPCR in cervical samples across CIN grades to evaluate diagnostic performance for cervical (pre)cancer.
This is a study-design/rationale paper describing planned recruitment and analyses for the Mood and Methylation twin study, with no primary data reported yet.
Human breast carcinoma samples (NACT-treated and pretherapeutic) with MLH1/MSH2 promoter methylation quantified and linked to chemotolerance/prognosis.
The study centers on SUMO3 depletion and DNA double-strand break repair in irradiated tumors; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or other eligible marker was measured.
Study measures blood levels of toxic elements (Cr, Mn, Ni, etc.); no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Randomized controlled trial of nut consumption in which total sperm DNA methylation was measured as a prespecified outcome alongside semen parameters.
Retrospective validation study using bisulphite pyrosequencing of an 11-gene methylation panel to detect ulcerative-colitis-associated dysplasia/cancer in human colonic samples.
Diagnostic-accuracy study measuring a six-gene urinary DNA methylation panel (ProCUrE) by MethyLight assay to identify clinically significant prostate cancer.
Post hoc analysis of a phase 3 RCT measuring serum free methylated GSTP1 DNA and relating it to survival and treatment response in prostate cancer.
Prospective cohort (Project Viva) epigenome-wide study of cord-blood DNA methylation in relation to maternal CRH exposure, with persistence tested into childhood.

Prospective cohort measuring tumor-tissue DNA methylation (450K array) and identifying a differentially methylated region (CRACR2A) linked to self-reported vigorous physical activity and cancer progression.
HSPA2 and ADAM2 are sperm surface/heat-shock proteins used as fertility biomarkers; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin measure was assessed.
Pharmacological GnRHa-manipulation study measuring genome-wide DNA methylation change relative to placebo and relating it to depressive symptoms.
SWI-SNF and ATM alterations are genomic mutations identified by sequencing; no direct measurement of an epigenetic mark (methylation, histone modification, chromatin state) is reported.
Case series of 30 SMARCA4-deficient thoracic sarcomas characterized by immunohistochemical protein loss, without a comparator group forming one of the eligible designs.
Case-control comparison of DNA methylation (5mC) at the SLC6A4 promoter between mother-child pairs with and without major depressive disorder.
Case series of 3 osteoclast-like giant cell lung carcinomas with histone H3 immunostaining used only as a lineage marker, with no comparison group.
Retrospective cohort of 37 recurrent glioblastoma specimens in which MGMT promoter methylation status was analyzed alongside histopathologic variables for association with overall survival.
Cross-sectional comparison of coal-exposed vs non-exposed workers measuring global DNA methylation (5-mdC by HPLC) in blood, linking occupational exposure to methylation change.
Retrospective study comparing promoter methylation (hMLH1, MGMT, P16) across normal endometrium, atypical hyperplasia and carcinoma to characterize the carcinogenesis pathway.

HOXC10/VEGFA/PRMT5 mechanism was established in xenograft and endothelial-cell models; the human glioma cohort data reported only a correlation of HOXC10/VEGFA expression, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Chromatin integrity was assessed by sperm chromatin structure assay (DNA fragmentation index), which the instrument specifies measures DNA strand breakage rather than an epigenetic mark.
Study profiles plasma metabolites by mass spectrometry for breast cancer detection; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Nested case-control study within a prospective cohort measuring epigenome-wide blood DNA methylation prior to lung cancer diagnosis.
Randomized controlled trial substudy quantifying γH2AX foci (a histone modification) in irradiated lymphocytes as a biomarker of radiosensitivity in nasopharynx cancer patients.
Case-control study comparing methylation-specific PCR results for HOXD11/PCDHGB6 in oral epithelium between lung cancer patients and controls for risk stratification.
Study of motivational factors and 'biological age' calculated from morphological/functional fitness indices; no epigenetic marker (e.g., DNAm clock) was measured.
Epigenome-wide DNAm study associates DRD4 methylation with physical aggression as a behavioral trait, without linking it to a modifiable exposure/intervention or a clinical/public-health decision.
Case-control study measuring SHMT1 promoter methylation by qMSP in essential hypertension patients versus controls, with ROC analysis for diagnostic value.
Retrospective series quantifying LINE-1 methylation by bisulphite pyrosequencing in sinonasal papillomas/carcinomas, linked to occupational exposure and prognosis.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial (escitalopram) measuring NR3C1 exon 1F methylation in ACS patients and relating it to depression risk and treatment outcome.
Case-control study (163 mesothelioma cases vs 137 controls) with genome-wide blood DNA methylation array used for diagnostic biomarker discovery in asbestos-exposed subjects.

Retrospective TCGA-LGG cohort in which individual-level DNA methylation data were analyzed for correlation with HSPG2 expression and prognosis, a permitted secondary analysis of human methylation data.
DNA methylation-based classifier (BrainMETH) developed from methylomes of human brain-metastasis specimens and validated by quantitative MSP against tissue of origin.

Abstract lists 'DNA methylation' among molecular changes integrated across HPV analytes but reports no specific methylation results, leaving unclear whether an eligible marker was actually measured versus only referenced.
Abstract describes a resource of methylomes from brain-metastasis specimens without a stated comparison/grouping or analytic design, so eligibility as a specific analytic study cannot be determined.
Case-control EWAS comparing DNA methylation in lean versus obese women, replicated in obesity-discordant twins, addressing obesity as a modifiable condition/intervention target.
Retrospective cohort of 497 colorectal cancers assessing CpG island hypermethylation (methylator phenotype) status stratified by patient age for implications in young-onset disease.
Retrospective TCGA/GEO cohort analysis in which CDC20 DNA methylation was examined and shown to predict overall survival in DLBCL, a permitted secondary use of individual-level methylation data.
Retrospective analysis of a randomized medulloblastoma trial using an Illumina 450k/MS-MIMIC DNA methylation classifier to define molecular subgroup and risk-stratify patients.
Retrospective cohort of 70 pituitary adenomas quantifying TERT promoter methylation by MS-HRM and relating it to disease progression and progression-free survival.
Cohort of treatment-naive glioblastoma patients in which MGMT promoter methylation status was analyzed together with MRI radiomics for association with overall survival.
Randomized trial substudy measuring blood DNA methylation (CRHR1, NR3C1) before and after CRF1-antagonist treatment in PTSD patients, related to treatment outcome.
Cohort of 141 endometrial cancers in obese versus non-obese patients showing DNA hypermethylation of GJA1 and related loci associated with obesity.

Study validates that DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility profiles are preserved in patient-derived xenograft models of T-ALL, a model-validation design rather than one of the five eligible human study designs.
Cohort study (Generation Scotland, n>4900) clustering blood DNA methylation patterns by smoking exposure, dose and cessation duration.
Biological age here is derived from body-composition/fitness variables in a national nutrition survey; no epigenetic marker is reported.
Case-control study (2444 CRC cases/3130 controls) classifying tumors by CpG island methylator phenotype and relating it to NSAID/aspirin use.

DNA methylation and histone acetylation changes at RANKL/OPG were shown only in an in vitro osteoblast cell line; the human bone-tissue analysis measured only expression of chromatin-modifying enzymes, not the marks themselves.
Case-control study (200 CRC vs 200 controls) measuring P16 and MGMT promoter hypermethylation by MSP and correlating it with disease severity.
HMGB1 is a non-histone nuclear protein measured by ELISA/qPCR/IHC as a serum and tissue biomarker; it is explicitly not a histone modification or other eligible mark.
Case-control genome-wide and candidate-gene (TLR1/2/4) methylation study comparing active tuberculosis patients to controls for biomarker discovery.
Cohort study (Melbourne Collaborative Cohort Study) measuring genome-wide blood DNA methylation in relation to physical activity and television viewing time.

Retrospective cohort of small intestinal adenocarcinoma in which promoter hypermethylation of USP10/p14ARF was directly measured in a subset of human tumor/normal tissue pairs and linked to protein loss and prognosis.
Cytomorphological description of mucinous gallbladder adenocarcinoma; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Citrullinated histone H3 is used as a NET marker by immunohistochemistry, which the instrument specifies is a protein/NET assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Secondary analysis of pooled public blood DNA methylation datasets (708 and 2711 subjects) examining sex-biased methylation acceleration linked to smoking and drinking.
Population cohort measuring epigenetic age acceleration (an epigenetic clock) directly in blood alongside telomere length, shown to independently predict all-cause mortality.
N6-acetyl-L-lysine is measured as a free circulating plasma metabolite by mass spectrometry, not as a chromatin-associated histone acetylation mark.
Extracellular histones are measured as circulating DAMP proteins in ECMO patients' plasma, not as a chromatin-state measurement.
Study examines an MCP-1 promoter genetic polymorphism (rs1024611) and its association with mRNA expression; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark is measured.
Case-control study (38 ovarian cancer vs 25 controls) using NGS and HRM/PCR to measure cadherin gene (CDH10/13/18) methylation for potential screening biomarkers.
Case-control genome-wide methylation study (450K array, 12 vs 12, validated in 40 vs 40) in congenital hypopituitarism identifying diagnostic CpG markers.
Case-control study measuring RELN promoter methylation in schizophrenia patients versus controls and relating methylation level to cognitive functioning.
SETD7 is a histone methyltransferase enzyme measured as a secreted/tissue protein biomarker by ELISA and IHC; the histone modification it catalyzes was not itself measured.
DNMT1/3A/3B were assessed by immunohistochemical protein expression in tamoxifen-treated breast tumors, not as directly measured DNA methylation status.
MDP1 is a mycobacterial DNA-binding protein used as a serologic antigen for tuberculosis diagnosis; it is a bacterial protein, not a human epigenetic mark.
Case-control genome-wide sperm methylation study (450K, deep sequencing) comparing infertile and fertile men to identify infertility-associated methylation signatures.
Retrospective cohort of 152 resected hepatocellular carcinomas measuring H3K36me3 (a histone modification) by immunohistochemistry, associated with tumor grade and survival.
Case-control study (25 GDM vs 30 controls) measuring adiponectin locus DNA methylation in maternal adipose/blood and offspring, linked to gestational diabetes.
Study compares fasting-blood indices of beta-cell function after pancreatectomy; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Cohort of 209 multiple sclerosis patients measuring BDNF CpG methylation and relating it to survival to a disability milestone (EDSS 6).
Secondary analysis of public 450K datasets from dietary-supplementation intervention trials (folic acid+B12; flavanols) showing altered Horvath epigenetic-clock age.
International cohort (n=237) measuring TERT promoter hypermethylation (THOR) alongside TERT mutation status, linked to bladder-cancer recurrence and progression.
Model-building study using sperm DNA methylation array data (329 samples) to predict chronological age, with an exploratory smoking-exposure association noted.
The abstract explicitly states as a limitation that no methylation or BRAF mutation was measured in polyps or normal mucosa.
Describes an ongoing clinical trial protocol (recruitment underway, results pending) to evaluate antiaging practices using methylation age, with no primary results reported.
Epigenome-wide study across two cohorts (Normative Aging Study, KORA) identifying blood DNA methylation loci associated with longitudinal lung-function decline, linked to smoking exposure.
Retrospective melanoma cohort measuring PD-L1 promoter DNA methylation and relating it to PD-L1 expression, overall survival, and potential hypomethylating-agent therapy.
Study of ED adherence to pneumonia/sepsis treatment guidelines; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Cohort of 48 glioblastoma patients comparing multiple MGMT promoter methylation assays for their ability to predict survival/temozolomide response.

Abstract states the miR-145-5p promoter is hypermethylated but does not make clear whether methylation was directly measured in the clinical cohort or only inferred, so the eligible-marker measurement cannot be confirmed.
Sperm chromatin integrity is assessed by Sperm Chromatin Structure Assay (%DFI/%HDS), which the instrument specifies reflects DNA strand breakage rather than an epigenetic mark.
Cohort of 453 trauma-exposed veterans/civilians measuring DNA-methylation-based age (DNAm age) alongside telomere length in relation to PTSD severity.
Human pancreatic cancer tissue versus normal tissue compared for CpG methylation and expression of KMT2D, linked to prognosis, alongside functional cell-line/xenograft validation.
Study characterizes CEBPA and chromatin-modifier gene mutations by targeted sequencing in AML; no DNA methylation or histone modification is directly measured.
Retrospective cohort of 1076 breast cancer cases from the Genomic Data Commons in which Horvath DNA methylation age was calculated and shown to predict recurrence and mortality.
Phase 1 dose-escalation trial of the HDAC inhibitor CXD101 assessing safety/pharmacokinetics; no histone modification or other epigenetic mark was measured as an endpoint.
Biological age is estimated from a validated 10-biomarker algorithm with no epigenetic (DNA methylation) component described in the abstract.
Cohort of 177 advanced ovarian cancer specimens (plus TCGA validation) measuring CDH1/DLEC1/SFRP5 promoter methylation by MSP as a prognostic panel.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial (MAVIDOS) measuring perinatal RXRA locus DNA methylation by pyrosequencing in cord tissue following maternal vitamin D supplementation.
Cohort of 131 AML patients versus 29 controls measuring ITGBL1 promoter methylation by RQ-MSP/BSP, linked to prognosis and monitoring of remission status.
Retrospective comparison of partial resection versus biopsy survival outcomes in glioblastoma; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
Extracellular histone and HMGB1 are measured as circulating DAMPs in ICU patients' plasma, not as a chromatin-state measurement.
CpG island methylator phenotype appears only as a subgroup-stratification covariate for the smoking-immune cell density association, not as the object of an exposure or clinical-decision link.
A four-gene urinary methylation panel (HOXA9/PCDH17/POU4F2/ONECUT2) was developed and validated in a case-control cohort of hematuria patients to diagnose bladder cancer.
CCND2 promoter hypermethylation was directly measured in patient tumor/plasma samples and TCGA data and shown to be an independent prognostic factor.
The core findings on H3K27ac-driven senescence signaling are from mouse osteogenic cells, with only a supplementary in vitro confirmation in human umbilical cord MSCs and no human participant design.
LINE-1 methylation patterns were measured in peripheral blood of methamphetamine users versus controls and linked to methamphetamine use and paranoia.
Leptin promoter (C-300) methylation was measured in smokers' blood before and after a smoking-cessation intervention.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assessed in glioblastoma patients and was associated with overall survival.
KITLG methylation was related only to cortisol stress reactivity, a physiological trait, and its tested link to childhood trauma as a candidate exposure was not significant.
Citrullinated histone H3 was assessed as a neutrophil extracellular trap and inflammation marker rather than as a chromatin-state readout.
AOX1 and IRF4 promoter methylation were measured in peripheral blood leukocyte DNA in a breast cancer case-control study with tested environmental interactions.
ARID1A status was assessed by immunohistochemical protein expression and loss, not by direct measurement of chromatin state or methylation.
A novel MGMT promoter methylation pyrosequencing analysis model was validated for predicting treatment response and prognosis in glioma patients.
This is a registered trial protocol describing planned methylation-of-oxytocin/serotonin-gene analyses, with no data yet reported.
No epigenetic marker of any kind is discussed; the study concerns antibiotic prescribing patterns for gastroenteritis.
Two established smoking-associated blood DNA methylation CpG sites, cg05575921 and cg03636183, were measured and used to validate an EMR-derived smoking phenotype.
Only somatic mutations in histone/chromatin-remodeling genes were identified by whole-exome sequencing; no methylation or histone modification was directly measured.
MLH1 promoter methylation was measured in resected colorectal tumors and used to classify sporadic MSI-H cancers with prognostic implications.
The title and text explicitly describe this as a protocol for a planned case-control observational study, not completed primary data.
This describes the design of the N2M2 umbrella phase I/II trial with biomarker-stratified treatment arms, without reporting completed trial outcomes.
Methylated SEPT9 was measured in plasma across colorectal cancer stages and adenomas and evaluated for detection and monitoring utility.
This is a differential gene-expression bioinformatics analysis of thyroid tissue via GEO2R; no epigenetic marker was directly measured.
DNA methylation of the IGF2-H19 and SNRPN imprinted regions was measured in fetuses and spermatozoa from assisted reproductive technology groups versus controls.
This is a technical reliability study of DNA methylation stability over one year with no modifiable exposure, intervention, or clinical decision tested.
Decreased MCT4 promoter methylation was measured in TCGA and independent patient cohorts and was associated with worse overall survival in urothelial carcinoma.
Histone H3/H4 acetylation and H3K4/H3K27 methylation were measured by ELISA in PBMCs of psoriasis patients before and after biological drug treatment and linked to treatment response.
A panel of DNA methylation markers was measured in cervical samples from an hrHPV-positive screening cohort and validated as a triage test for CIN2+.
Glucocorticoid receptor gene promoter methylation was measured in infant cheek swabs and linked to maternal breastfeeding behavior, a modifiable exposure.
It is unclear whether CpG island methylator phenotype/methylation was assessed directly in the 637-patient tissue-microarray cohort or confined to the separate 11-cell-line mechanistic experiments.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was used to build predictors of modifiable lifestyle factors such as smoking and alcohol that were shown to predict all-cause mortality.
Whole-genome DNA methylation age (Horvath and Hannum clocks) was measured in a randomized controlled trial of vitamin D3 supplementation in overweight/obese adults.
This is a workshop summary paper reviewing seven separate analytical approaches applied to the GAW20 dataset, not a single primary study.
Genome-wide DNA methylation at specific CpG sites was measured pre- and post-fenofibrate therapy in the GOLDN study and linked to triglyceride levels and drug treatment.
A methylation-derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio was computed from DNA methylation in a nested case-control study and linked to lung cancer risk in heavy smokers.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiling was performed on tectal glioma patient tumors and used to establish it as a distinct diagnostic entity.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiling was performed on 78 WNT-medulloblastoma patient samples and shown superior to routine methods for diagnostic verification.
Chromatin-remodeling gene expression by RT-PCR, not methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state itself, was measured in gastric mucosal samples.
DNA and chromosome damage assays (comet and micronucleus) were measured; condensed chromatin describes cytological morphology, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
P16 promoter methylation and hydroxymethylation were measured prospectively in patients with oral epithelial dysplasia to predict malignant transformation.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was measured in blood and saliva in a case-control study and linked to ambient organophosphate pesticide exposure.
This is a genomic and cytogenetic characterization (fusion detection, copy number) of ependymomas; no methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state was measured.

It is unclear whether methylation density of the HBV viral genome counts as an eligible human epigenetic marker, and the study's primary design is dietary-questionnaire validation rather than a clearly stated analytic design.
DNA methylation of CD11a and CD70 was measured in CD4+ T cells of SLE patients versus healthy controls, alongside the circRNA findings.
CpG methylation of host-associated HPV genome regions was measured by sequencing in cervical samples from a nested case-control study and linked to CIN3 triage.
MGMT promoter methylation status combined with IDH1 mutation was used to classify glioblastoma patients in a multi-institutional cohort with prognostic validation.

This is a survey of perceived implementation gaps for a TBI rehabilitation guideline; no epigenetic marker is involved.
This is a stakeholder survey about clinical practice guideline development for TBI rehabilitation; no epigenetic marker is involved.

Methylated DNA markers were measured in tissue and plasma across discovery and validation cohorts and validated for hepatocellular carcinoma detection.

DNA methylation was measured longitudinally in a population cohort at birth, childhood, and adolescence and evaluated for mediating genetic risk of type 1 diabetes.
This is a cytology study of bile duct brushings; 'coarse chromatin distribution' refers to a cytomorphologic feature, not a measured epigenetic marker.

Peripheral blood DNA methylation patterns were directly measured and used to build a classification model distinguishing spastic cerebral palsy from controls.
Whole blood Illumina 450K methylation was compared between postmenopausal osteoporotic women and normal controls from the CaMos cohort.

SCARA5 promoter methylation was measured and correlated with expression in 77 paired breast tumor and non-cancerous tissue samples.
gamma-H2AX, a chromatin-based histone modification marker of DNA damage, was measured by immunohistochemistry on colonic biopsies before and after MB-MMX chromoendoscopy exposure.

DRD4 CpG methylation was measured in an 8-week open-label MPH trial and tested for interaction with prenatal maternal stress on ADHD treatment response.
This case-control study measured dietary folate, B6, B12 and methionine intake and pancreatic cancer risk without any epigenetic marker assay.
