RARbeta promoter methylation was directly measured by bisulfite sequencing and compared across LS-VSCC, cancer-associated and cancer-free vulvar LS, and normal skin.

BMP3 promoter methylation was directly measured in plasma cell-free DNA and compared between patients with colorectal polyps/tumors and controls.
Patients with MGMT promoter methylation confirmed by testing were enrolled in a single-arm chemotherapy trial for recurrent glioblastoma.
This cohort study of clinical practice guideline adherence for cardiovascular disease outcomes did not measure any epigenetic marker.

Leukocyte DNA methylation at 41 PGC1A/PGC1B CpGs was measured in a prospective veteran cohort and linked to incident cancer risk.

Bisulfite sequencing directly measured Mfn2 promoter methylation and compared essential hypertension patients against normal controls in a Chinese case-control study.
This randomized controlled trial measured monocyte LINE-1 methylation as a secondary outcome of folic acid versus l-5-MTHF supplementation in Malaysian women.
This is a narrative discussion of published trial response rates for hypomethylating agents in MDS/AML rather than a report of the authors' own primary data.
Direct bisulfite sequencing measured POMC promoter methylation in blood across a smoking-withdrawal cohort compared with non-smoking controls.
Histone modifications on the SNEC substrate are an assay reagent for detecting patient autoantibodies, not a direct measurement of patients' own chromatin state.
This retrospective audit of emergency department mild traumatic brain injury guideline adherence measured no epigenetic marker.
MGMT promoter methylation status, alongside IDH and 1p/19q status, was measured in 61 grade II/III glioma patients and correlated with quantitative MRI features.
This retrospective analysis of infectious complications during AML chemotherapy protocols measured no epigenetic marker.

This observational study of frailty and myocardial infarction prognosis in elderly patients measured no epigenetic marker.

Immunohistochemistry directly measured loss of 5-hydroxymethylcytosine in CD4+ cells across mycosis fungoides disease stages compared with benign dermatoses, linked to survival.
IRX1 promoter methylation was assessed by ChIP/co-IP only in SGC7901 and NCI-N87 gastric cancer cell lines; the 433 human tissue samples were evaluated only for PRMT5 protein expression.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiles were directly compared between 489 individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders/congenital anomalies and 1534 controls to identify epivariations.
Methylation-specific PCR directly measured MGMT promoter methylation in serum cell-free DNA comparing colorectal cancer patients against age-matched normal individuals.
Loss of INI-1 (SMARCB1) nuclear expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry as a protein marker, not as a direct chromatin or methylation assay.
Illumina 450K methylation was directly measured in bronchial washing samples from NSCLC patients versus controls and linked to smoking cessation duration.
Methylated BCAT1 and IKZF1 DNA was directly measured in colorectal cancer tissue and serial blood samples to monitor circulating tumor DNA around surgical resection.
Cord blood Alu/LINE-1 DNA methylation was directly measured in the Taiwan Birth Panel cohort and linked to prenatal PFOS exposure.

This randomized pilot trial directly measured epigenome-wide leukocyte DNA methylation in mothers and breastfed infants after vitamin D3 supplementation.

This WHIMS analysis genotyped the SREBF1 SNP rs752579 rather than directly measuring DNA methylation itself in this cohort.

Promoter methylation of MCAM, ERalpha and ERbeta was measured by QMSP in serum from prostate cancer cases, controls, and HGPIN patients to develop an early-detection biomarker panel.

Although promoter methylation of DTX1 was confirmed in HNSCC cohorts, the study is a mechanistic tumor-suppressor characterization with no stated link to a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public-health decision.

This cross-sectional study of pesticide sprayers used the bacterial hupB gene for molecular detection of Mycobacterium species and measured hematology/liver enzymes, none of which is a human epigenetic marker.
This randomised phase II trial tests CpG-ODN immunotherapy for glioblastoma survival but does not measure any epigenetic marker in participants.
This is a case series of seven FNA cytology diagnoses of endometriosis with no comparison group and no epigenetic marker measured.

This cross-sectional EWAS links CPT1A methylation to plasma adiponectin, a metabolic biomarker, but states no modifiable exposure/intervention or clinical/public-health decision tied to the association.

MGMT promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in 210 GIT tumors versus 90 adjacent normal tissues, a case-control style comparison intended to support early diagnosis and prognosis.

This study profiles mRNA expression of histone-modifying enzymes (HATs, HDACs, KDMs) in cultured human mesenchymal stromal cells rather than directly measuring methylation, histone marks, or chromatin state.
Meningioma DNA methylation was profiled with the Illumina 450K array in a 140-sample training/validation cohort to build a methylation-based classifier predicting recurrence-free survival.
HDAC6 was assessed only at the mRNA/protein expression level via qRT-PCR, western blot, and IHC, not as a directly measured histone modification or chromatin mark.
CRMP4 promoter methylation was quantified by bisulfite pyrosequencing in prostate biopsies across a training set and two independent validation cohorts to predict lymph node metastasis.
OPRM1 promoter DNA methylation was measured by nested MSP in leukocyte DNA from 66 men with opium use disorder versus 57 controls, a case-control design.

This prospective cohort study of smoking and synchronous colorectal cancer risk discusses CIMP and BRAF status as background but does not report direct measurement of an epigenetic marker in this analysis.

Genome-wide peripheral blood DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in a nested case-control study of 687 incident prostate cancer cases within a prospective cohort, examining risk association.
H3K9 dimethylation, a histone modification, was measured in blood from a cohort of 15 multiple sclerosis patients and evaluated as a predictor of relapse and treatment responsiveness.

DNA methylation targets were identified using breast cancer cell-line models; the human patient cohort analysis relied on survival association with these target genes rather than methylation measured directly in patients.

Gamma-H2AX foci decay, an eligible histone modification readout, was measured in ex vivo-irradiated lymphocytes from a retrospective prostate cancer cohort to derive a prognostic marker for late radiation toxicity.
TPX2 was evaluated by mRNA expression and immunohistochemistry as a prognostic marker in renal cell carcinoma, with no epigenetic mark directly measured.
CNR1 promoter DNA methylation was directly measured in human PBMCs from 25 schizophrenia patients versus other diagnostic groups, with a rodent model used only for mechanistic confirmation.
Global blood 5-methylcytosine content was measured by ELISA-like assay in a three-group cross-sectional study of asbestos-exposed and unexposed subjects, linking a modifiable exposure to methylation.
The sperm chromatin structure assay used here measures DNA strand breakage and packaging, which per the instrument does not constitute a regulatory epigenetic marker.
This methods paper builds a physiological dysregulation index from clinical blood biochemistry biomarkers and Random Survival Forests, with no epigenetic marker involved.

CDKN2A nonpromoter methylation was measured by the Illumina 27K array in laryngeal SCC tumor samples and validated in TCGA, with combined methylation/expression status linked to locoregional recurrence.

AHRR cg05575921 methylation, a validated smoking biomarker, was measured in leukocyte DNA from 9234 Copenhagen City Heart Study participants and linked prospectively to COPD, lung cancer, and mortality.
This randomized trial of azacitidine plus the HDAC inhibitor pracinostat in MDS reports clinical response and survival outcomes but does not measure any epigenetic marker in participants.
This sequencing study of clonal evolution in myelodysplasia to secondary AML profiles somatic mutations in DNA-methylation and splicing genes, but does not measure DNA methylation itself.
This birth-cohort study of cytokine responses and allergen exposure measures immune cytokines, not any epigenetic marker; CpG here refers only to a stimulatory oligonucleotide reagent.

CIMP status, ordinarily a DNA methylation classification, is stated to have been evaluated by reverse transcriptase-PCR, leaving it unclear whether methylation or only expression was actually measured.

A 25-CpG DNA methylation aggressiveness classifier was developed from prostate cancer foci and matched lymph node metastases in 14 patients and validated in an independent cohort, linked to invasive stage.
CYP11B2 promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in a 192-participant hospital-based case-control study of essential hypertension, with gene-environment interaction analysis.

In the randomized, placebo-controlled DISC trial, SFRP1 promoter DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in rectal mucosal biopsies before and after resistant starch/polydextrose supplementation.
DNA methylation changes with escalating alcohol use were measured in the nucleus accumbens of rhesus macaques, an animal model with no human participants.
This is a cohort profile update for the Generation R Study describing design and available data resources rather than reporting a specific marker-outcome analysis.
HPV16 methylation was measured by next-generation sequencing and pyrosequencing in cervical CIN3 versus invasive cancer samples, distinguishing precancer from cancer for diagnostic purposes.
TOP2A, HELLS, ATAD2, and TET3 were assessed as mRNA expression prognostic markers in renal cell carcinoma; no DNA methylation, histone mark, or chromatin state was directly measured.
Salivary genome-wide DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in Hispanic preschool children and correlated with maternal BMI to identify pathways for pediatric obesity risk stratification.

A three-CpG DNA methylation signature (MSEH) was developed from 450K profiling of 576 hepatocellular carcinoma patients across discovery, training, and multiple validation cohorts to predict recurrence.
This reads as an invited perspective/review summarizing five years of genetic and epigenetic findings in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis rather than presenting new primary data.
This exome sequencing study of follicular lymphoma identifies histone-gene somatic mutations, which are genetic alterations rather than a directly measured epigenetic mark.
ASXL1 and ASXL2 mutations were genotyped in pediatric AML patients; despite ASXL2 being an epigenetic regulator gene, the study measures DNA sequence mutations, not an epigenetic mark.

Promoter DNA methylation of ERalpha, C/EBPalpha, and OLIG2 was measured by pyrosequencing in AML patients from a phase II decitabine trial to identify biomarkers of response to hypomethylating therapy.
Biological age here is computed from 15 clinical biochemistry biomarkers via principal component analysis, not from DNA methylation or any other epigenetic clock measurement.
This multicenter survey reports clinical outcomes of myeloid sarcoma treatment without measuring any epigenetic marker.
This RCT of photobiomodulation and cryotherapy for muscle recovery measures oxidative damage and creatine kinase biomarkers, none of which is an epigenetic marker.
Placental mtDNA and CYP1A1 promoter DNA methylation were measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing in the ENVIRONAGE birth cohort and linked to maternal smoking, a modifiable exposure, and birth weight.

ATX promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing in leukocytes and liver tissue of a 130-subject case-control study of biliary atresia and linked to disease progression and hepatic dysfunction.
This preclinical study of panobinostat efficacy against DIPG uses genetically engineered and xenograft mouse models, with no human participants or samples.
Hypomethylating-agent resistance was characterized in MOLM-13-derived cell lines and mouse xenograft models, with no human participants involved.

The RHCG-TCAF1 promoter methylation panel was discovered by 450K profiling of prostate tumor tissue and validated by qPCR in two independent radical prostatectomy cohorts to predict biochemical recurrence.
NDRG4 promoter and gene-body methylation were measured by MethyLight and pyrosequencing in 110 gastric cancer patients and TCGA, serving as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers.
This immunohistochemistry study reports total H2AX protein expression in cervical squamous carcinoma rather than a specific histone modification such as phosphorylated gamma-H2AX.
Beyond miR-23b/miR-193a expression, DNA methylation at the miR-23b locus was directly measured in a cohort of HCC patients and linked to survival, so ncRNA is not the only marker measured.
LINE-1 methylation was quantified by qPCR in microdissected tumor tissue from a 164-patient stage II colon cancer cohort and shown to predict overall survival.
This is a small descriptive series of nine colorectal cancer patients examining diurnal SEPT9 methylation variation, without a defined comparison-group design.
Gamma-H2AX foci, an eligible histone modification, were measured in PBMCs in a prospective controlled trial of oral antioxidant treatment before diagnostic radiation exposure.
This is a case series of 11 patients with bithalamic gliomas describing clinical, radiologic, and methylation-clustering features without a comparison group.

Circulating methylation markers, including hypermethylated miRNAs and genes, were measured in plasma to build a predictive model for HCC diagnosis and prognosis with reported sensitivity and specificity.
LINE1 DNA methylation was measured in cord blood from two Chinese birth cohorts around a coal plant closure and linked to prenatal PAH exposure and childhood neurodevelopmental scores.
Global DNA hypomethylation (5-methyl-2'-deoxycytidine) was measured in a 209-case, 417-control study of urothelial carcinoma and linked to cadmium/lead exposure, a modifiable environmental factor.
Promoter methylation of COX2, EGR1, and SOCS3 was measured in cord blood and saliva of arsenic-exposed newborns and children, linking a modifiable environmental exposure to methylation change.
This bioinformatic reanalysis of a public GEO microarray dataset identifies differentially expressed genes for trisomy 21 amniocytes, not any epigenetic marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was quantified in 262 post-mortem brain samples across four regions from 41 schizophrenia patients and 47 controls, a case-control design.
This phase 2 trial of neoadjuvant temozolomide for glioblastoma reports 4-year overall survival stratified by MGMT promoter methylation status, a directly measured prognostic marker.
LINE1 and DNA repair gene (OGG1, APEX1, PARP1) methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in a cross-sectional study of 150 schoolchildren exposed to particulate matter air pollution.
This nested case-control study identifies serum proteomic peaks, including histone acetyltransferase protein peaks, for colon cancer detection, but does not measure an epigenetic modification itself.

Smoking-related DNA methylation CpGs were measured on the Illumina 450K array in two independent older-adult cohorts and linked to a frailty index, tying a modifiable exposure to a health-monitoring outcome.

MGMT promoter methylation was quantified by bisulphite-PCR pyrosequencing in 96 benzene-exposed petrochemical workers versus 100 matched controls, linking a modifiable occupational exposure to methylation.
SHOX2 and SEPT9 promoter methylation were measured in tumor tissue and plasma from biliary tract cancer patients and controls to evaluate diagnostic and prognostic biomarker performance.

DNA methylation at GSTp1, MGMT, and LINE-1 was measured by pyrosequencing in blood from Agricultural Health Study pesticide applicators and linked to high pesticide exposure events, a modifiable occupational exposure.
Genome-wide sperm DNA methylation was measured via multiple platforms including the 450K array in a controlled study of low-dose folic acid supplementation, a modifiable dietary intervention.

A 12-marker DNA methylation panel was identified by array profiling of human breast tissue and validated by digital PCR in plasma cfDNA from breast cancer patients and healthy volunteers for early detection.
DNA methylation in the COASY and SPINT1 promoter regions was measured by MS-HRM in normal, aMCI, and Alzheimer's disease subjects as a diagnostic biomarker candidate.

H3 K27M is a histone gene point mutation detected by sequencing and mutant-specific immunostaining in paediatric gangliogliomas, which is a genetic alteration rather than a directly measured histone modification.
GSK3beta promoter methylation was assessed by MS-PCR per the methods, but the results section reports only the rs334558 polymorphism and expression findings, leaving the methylation results unclear.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in a longitudinal cohort of 646 subjects and linked to specific PM2.5 chemical species, a modifiable environmental exposure.
This analysis of romidepsin response by line of therapy in T-cell lymphoma reports clinical outcomes only, with no epigenetic marker measured despite romidepsin being an HDAC inhibitor.
Loss and gain of methylation at the 11p15.5 imprinted region were directly measured for molecular diagnosis in a retrospective cohort of 27 Chinese Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome patients.
CpG island methylation was quantified by MS-MLPA in a 50-patient training cohort and validated in 203 adrenocortical cancer patients as an independent prognostic factor.
A DNA methylation-derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio index was built from methylation data across bladder, head and neck, ovarian, and breast cancer case-control studies and linked to survival.
This trio-based exome sequencing study identifies de novo ZNF148 truncating mutations causing an intellectual disability syndrome, a genetic finding rather than a measured epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation was combined with sequencing and RNA data to define a BRCA-deficient TNBC subtype in MDACC, TCGA, and METABRIC cohorts, linked to chemosensitivity and survival outcomes.
Circulating histone-MPO complexes were measured as a NET biomarker in myeloproliferative neoplasm patients, which per the instrument is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Tumor LINE-1 methylation was measured by MethyLight assay in 40 advanced-stage colorectal cancer patients and correlated with survival and response to FOLFOX chemotherapy.

OSMR and SFRP1 promoter methylation in cell-free DNA was measured by qPCR in a cohort of 114 colorectal cancer patients, 56 healthy subjects, and 22 adenoma patients for diagnostic and prognostic value.
Cross-sectional comparison of 74 asthmatic vs 41 nonasthmatic adults with genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) measured in airway epithelial cells, linked to asthma endotypes and risk.
PITX2 methylation quantified by qMSP across neoplastic/nonneoplastic tissue, a prostatectomy cohort, and core biopsies, linked to biochemical-recurrence prognosis.
Measures anti-citrullinated protein autoantibodies, including an anti-histone-2A/2B antibody subtype, which is serology rather than a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Case-control comparison of hypermethylated RASSF1A in maternal plasma cell-free DNA used as a diagnostic marker for pre-eclampsia.
5-year longitudinal cohort measuring BDNF promoter methylation by bisulfite-pyrosequencing to predict conversion from aMCI to Alzheimer's disease.
Quality-improvement project on postoperative atrial fibrillation guideline compliance; no epigenetic marker is measured anywhere in the study.
Explicitly a systematic review protocol (registration CRD42016038654) describing planned methods, with no primary data reported.
Nested case-control study measuring blood DNA methylation at AHRR, 6p21.33 and F2RL3 by pyrosequencing to predict lung cancer incidence, informing screening.
Randomised trial of Brazil-nut/green-tea supplementation measuring rectal acetylated histone H3 (and DNMT1) directly in biopsy tissue, linking a chromatin mark to a dietary intervention.
Prospective ALSPAC cohort measuring genome-wide DNA methylation (Illumina 450k) in cord and childhood blood, linked to prenatal smoking exposure and adolescent substance-use risk.
Prospective cohort of unresectable glioblastoma patients with MGMT promoter methylation (MSP/bisulfite sequencing) analysed for survival prognosis.
Randomised phase II trial with exploratory MGMT promoter methylation biomarker analysis relating it to treatment benefit with onartuzumab plus bevacizumab.
MTHFR SNP genotyping and mRNA expression study in prostate cancer; no DNA methylation or histone mark is measured.
Primary marker is CPT1A protein/mRNA expression in AML; hypermethylation is only vaguely referenced within a multi-omics analysis without being reported as directly measured.
Untargeted urine metabolomics study in prostate cancer; DNA methylation and histone marks are mentioned only in discussion of pathway connections, not measured.
Retrospective cohort comparing two glioblastoma treatment eras that assessed MGMT promoter methylation status among prognostic risk factors for survival.
Fetal haemoglobin (HbF) induction by decitabine is studied as an outcome predictor in MDS/AML; HbF is a protein, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Measures anti-SmD1 and anti-histone autoantibodies by immunoblotting in children with SLE; this is autoimmune serology, not chromatin measurement.
Randomised waitlist-controlled yoga trial measuring DNA methylation of IL-6, TNF, CRP and the global LINE-1 marker in blood of stressed women.
Clinical-practice-guideline implementation study for pediatric diabetic ketoacidosis hospital stay; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Cohort of prostate cancer patients with LINE-1 methylation measured in tumour and adjacent tissue, analysed against prostate-cancer mortality.
Project Viva pre-birth cohort measuring cord-blood and mid-childhood DNA methylation (Infinium 450K) linked to birth weight-for-gestational-age.

Prospective study measuring plasma cell-free DNA promoter hypermethylation panel by methylation-specific PCR as a diagnostic marker distinguishing pancreatic adenocarcinoma from benign pancreatic disease.
Monozygotic-twin study measuring blood DNA methylation age (epigenetic clock) and evaluating its association with cognitive abilities, a prognostic biomarker question.
Explicitly a cross-sectional study measuring PPARGC1A promoter methylation in leukocytes, linked to metabolic risk stratification in PCOS.
MoBa birth cohort measuring epigenome-wide newborn DNA methylation (450K) linked to maternal smoking, a modifiable prenatal exposure.
Case-control epigenome-wide methylation study (240 IBD cases vs 190 controls) with independent replication, linking DNA methylation differences to IBD diagnosis and genetic risk.
Cohort of treatment-naive early rheumatoid arthritis patients with T-lymphocyte DNA methylation (450K BeadChip) analysed against DMARD treatment response.
METHOD/DESIGN section describing a planned phase II trial (V-CHANCE) of valproic acid plus cisplatin/cetuximab; no results are reported.
Historical cohort study in rural Bangladesh measuring targeted DNA methylation at metastable epialleles linked to famine exposure during development.
Longitudinal study of serum cardiac troponin T release after endurance exercise; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Cross-sectional comparison of histone H3K9 dimethylation in white blood cells across trauma, cancer and sepsis groups, measured by immunofluorescence, with stated diagnostic/prognostic relevance.
A statistical methodology paper developing a model for analysing DNA methylation beta values; it is methods research, not a clinical/epidemiological study design.
Cross-sectional comparison of high-risk (FIGO grade 3) vs low-risk (grade 1) endometrial carcinomas using genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) to identify prognostic markers.
Prospective multicenter TRACE study measuring POU4F3 promoter methylation by quantitative MSP in cervical liquid-based cytology samples for hrHPV triage.
Retrospective evaluation of decitabine as first-line AML treatment; response is assessed clinically, with no epigenetic marker directly measured.
Deep-sequencing mutation profiling of chromatin-remodelling genes in lung neuroendocrine tumours measures gene mutations, not the chromatin/histone marks themselves.
Prospective TBCRC 005 biomarker study measuring a serum cell-free DNA methylation panel (cMethDNA) in metastatic breast cancer for survival monitoring.
Isle of Wight birth cohort measuring epigenome-wide DNA methylation (450K) linked to tetanus vaccination exposure and asthma risk at age 18.
Measures Warburg-effect-related microRNAs (ncRNA) and HDAC enzyme mRNA levels in AML bone marrow; the microRNAs are the only epigenetic-type marker actually measured in humans.
Case-control study of CpG-island hypermethylation (CIMP) in paraffin-embedded tissue from RA-methotrexate lymphoproliferative-disorder patients vs DLBCL controls, linked to EBV status and prognosis.
Cross-sectional study measuring Alu and LINE-1 methylation by bisulfite-pyrosequencing in blood leukocytes of Mexican children, linked to urinary arsenic exposure.
Genetic-variant study of TBX6 in congenital scoliosis/spondylocostal dysostosis; a chromatin-binding domain is affected by mutation, but no epigenetic mark is measured.
Study protocol for the HABSelect multicentre randomised controlled trial; no results are reported.
TCGA analysis of IGFBP2 gene expression and glioma survival; IDH-associated DNA hypermethylation is discussed as background mechanism but is not measured or analysed as the study marker.
Case-control comparison of H3K27me3 histone mark expression by immunohistochemistry between pediatric nodular melanomas and proliferative nodules, with stated diagnostic utility.

Abstract does not clearly state a comparative epidemiological design; DNA methylation is examined only via a brief TCGA gene-expression/methylation correlation without describing the sample or comparison structure.
Population-based PIVUS cross-sectional cohort measuring genome-wide blood DNA methylation (450K) linked to circulating p,p'-DDE, a pesticide breakdown product (environmental exposure).
Phase I non-randomised trial measuring tumour DNA methylation biomarkers by digital-droplet bisulfite qPCR before and after azacitidine priming, linked to chemotherapy response.
Explicitly an observational cross-sectional study measuring VHL promoter hypermethylation in renal cell carcinoma tissue, related to clinicopathologic variables including metastasis.
Training and validation cohorts (including TCGA) measuring PD-L1 promoter methylation by quantitative MSP in prostate tissue, linked to biochemical-recurrence prognosis.
Pilot cohort of malignant glioma patients measuring tumour 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) content alongside MBD3, linked to progression-free and overall survival.
Case-control study of the genetic variant rs4442975 affecting FOXA1 binding in breast cancer; no epigenetic marker is measured.

Descriptive molecular profiling (genetic, transcriptional, DNA methylation) of AML bone-marrow stromal cells with no stated link to a modifiable exposure or clinical decision beyond speculative future niche-directed therapy.
MANOE mother-infant cohort measuring cord-blood global and gene-specific (LEP, DNMT1, RXRA) DNA methylation linked to maternal methyl-donor and folic-acid intake, a modifiable exposure.

KORA F4 cross-sectional study relating blood DNA methylation at AQP3/SOCS3 to CRP inflammation levels; a mechanistic marker-marker association with no stated modifiable exposure or clinical/public-health decision.
Prognostic study of chromosomal translocations and IPSS-R scoring in myelodysplastic syndrome; no epigenetic marker is measured.
RNA-sequencing study identifying MEF2D gene fusions in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia; a genetic rearrangement study with no epigenetic marker measured.
Double-blind randomised controlled trial of prenatal DHA supplementation measuring infant global and genome-wide (450K) DNA methylation at birth and age 5.
Discovery and independently replicated cohort study measuring a blood/saliva DNA methylation biosignature linked to suicide-risk prediction, a public-health screening decision.
Longitudinal study measuring vascular age via arterial pulse-wave tonometry after cannabis exposure; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Retrospective clinicopathologic study using EBER in-situ hybridisation and FISH for bcl-2/bcl-6/C-MYC rearrangements; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Genetic sequencing cohort of choroideremia patients; CpG mutation-to-methylation deamination is discussed mechanistically but methylation itself is not measured.
Genetic SNP association study of radiation-induced skin toxicity in breast cancer patients; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Micronucleus and nuclear-abnormality genotoxicity assay in pesticide-exposed pilots; measures DNA/nuclear damage endpoints, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
PA-SCOPE case-control cohort measuring whole-blood DNA methylation (Illumina 27K) linked to COPD case status among African-American smokers.
Explicitly a cross-sectional study measuring TNF-alpha promoter CpG methylation in white blood cells linked to dietary fruit intake, a modifiable exposure.
Measures EZH2 protein expression (a histone methyltransferase enzyme) by immunohistochemistry in CNS DLBCL, not the histone methylation mark itself.
BRD4/PI3K inhibitor study conducted in hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines and mouse xenografts, with no human participants.

Prospective cohort study measuring tumour let-7a/let-7b microRNA expression as the primary marker in two US cohorts; CpG island methylator phenotype and LINE-1 methylation are used only as adjustment covariates, not analysed as the study's marker.
Randomised controlled dietary intervention trial in Hispanic breast cancer survivors measuring global DNA methylation change associated with the culturally based intervention.
Retrospective study measuring gene promoter methylation (MS-MLPA) in sinonasal adenocarcinoma and squamous carcinoma tumours, linked to overall survival.

Expression-based analysis of B7-H3 protein/mRNA in prostate cancer; chromatin immunoprecipitation for androgen-receptor occupancy was performed in LNCaP cells, not as a human DNA methylation or histone-modification measurement.
Case series of 15 individuals undergoing exome sequencing for diagnosis of Smith-Magenis-like disease, with no comparison group; chromatin conformation capture is used only as mechanistic follow-up.
Large cohort of high-grade serous ovarian cancer tumours (313/407) with directly measured loss of histone H2B monoubiquitination (H2Bub1), linked to disease stage.
Presentation of a bioinformatics software tool (DiMmeR) for differentially methylated region detection; no human evaluation cohort or clinical design is reported.
Whole-exome and targeted sequencing study of somatic mutations in epigenetic-modifier genes in myeloma; measures DNA sequence mutations, not the epigenetic marks themselves.
KORA F4 cohort measuring DNA methylation age acceleration (an epigenetic clock) linked to long-term air pollution exposure.
Netherlands Cohort Study case-cohort measuring tumour promoter CpG island methylation of ion-transport genes linked to dietary sodium/potassium intake and renal cell cancer risk.
Measures circulating microRNAs (ncRNA) as the epigenetic biomarker of pre-pregnancy BMI; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured.
Explicitly a cross-sectional study comparing a methylated BCAT1/IKZF1 blood test to CEA for detecting recurrent colorectal cancer.
Case-control study (200 healthy vs 200 lung cancer patients) measuring gene promoter methylation (p16, RASSF1A, FHIT) by qMSP to build a diagnostic classifier for lung cancer screening.
Single-arm trial of temozolomide in low-grade glioma assessing 1p/19q codeletion and IDH1 mutation status, both genetic rather than epigenetic markers.
Prospective cohort of prostate cancer active-surveillance patients measuring urinary DNA methylation biomarkers (MethyLight) linked to disease-reclassification monitoring.
Cohort of breast cancer patients receiving different radiotherapy modalities with directly measured gamma-H2AX histone foci in leukocytes, linked to the radiotherapy technique used.
EHF gene expression/amplification study in gastric cancer using ChIP to identify downstream transcription-factor targets; no DNA methylation or histone-modification state is measured.
Cohort of AML/MDS patients (n=43) with TERT promoter methylation measured by pyrosequencing in primary leukaemia cells, analysed against survival.
Paired tumour vs adjacent-normal-tissue study measuring DNA methylation (microarray and MS-HRM) to validate candidate diagnostic biomarkers in lung adenocarcinoma.
H3K27me3 mechanism at the PTEN promoter is demonstrated through mechanistic/functional experiments, while the 182-patient cohort data concern JARID2 expression, not the histone mark itself.
MBD-Seq case-control study of CLL vs normal B cells measuring genome-wide DNA methylation, replicated and linked to IGHV prognostic subgroup and survival.
Cross-sectional comparison of maltreated vs nonmaltreated school-aged children measuring genome-wide and candidate-gene saliva DNA methylation linked to maltreatment exposure.
Case-control study measuring genome-wide infant DNA methylation (450K) linked to maternal major depressive disorder exposure during pregnancy.
Microsatellite instability and JAK1 frameshift mutation study in endometrial cancer; a genetic study with no epigenetic marker measured.
Barwon Infant Study birth cohort measuring NR3C1 cord-blood methylation by Sequenom MassArray linked to maternal psychological distress during pregnancy.
Paired tumour vs adjacent-normal breast tissue study measuring IGFBP7 promoter methylation by methylation-specific PCR as a candidate biomarker.
TCGA-based multiplatform molecular subtyping of NSCLC that includes DNA methylation (a CpG island methylator phenotype subtype) linked to differentiation and prognosis.
Case-control study of the MTHFR C677T genetic polymorphism and oral squamous cell carcinoma risk; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Explicitly a case-control study measuring candidate gene promoter methylation in peripheral blood leukocytes linked to adenomatous polyp formation and screening utility.
Case-control study measuring gamma-H2AX histone-foci response in blood lymphocytes and hair follicles to predict radiosensitivity, informing radiotherapy treatment decisions.
Prospective cohort of pancreatectomy/islet-autotransplant recipients measuring unmethylated insulin DNA, a methylation-based beta-cell-death marker, linked to clinical monitoring of glycemic outcome.
Bisulfite sequencing for FAM46C methylation was run only on the eleven gastric-cancer cell lines, while the 129 patient tissues had only mRNA expression measured.
RND1 promoter methylation was examined using individual-level TCGA and GSE14520 methylation data linked to overall survival across three HCC cohorts.
This is a case series of targeted next-generation sequencing for somatic mutations in NSCLC with no methylation, histone, or chromatin assay reported.
Placental LINE1, NR3C1 and IGF2 methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in 80 mother-newborn pairs and linked to in utero PBDE exposure.
HDAC4 and SIRT6 levels were assessed only as Western blot protein expression, not as a measured histone modification.
Three histone post-translational marks (H3K36me2, H3K36me3, H3K79me2) were measured in PBMCs within a randomized folic-acid trial in arsenic-exposed adults.
Blood DNA methylomes across ~483,000 CpGs were profiled in a two-generation cohort and linked to childhood malnutrition exposure and later attention/cognition.
The decision-tree analysis is built entirely on nuclear cytology features of thyroid FNA smears with no epigenetic assay.
hTERT promoter methylation was quantified by MS-PCR in 78 meningiomas and 38 hemangiopericytomas and related to WHO grade, recurrence and survival.
The study reports SEER registry completeness for recording an MGMT-methylation field rather than measuring methylation values in patients.
Saliva-derived DRD/COMT/AKT1 promoter methylation was measured by q-MSP in a methamphetamine-dependency case-control design and linked to psychosis and drug exposure.
Neutrophil fluorescence quantifies chromatin decondensation as a structural NETosis readout of cell activation, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, akin to the sperm chromatin integrity exclusion.
This is a quality-improvement study of emergency-department time-to-antibiotics with no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Urine OTX1/ONECUT2/TWIST1 methylation was assayed alongside FGFR3/TERT/HRAS mutations in a 200-patient hematuria case-control cohort to select patients for cystoscopy.
Genome-wide bisulfite profiling identified DNA methylation of microRNA promoter regions in cholangiocarcinoma tissue, validated in two patient cohorts and linked to patient outcome.
Global histone H4 acetylation in PBMCs was directly measured in amateur runners versus sedentary controls in relation to exercise exposure.
This phase 2 trial reports clinical response to clofarabine/cytarabine after hypomethylating-agent failure without measuring any methylation marker.
ARNTL CpG methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in blood from bipolar-disorder patients versus controls, distinguishing diagnostic groups.
MethylCap-seq identified genome-wide hypermethylated regions validated by qMSP in cervical scrapings for detection of adeno- and squamous-cell carcinoma.
Promoter methylation of a six-gene panel was measured by qMSP in plasma and sputum to diagnose node-negative NSCLC in a case-control design.
Methylation of LRRC3B, APC, FHIT and RASSF1 in plasma cell-free DNA was measured in renal-cancer patients versus healthy donors for diagnostic use.
Global leukocyte DNA methylation was measured by ELISA in a cross-sectional cohort of postmenopausal women and related to cardiovascular risk stratification.
PITX2 and PANCR promoter methylation were measured by qMSP in 399 head-and-neck cancer patients and used to predict overall survival.
Quantitative DNA methylation was measured in maternal and cord-blood plasma across a 40-dyad birth cohort and linked to maternal lipid metabolite exposure.
This molecular profiling of unclassified renal cell carcinoma reports somatic mutations in chromatin regulators (SETD2, BAP1) rather than a directly measured methylation or histone mark.
Dot1l was assessed only by immunohistochemical protein expression in renal cancer tissue, not by measuring the H3K79 methylation mark it deposits.

HSF1 methylation was checked in TCGA only to explain protein upregulation and was found unrelated to it, leaving unclear whether methylation itself was linked to the prognostic decision this record targets.
Genome-wide 450K methylation was measured in PBMCs of discordant Parkinson's siblings/twins and validated in two independent case-control cohorts for a diagnostic CpG signature.
PITX3 promoter methylation was measured by qPCR and 450K array in TCGA and institutional prostatectomy cohorts to predict biochemical recurrence.
A six-gene methylation score was quantified by pyrosequencing in a watchful-waiting prostate cancer cohort and used to predict cancer death.
hTERT CpG-island methylation was measured by MSP in 50 paired invasive breast cancers and normal tissue for diagnostic biomarker development.
Epigenetic age (DNAm clock) was measured in the Women's Health Initiative cohort and linked to insomnia symptoms and sleep duration.
RECK promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite PCR across 112 human oral tissue samples spanning normal to invasive tumor stages.
MALDI imaging mass spectrometry identified histone proteins only as one of several abundance clusters, not a measured histone modification.
CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by qPCR and TCGA 450K array across two prostate cancer cohorts and linked to biochemical recurrence.
A 450K epigenome-wide association study measured blood DNA methylation in current versus never smokers and linked it to cotinine-validated smoking exposure.
Phosphohistone-H3 (a histone modification) was assayed by immunohistochemistry in 160 meningiomas and used as a proliferation index predicting recurrence.
ERCC1/ERCC2/XPC promoter methylation was measured in peripheral blood lymphocytes and skin lesions of arsenicosis patients versus healthy controls.
PDE4D promoter methylation was assessed alongside expression data across prostate tissue datasets and linked to isoform-based diagnostic/prognostic metrics.
GFI1 CpG methylation was measured by bisulfite sequencing in blood from SIDS cases with and without maternal smoking exposure.

DNA methylation marker testing is named as part of the SIMONATH surveillance protocol but no methylation results are reported, so it is unclear whether the marker was actually analysed in this record.
ELOVL2/FHL2 methylation was measured longitudinally in the Doetinchem and Leiden Longevity cohorts and tested against cytomegalovirus status and mortality.
Promoter methylation of ZNF516, FKBP6, INTS1 and HPV16-L1 was measured in cervical brushings and urine cfDNA to triage CIN2+ lesions.
The abstract states genetic, epigenetic and transcriptional alterations were profiled in laterally spreading tumors but never names the specific epigenetic marker or assay used.
A six-CpG methylation panel was measured by array and pyrosequencing in ESCC biopsies to predict chemoradiation response.
RUNX3 promoter methylation at 8 CpG sites was quantified by pyrosequencing in gastric cancer versus normal tissue and linked to prognosis.
Blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array and pyrosequencing in ovarian cancer patients from the SCOTROC1 platinum-chemotherapy trial and linked to survival.
Plasma histone H4 is measured as a circulating inflammatory protein biomarker in ACLF patients, not as a chromatin-state assay.
ADCY8, CDH8 and ZNF582 promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing across cervical cytology grades alongside HPV genotyping.
A 52-CpG methylation signature from TCGA was generated and tested in 523 prostatectomy patients to predict recurrence by Gleason score.
This retrospective outcome analysis compares systemic therapies including HDAC inhibitors in CTCL without measuring any epigenetic marker.
p16 CpG-island methylation was measured by MSP in a 98-case/98-control cervical cancer study and linked to smoking and HPV risk factors.
SHP1-P2 methylation was measured by qPCR in colorectal cancer lymph nodes and linked to occult metastasis detection and prognosis.
This is a 10-case cytomorphology case series of CASTLE thyroid tumors with no comparison group and no epigenetic measurement.
PCDH17 promoter methylation was measured by 450K array and bisulfite sequencing in pediatric ALL diagnostic samples and linked to relapse risk.
H3K23 acetylation, a histone modification, was measured by immunohistochemistry in 121 breast cancer samples and linked to overall survival.
This phase II trial reports clinical response to the HDAC inhibitor romidepsin without measuring any epigenetic marker.
Global DNA methylation subgroup and MGMT promoter methylation status were determined in 152 glioblastoma patients and used as the molecular classification target for an imaging-based classifier.
Pre-diagnostic blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array in nested case-control cohorts and linked to smoking exposure and lung cancer risk.
CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by Q-MSP in 169 ESCC patients and linked to prognosis and neoadjuvant therapy response.
This claims-database analysis of tympanostomy tube guideline adherence contains no epigenetic measurement.
SFRP3 DNA hypermethylation was evaluated in TCGA methylation data and validated by pyrosequencing in an NSCLC tissue cohort linked to clinical outcome.
Genome-wide 450K methylation profiling compared gallbladder tumor, adjacent, and gallstone tissue with the stated aim of an early-diagnosis biomarker.
Placental LEP promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing in the ENVIRONAGE cohort and linked to PM2.5 air-pollution exposure.
p15, p16, p53 and DAPK promoter methylation were measured by MSP in bone marrow across MGUS, SMM, MM and healthy controls to study myelomagenesis staging.
This NAFLD study measures circulating betaine levels and a DMGDH genetic variant, not any directly measured methylation or histone mark.
IGF2 fetal-promoter methylation was measured directly in 228 human HCC tissues compared with adjacent and non-tumor liver, linked to oncogene activation.
Cell-free plasma DNA methylation of DAPK1/DBC1/MIR34A/B/C was measured by pyrosequencing in DLBCL patients and used as an independent prognostic marker.

A novel statistical test is applied to genome-wide methylation data from the Bogalusa cohort, but the record's primary purpose is method development rather than a clearly delineated epidemiological design.
The abstract states a functional study raised methylation at an hOGG1 CpG site but does not specify whether this was measured in the human case-control samples or only in a reporter/functional assay.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined by PCR in 63 glioblastoma patients and analyzed as a prognostic factor for survival.

Cp-promoter methylation of Epstein-Barr viral DNA (not host DNA) was measured in nasopharyngeal brushings, and it is unclear whether pathogen epigenetic marks fall within this instrument's eligible marker scope.
Myopodin promoter methylation was measured by MS-PCR in 88 kidney tumors and used to predict prognosis and antiangiogenic treatment response.
Placental DNA methylation was measured genome-wide by 450K array in the INMA birth cohort and linked to maternal smoking during pregnancy.
Nucleotyping quantifies nuclear texture by image cytometry, a structural morphometric readout rather than a directly assayed methylation or histone mark.
HS3ST2, SEPTIN9 and SLIT2 promoter methylation was measured by qMSP in urine from bladder cancer patients for diagnosis and surveillance.
ASS1 gene-body methylation was measured in tumor samples from a randomized mesothelioma trial and correlated with treatment response to arginine deprivation.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assayed in glioblastoma tissue from elderly versus young patient cohorts and compared for therapeutic-target relevance.
This is a genetic-association study of PIWI-piRNA pathway SNPs in melanoma survival; DNA methylation is only mentioned as pathway background, not measured.
RPTOR, MGRN1 and RAPSN blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array and MassARRAY in breast cancer cases versus healthy controls across four cohorts.
Methylation of 40 tumor-suppressor genes was measured by MS-MLPA in prostate cancer versus healthy prostatic tissue across training and validation sets.
A DNA methylation microarray classifier (EPICUP) was trained on 2790 tumors and validated on 7691 tumors to diagnose the primary site of cancer of unknown origin.
Histone H2AX phosphorylation was measured only in HeLa cells expressing mutant MCM8, not in the human POI patients themselves.
Histone H3-K27M is scored here as a genetic mutation used for WHO tumor classification, not as a directly measured histone modification.
OAS2 promoter methylation was measured at 11 CpG sites by pyrosequencing across psoriasis and two SCC subtypes and linked to disease-specific expression.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined in 303 glioblastoma patients and 190 TCGA cases and analyzed jointly with hTERT mutation for survival.
SCD1 promoter methylation was measured in blood before and after a controlled one-night total-sleep-deprivation exposure in healthy men.
Telomere length is not one of the eligible epigenetic markers (methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or DNAm clock) defined by this instrument.
DNA damage (comet assay/γ-H2AX) was measured in myeloma cell lines and xenografts, not as an epigenetic assay in the human bone-marrow samples.
Genome-wide DNA methylation across ~2 million loci was measured in cervical biopsies from HPV+ women and validated in TCGA, tracking progression to carcinoma.
MLH1 promoter methylation testing was performed on IHC-flagged endometrial tumors in a prospective universal Lynch-syndrome screening cohort.
Cord blood IGF2, H19 and LINE1 methylation were measured by pyrosequencing and linked to prenatal perfluoroalkyl acid exposure.
Salivary H3 histone family 3A mRNA was measured as gene expression, not as a histone modification or chromatin mark.
This azacitidine-lenalidomide MDS trial reports clinical response rates without measuring any methylation marker.
Placental PCDHAC1 promoter methylation was measured in a birth cohort and linked to maternal cadmium exposure and fetal growth.
SHOX2 and PTGER4 promoter methylation was measured by real-time PCR in plasma across three case-control cohorts to diagnose lung cancer.
This is a cytomorphology study of nuclear/cytoplasmic features for melanocytic lesion diagnosis, with no epigenetic assay.
Serum methylated vimentin and CIMP-high methylation status were measured in a phase I/II azacitidine/CAPOX trial and correlated with treatment response.
IGF2 methylation was measured in blood at birth and age 7 within the ALSPAC cohort and linked to prenatal diet exposure and ADHD symptoms.
Methylation of IGF2 regulatory regions (DMR0, ICR, H19 promoter) was measured by pyrosequencing to diagnose adrenocortical carcinoma versus adenoma.
687 UTUC patients had RASSF1A promoter methylation measured by MSP and linked to recurrence-free survival, a retrospective cohort with a clear prognostic marker-outcome link.
The study evaluates IPSS-R prognostic value against clinical response to hypomethylating therapy but never reports an assayed methylation level in these MDS patients.
DNA methylation was profiled genome-wide in blood from 12 PTSD cases versus 12 trauma-resilient controls, a human case-control comparison even though no significant CpGs survived correction.
FoxP3 TSDR demethylation was directly measured in PBMCs across four groups of children with and without cow's milk allergy, linking the mark to dietary tolerance-induction treatment.
γH2AX, a histone modification, was quantified by immunofluorescence in lymphocytes from MCI patients versus controls and fed into a diagnostic classifier.

miR-449a silencing by DNA methylation was shown via demethylation-reagent treatment and MSP, but it is unclear whether the MSP assay was run on the patient FFPE specimens or only on medulloblastoma cell lines.

The Methylated Septin-9 blood test was measured in a prospective series of CRC patients versus healthy controls and compared against stool occult blood testing.

miR-151-5p expression, a microRNA, is the marker profiled and validated as a BRCAness biomarker; the chromatin remodeler SMARCA5 is only its downstream target, not itself measured epigenetically.
SLC6A4 promoter methylation was measured at birth and discharge in preterm and full-term infants and linked to socio-emotional stress-response outcomes.
Illumina 450K methylation arrays classified 10 CRINET tumors alongside ATRT molecular subgroups, directly measuring methylation in human tumor tissue for differential diagnosis and prognosis.
Genome-wide and pyrosequencing methylation analysis of RAB25 was performed in paired lymph-node-positive/negative OOSCC tumors, including TCGA validation, to support metastasis diagnosis.

γ-H2AX foci, a histone modification marking DNA damage, were measured before and after escalating exercise distances in trained athletes.

This phase II vorinostat trial in soft-tissue sarcoma reports clinical response and toxicity outcomes only, without any histone acetylation or other epigenetic assay.
This is a histological prevalence study of prostatic stromal tumors misdiagnosed as hyperplasia, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Genome-wide cord-blood DNA methylation (450K) was measured in a pilot birth cohort and analysed against regional air-pollution exposure and maternal HIV status.
Epigenome-wide tumor DNA methylation profiling in two prostate-cancer cohorts identified CpG biomarkers that stratified metastatic-lethal from nonrecurrent disease.

An integrated multi-omic analysis, including DNA methylation from the TCGA lung adenocarcinoma cohort, characterized the molecular profile of the aggressive 10-gene-signature subgroup linked to poor stage I prognosis.
Circulating histones are measured in plasma as a perioperative injury/inflammation biomarker after cardiac surgery, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
BRAF V600E colorectal cancer subtypes are defined from gene-expression clustering and phosphoprotein levels, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Histone deacetylase inhibition with trichostatin A was tested only in C57BL/6 mice with postinfluenza pneumococcal infection.
Repeated-measures blood LINE-1 and Alu methylation were tracked prospectively in 583 participants and analysed against subsequent cancer incidence and mortality.
Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing measured DNA methylation in mother-child pairs and a larger LINA cohort, linking prenatal maternal stress to child methylation changes and wheeze risk.
Shati/Nat8l CpG island methylation was measured in peripheral blood of human schizophrenia patients versus healthy controls, in parallel with a mouse model, as a candidate diagnostic biomarker.
CpG-oligonucleotide is used only as a mitogenic stimulant to enable karyotyping/FISH in CLL specimens; no methylation or chromatin mark is measured.
Promoter methylation of 11 genes was measured by MSP in tumor tissue from a case-cohort study of clear-cell renal cell cancer and tested against alcohol and folate intake.

H3K4me3 and HP1 levels were measured directly in blood from nickel smelting workers versus matched office workers and correlated with employment length.

OXTR promoter methylation across 12 CpG sites was measured in adult women and shown to mediate the effect of adversity on depression-related schemas.
This study evaluates serum hormones and testicular biopsy histology in cryptorchidism; DNA methylation is mentioned only as background biology, not measured.
A randomized crossover-controlled human exposure study measured bronchial epithelial DNA methylation at CpG resolution after diesel exhaust and allergen challenge.
Alu, LINE-1 and SAT-α methylation were measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing in blood from 51 MS patients versus 137 matched controls and linked to disability score.
MBD2 is assessed by western blot and immunohistochemistry as a protein expression marker in HCC tissue, not as a direct measurement of DNA methylation.

Genome-wide methylation differences between keloid and normal skin were profiled purely for pathway/mechanistic insight, without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure or a specific clinical screening/diagnosis/treatment decision.
ATRX status was assessed by immunohistochemistry as a proxy for the ATRX chromatin remodeler mutation, not as a direct measurement of a chromatin-state or histone mark.
A randomised within-subject sleep-deprivation trial in 16 healthy adults directly measured genome-wide blood DNA methylation.
VPA effects were tracked through gene-expression and miRNA profiling in AML patients; no histone acetylation or other epigenetic mark was directly measured.
A case-control study measured DNA methylation of the miR-196b promoter in human sputum and linked it to lung cancer diagnosis.
Two longitudinal cohorts tracked epigenetic-clock stability and its correlation with blood-cell composition but did not relate DNAmAge to a modifiable exposure or a clinical decision.
The COPERS RCT evaluated a group pain intervention with no epigenetic marker measured.
PAX1/ZNF582 promoter methylation was measured by qMSP in a case-control diagnostic study for cervical cancer/CIN3+.
TCGA-derived AML cohort data showed differential methylation patterns linked to SIRT2-defined prognostic groups.
Circulating cell-free 5mC and H3K9me3 nucleosome levels were directly measured by ELISA and differed between cancer patients and healthy individuals.
Genome-wide DNA methylation in newborn bloodspots was compared across ART/ICSI conception modes, a modifiable clinical exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation in 52 oral tongue tumors was correlated with disease-free survival and validated against TCGA.
A randomised vitamin D3 vs placebo trial measured chromatin accessibility by FAIRE-qPCR in human PBMCs.
RBP2, a histone demethylase, was studied via its overexpression and correlation with RCC prognosis, but no histone mark itself was measured.
Sperm chromatin integrity/morphology was assessed, which measures DNA packaging/strand integrity rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
The study profiled autoantibodies against modified histone H2B tails as SLE biomarkers rather than measuring the histone modification itself.
MRI texture features were used to predict known MGMT promoter methylation status in a retrospective GBM cohort, a treatment-selection-relevant marker.
CNV analysis of relapsed DLBCL identified histone-gene copy-number changes (e.g., H1T duplication), not a measured epigenetic mark.
AML genomic subgroups were defined by driver gene mutations, including chromatin-regulator genes, without measuring an epigenetic mark directly.
Epigenetic clock (DNAmAge) age acceleration was measured in a population cohort and predicted cancer, cardiovascular, and all-cause mortality.
FOXE1 promoter methylation was profiled and validated in CRC patient cohorts and linked to prognosis.
DNA methylation at a CYP2E1 DMR was measured in buccal cells of adoptees exposed to varying durations of institutional deprivation.
DRD2 promoter methylation was measured in leukocytes of medicated and drug-naive schizophrenia patients versus controls.
Ex vivo irradiated human lymphocytes were assessed for gammaH2AX histone phosphorylation as a candidate biodosimetry marker.
A cumulative methylation index across eight genes was measured in fine-needle aspirates and linked to breast cancer risk assessment via cytological atypia.
Genome-wide DNA methylation in HCC tumors was compared by viral (HBV/HCV) status, an infectious exposure.
The study characterized mutations in DNA-methylation regulatory genes in AML without directly measuring methylation.
DNA methylation and hypermethylation patterns were analyzed alongside IDH1/IDH2 mutation status in a large glioma cohort with survival outcomes.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR measured let-7a-3 promoter methylation in MDS patients versus controls, linked to overall survival.
Plasma citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating NETosis biomarker, a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Sperm DNA fragmentation index (a chromatin integrity/DNA strand-breakage test) was used to stratify ICSI intervention, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
H19/MEST DMR methylation was measured in cord blood of SGA versus AGA infants and linked to maternal folic acid supplementation.
hTERT promoter CpG methylation was quantified by pyrosequencing in breast tumors versus normal tissue for diagnostic biomarker potential.
hSETD1A protein expression (a histone methyltransferase) was assessed by immunohistochemistry, not the histone methylation mark itself.
SFRP2 and MGMT-B promoter hypermethylation was measured by MS-PCR in polyp tissue and serum for early CRC detection.
Genome-wide promoter methylation was profiled in prostate tumors and linked to biochemical recurrence after prostatectomy.
A qPCR assay measuring FOXP3 TSDR demethylation was evaluated in healthy individuals and kidney transplant recipients for immunosuppression monitoring.
Children randomised to foster care versus care-as-usual after institutionalization had DNA methylation measured at FKBP5 and SLC6A4.
Longitudinal DNA methylation at the serotonin transporter promoter was measured in adolescents and linked to socioeconomic status and brain function.
A PRM1 promoter SNP was genotyped as a genetic risk factor, not a methylation or other epigenetic measurement.
Cell cycle-related gene mRNA expression was measured as a schizophrenia biomarker, with no epigenetic mark assessed.
Genome-wide methylation array findings from xenografts were validated by bisulfite sequencing in human ACC tumors versus normal salivary tissue.
Reduced representation bisulfite sequencing measured genome-wide methylation across CML disease phases from chronic to blast crisis.
H3K27me3 ChIP-seq was performed in HCC cell lines, while the human tissue cohort data measured only CLDN14 protein expression.
The study profiled miRNA expression differences by tumor molecular phenotype in colorectal carcinomas, with no DNA methylation or other eligible marker measured.
DNA methylation of TGFbeta-pathway gene regions, including BAMBI, was measured in NSCLC tissue compared with tumor-free lung tissue.
Runx3 promoter CpG methylation was measured across three severity groups of chronic atrophic gastritis and correlated with prognosis.
This is a single case report of vorinostat treatment in one child with relapsed myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (HELP tagging, validated by bisulfite sequencing) was measured in cord blood CD3+ T cells from IUGR versus AGA infants.
DNA methylation of NF-kB pathway genes was measured in adolescents prenatally exposed to the Quebec ice storm and linked to cytokine production.
DAPK and THBS1 promoter methylation was measured by MS-PCR in esophageal metaplasia samples and linked to H. pylori infection status.
This study of systematic training and skeletal/biological maturity measured no epigenetic marker.
Xq28 duplications encompassing MECP2 were characterized as copy-number variants, not as a methylation or chromatin measurement.
Genetic polymorphisms in chromatin-remodeling genes were genotyped in a case-control study; chromatin state itself was not measured.

gammaH2AX phosphorylation was measured in laryngeal cancer patients and served as a prognostic biomarker for organ-preservation outcomes.

Genome-wide leukocyte DNA methylation was measured before and after an 8-week resistance exercise training intervention.
SBF2-AS1 lncRNA expression was the only marker measured in human NSCLC tissue; the H3K27me3 ChIP assay was performed in cell lines only.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was compared between newborns with congenital aortic valve stenosis and matched controls for potential screening markers.

This phase II entinostat trial in Hodgkin lymphoma reported clinical response and toxicity without measuring an epigenetic marker.
This is a narrative clinical review ('How I treat') of mycosis fungoides and Sezary syndrome management.

H3K9 acetylation at the HTR3A promoter was measured in leukocytes of alcohol-dependent patients versus controls and linked to craving severity.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was associated with skeletal muscle mass in twins, but no modifiable exposure or clinical decision was linked to the marker.

This is a simulation-based methodological evaluation of cell-type correction methods, illustrated with but not centered on primary human methylation data.

MGMT promoter methylation status was measured in glioblastoma patients and compared against ADC histogram analysis for prognostic value.
